articles.title: A Unified Framework for Image-to-3D Part Generation via Variable Granularity
articles.content: Controllable 3D part generation is pivotal for digital asset creation, yet existing methods lack the flexibility to accommodate diverse user workflows requiring varying levels of control. In this paper, we introduce FlexPart, a unified image-to-3D part generation framework that supports variable-granularity geometric conditions within a single model. By seamlessly integrating heterogeneous inputs, ranging from sparse points to dense bounding boxes and masks, via gated adaptive modulation, FlexPart unlocks a powerful cross-modal synergy. We also propose an asymmetric geometric guidance mechanism that leverages strong spatial priors to align representations across granularities, improving geometric consistency and facilitating inter-task synergy. Under mask conditioning on PartVerseXL, FlexPart reduces Part CD by 16.6% relative to TripoSG + SAM3D and by 10.5% relative to OmniPart, while maintaining competitive whole-mesh quality. The code can be found at https://github.com/Gucci233/FlexPart

articles.title_zh: 图像到3D的统一框架 通过可变颗粒生成部分
articles.content_zh: 可控3D部分生成对于数字资产创造至关重要,但现有方法缺乏灵活性,无法适应需要不同程度控制的各种用户工作流程。 在本文中,我们引入了FlexPart,一个统一的图像到3D部分生成框架,支持一个单一模型内的可变-角几何条件. FlexPart通过无缝融合各种投入,从零星点到密集的边框和口罩,通过有门的适应性调制,释放出强大的跨模式协同效应。 我们还提出一种不对称的几何指导机制,利用强大的空间前兆来调和颗粒体之间的表示,提高几何一致性,促进任务间的协同作用。 在PartVerseXL上的口罩调节下,FlexPart相对TripoSG + SAM3D减少16.6%,相对于OmniPart减少10.5%,同时保持有竞争力的全mesh质量. 该代码可在https://github.com/Gucci233/FlexPart上找到.

articles.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
articles.content: Robotic foundation models are typically evaluated through costly closed-loop rollouts, which motivates cheap offline proxies for model capability. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that as representations improve, different modalities such as vision and language converge toward a shared statistical model of reality. We ask whether motion trajectories form another such modality: as embodied models become more capable, should their sensory representations converge toward the structure of physical motion? To examine this, we propose Sensorimotor Alignment ($S^2$), a training-free offline metric that measures how well a model's sensory representation aligns with the geometry of physical motion. We find that $S^2$ correlates positively with downstream robot task success across embodied model families, making it a low-cost offline proxy for prioritizing models before closed-loop evaluation. $S^2$ can also identify promising vision-language model (VLM) backbones even before costly fine-tuning into vision-language-action models (VLAs). Beyond this correlation, $S^2$ offers representation-level explanations for phenomena observed in VLAs and world action models (WAMs). With $S^2$, we extend PRH to embodied models and make sensorimotor alignment empirically measurable, offering insight into why an embodied model succeeds beyond its closed-loop success rate.

articles.title_zh: Sensorimotor 校正: 完美政策成功的一个柏拉图代理
articles.content_zh: 机器人基础模型通常通过昂贵的闭路式推出来评估,这激励了模型能力的廉价离线代理。 柏拉图表达假说(PRH)表明,随着表达方式的改进,愿景和语言等不同模式向共同的现实统计模式汇合。 我们问运动轨迹是否构成另一种这种模式:如所体现模型的能力增强,其感官表现是否应当趋同于物理运动的结构? 为了审查这一点,我们提议采用Sensorimotor对齐(S^2美元)这一无培训离线计量标准,衡量模型的感官表现如何与物理运动的几何相协调。 我们发现,$S^2美元与下游机器人任务在包含的模范家庭的成功有着积极的关系,使其成为一个低成本的离线代名词,用于在闭路评估前优先排列模型。 $S^2美元也可以在成本高昂的精细调整成视觉语言-行动模型之前就确定有希望的视觉语言模型(VLM)骨干. 除了这种关联外,$S^2美元为在《维也纳条约法公约》和世界行动模式中观察到的现象提供了代表性层面的解释。 我们用$S^2美元将PRH扩展为包含的模型,并使感官对齐在经验上可以测量,从而深入了解一个包含的模型为什么成功超过其闭锁-启动成功率。

articles.title: Reading, Writing, Sharing, and Interacting with the World through Video
articles.content: Video foundation models have advanced rapidly in understanding and generating visual sequences, while video world models seek to capture the underlying dynamics of the world they depict. Despite their different objectives, both concern the relationship between video observations and an evolving world. This survey adopts world modeling as a unifying lens for examining these developments. Viewing an observed video as a partial, lossy, and temporally ordered projection of a latent temporal world, we organize the literature around four complementary operations: reading infers world properties from observed video; writing synthesizes video from specified or learned world conditions; sharing integrates understanding and generation through common modeling mechanisms; and interacting predicts and updates world states under actions and evolving observations. This perspective distinguishes temporal coherence in observed or generated sequences from consistency in the underlying world state. Across tasks, representations, models, datasets, and benchmarks, we trace a shift in emphasis from clip-level recognition and perceptual fidelity toward persistent state, controllable evolution, physical and causal validity, and evaluation grounded in interaction and downstream decisions, and we distill the open challenges that follow.

articles.title_zh: 通过视频阅读、写作、分享和与世界互动
articles.content_zh: 视频基础模型在理解和生成视觉序列方面迅速进步,而视频世界模型则寻求捕捉他们所描绘的世界的基本动态. 尽管目标不同,但两者都涉及视频观测与不断变化的世界之间的关系。 这项调查采用世界模型作为审查这些事态发展的统一视角。 我们把被观测到的视频视为对潜在时空世界的片面、失落和时间顺序的投影,我们围绕四个互补行动组织文献:从被观测到的视频中推断出世界属性;从特定或了解的世界条件中合成视频;通过共同的建模机制分享理解和生成;在行动和不断发展的观测下,互动预测和更新世界国家。 这一视角区分了观测或生成序列的时间一致性与基本世界状态的一致性。 在任务、表述、模型、数据集和基准方面,我们追踪重点的转变,从短片层面的识别和观念上的忠诚转向持续状态、可控制的演化、物理和因果有效性,以及基于互动和下游决定的评价,我们总结了随之而来的公开挑战。

articles.title: SpectralCanary: Embarrassingly Simple Low-Frequency Traces for T2I Dataset-Use Auditing
articles.content: Auditing whether a text-to-image (T2I) model was fine-tuned on a particular image collection is difficult: a model can absorb collection-level visual characteristics without reproducing training images. Proactive dataset-use auditing plants a shared signal in a dataset before release, then later checks whether that signal appears in a suspect model's generated outputs. Existing approaches often trade off verifiability, fidelity, robustness, and deployability. We introduce $\textbf{SpectralCanary}$, which uses a smooth low-pass mask to blend a fixed canary image into every collection image while leaving captions unchanged and requiring neither auxiliary generation nor per-image optimization. A lightweight verifier detects the transferred signal in suspect-model outputs. Across eight tests on the Pokemon dataset and three realistic data transformations, spanning two architectures families, SpectralCanary achieves the highest average per-generation TPR@$1\%$ FPR ($91.1\%$) and fixed threshold model-level accuracy using 30 generations ($94.8\%$) among the evaluated methods. Across five datasets spanning artistic, medical, satellite, and fashion domains with SD3.5, SpectralCanary averages $92.4\%$ per-generation TPR@$1\%$ FPR while preserving the released images (SSIM $0.989$, LPIPS $0.022$) with a near-zero mean change FID (mean $Δ$FID $0.05$) across datasets. Matched-energy ablations on Pokemon and ROCOv2 support our design choice, low-frequency placement transfers more reliably compared to mid/high-frequency placement. Under the evaluated adaptive attacks, the most effective removal requires aggressive modification and incurs more than $25$ $Δ$FID points. These results identify low-frequency visual signals as effective carriers for collection-level T2I audit traces.

articles.title_zh: Spectral Canary: T2I 数据集-用途审计令人难堪的简单低频追踪
articles.content_zh: 对文本到图像(T2I)模型是否在特定图像收藏上进行微调的审计是困难的:一个模型可以吸收收藏级的视觉特性而无需复制训练图像. 主动的数据集-使用审计工厂在发布前在数据集中共享一个信号,然后检查该信号是否出现在可疑模型生成的输出中. 现有办法往往与可核查性、忠诚性、稳健性和可部署性相交换。 我们引入 $\ textbf{ Spectral Canary} $, 它使用一个平滑的低通道遮罩将固定的金丝雀图像混合到每个收藏图像中, 同时保留标题不变, 不需要辅助生成或每个图像的优化 。 轻量级验证器在可疑模型输出中检测到传输的信号. 通过对Pokemon数据集的8个测试和3个现实的数据转换,跨越两个架构家族,SpectralCanary实现了每代TPR@1\%$FPR(91.1\%$)的最高平均值,并在被评价方法中采用30代(94.8\%$)的固定阈值模型水平精度. 涵盖艺术、医疗、卫星和时尚领域的5个数据集,SD3.5、Spectral Canary平均每代92.4美元 FPR在保存发布图像(SSIM 9.989美元,LPIPS $ 0.022美元)的同时,各数据集的FID(平均$ $ $ 0.05美元)变化接近零. Pokemon和ROCOv2上的匹配能量可以支持我们的设计选择,与中/高频布置相比,低频布置转移更可靠。 在经过评估的适应性攻击下,最有效的清除需要积极修改,并需要超过25美元(美元)的FID点。 这些结果将低频视觉信号确定为收集级T2I审计痕迹的有效载体.

articles.title: BrickWright: Agentic Creation of Physically Feasible Brick Builds
articles.content: Frontier coding agents are becoming increasingly adept at 3D modeling. Yet, they still face challenges when building objects meant to be assembled in the physical world, often creating invalid assemblies with floating, colliding, or disconnected parts. We argue that providing agents with tools for assembling builds and verifying their physical feasibility is sufficient for them to produce physically valid assemblies that still adhere to input prompts. Focusing on the domain of LEGO brick builds, we present BrickWright, a framework for generating physically feasible brick builds from text or image prompts using pre-trained agents, where a build is physically feasible if it uses only real parts, has no colliding or floating parts, and forms a connected structure if possible. BrickWright guides agents to create builds by writing code with BrickLayer, a Python toolkit with two main components: an ergonomic brick assembly API that halves inference cost compared to working in raw LDraw, and a validator that provides feedback on physical feasibility. Whereas baseline agents achieve physical validity rates ranging from only 9% (GPT-6 Luna) to 69% (GPT-6 Astra), BrickWright-guided agents achieve 100% validity on a sample of 512 prompts, while improving prompt adherence for lightweight agents and maintaining it for stronger agents. Additionally, they outperform specialized models on the text-to-brick task. Code is available on our project page: https://avalovelace1.github.io/brickwright/

articles.title_zh: BrickWright: 物理功能砖建筑的代理创建
articles.content_zh: 边疆编码代理商在3D建模方面越来越精通. 然而,在建造拟在物理世界组装的物体时,它们仍然面临挑战,这些物体往往用漂浮、碰撞或断开的部件制造无效的组件。 我们辩称,向代理人提供集成工具并核实其物理可行性足以使其产生实际有效的组件,这些组件仍然遵守输入提示。 聚焦于LEGO砖建领域,我们提出BrickWright,这是利用预试剂的文字或图像提示生成物理上可行的砖建的框架,如果建筑只使用真实部件,则在物理上可行,没有碰撞或浮动部件,并在可能时形成连接结构. BrickWright 引导代理通过与 BrickLayer 的写法代码创建构建,一个Python 工具包,主要组件有两种:一种是人造砖组装API,比在原始 LDraw 中工作时将推论成本减半,一种是提供物理可行性反馈的验证器. 基线制剂的物理有效性从只有9%(GPT-6 Luna)到69%(GPT-6 Astra)不等,而BrickWright制导的制剂在512个速率的样本上则达到100%的有效性,同时提高轻度制剂的迅速遵守性,并维持其更强的制剂. 此外,它们在文本对砖块任务上的表现超过了专门模式。 代码见我们的项目网页:https://avalovelace1.github.io/brickwright/。

articles.title: Gate3DGen: A Pre-processing Model that Selectively Purifies Real-World Images for 3D Generation
articles.content: Single-image 3D generation has achieved high fidelity on curated benchmarks, yet degrades sharply on real-world images with uneven illumination, blur, and occlusions. Purifying such inputs requires deciding when to intervene and preserving the visual cues needed for 3D generation, while leaving clean inputs unchanged. We introduce Gate3DGen, a selective pre-processing model that gates image inputs to existing 3D generators without retraining them. A degradation-aware router bypasses inputs classified as clean and extracts features to guide purification of the remaining inputs. Conditioned on these features, a 3D-oriented one-step purifier purifies degraded inputs with spatial losses that encourage preservation of object identity, contours, and textural cues. To provide paired supervision, we construct a synthetic data engine that renders clean views of 3D assets and synthesises composite degradations. On the synthetic benchmark, the purifier improves image fidelity and downstream 3D geometry in only 2.3s on average, reducing TRELLIS.2 mesh distance by 61.5% relative to degraded inputs. VLM evaluation and human preferences on real photographs further support identity preservation and degradation correction. More demos and code are available at https://supra-3d.github.io/gate3dgen.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Gate3DGen: 用于三维生成的精选纯化真实世界图像的预处理模型
articles.content_zh: 单像3D一代在编译的基准上实现了高度的忠诚,然而在现实世界的图像上却以不均匀的光线,模糊,和杂乱无章地急剧退化. 净化这种投入需要决定何时进行干预,并保留3D生成所需的视觉提示,同时保持清洁投入不变。 我们引入了Gate3DGen,一种选择性的预处理模型,在不进行再培训的情况下将图像输入到现有的3D发电机上. 降解感路由器绕过归类为清洁的输入并提取特性,以指导其余输入的净化. 以这些特征为条件,一个面向3D的单步净化器净化了已退化的输入,造成空间损失,鼓励保存物体的特征、轮廓和纹理提示。 为了提供配对监督,我们建造了一个合成数据引擎,使三维资产得到干净的视野,合成合成降解。 在合成基准上,净化器平均仅用2.3s改进图像忠贞度和下游3D几何,相对于退化的输入物,TRELLIS.2网间距离减少了61.5%. VLM评价以及人类对真实照片的偏好进一步支持身份保存和降解矫正. 可在https://supra-3d.github.io/gate3dgen上查阅更多演示和代码。

articles.title: OmniRay: Camera-Agnostic Monocular 3D Reconstruction with Composite Ray Fields
articles.content: Monocular models recover 3D geometry from a single image in one pass, but most assume a pinhole camera and produce distorted geometry on the wide-angle imagery produced by fisheye and panoramic lenses. Camera-aware models remove this assumption by predicting a per-pixel ray field. However, they represent different camera geometries using a single fixed basis to capture both the overall camera projection and its finer variations. We argue that camera geometry can be viewed as having a hierarchy of complexity for representing rays. We present OmniRay, a feed-forward model whose Ray Module is composed of three components: a monotone radial base that captures radially symmetric structure, a spherical-harmonic residual for smooth deviations from it, and a free-form residual for remaining local variation. These components are composed as successive rotations on the sphere, allowing the representation to accommodate diverse camera geometries. Given a single image, OmniRay predicts a ray direction and an up-to-scale radial distance for every pixel, from which a 3D point cloud is recovered without needing camera information at inference time. Extensive experiments across different camera configurations demonstrate that OmniRay establishes a new state-of-the-art in camera-agnostic monocular 3D reconstruction.

articles.title_zh: OmniRay: 相机-不可知 单体 3D 重建与复合雷场
articles.content_zh: 单体模型在一次通过中从单一图像中恢复3D几何,但大多数假设是针孔相机,并在鱼眼和全景镜头产生的广角图像上产生扭曲几何. 相机感知模型通过预测每像素射线场来删除这个假设. 然而,它们代表不同的相机几何,使用一个单一的固定基础来捕捉总体相机投影及其更细的变异. 我们主张,相机几何可以被视为具有代表射线的复杂层次. 我们提出OmniRay,一种向导模型,其Ray Module由三个部分组成:一个捕捉光线对称结构的单质光圈基,一个平滑偏移的球形-谐振残基,以及一个剩余局部变异的自由形式残基. 这些组件由球体的连续旋转组成,使代表能够容纳不同的相机几何. 鉴于一个单一的图像,OmniRay预测每个像素的射线方向和最高的射线距离,从中恢复一个3D点云,在推断时间不需要相机信息. 跨越不同相机配置的广泛实验表明,OmniRay在相机不可知的单体3D重建中建立了新的先进水平.

articles.title: GigaBench: Benchmarking Learnable Representations for Gigapixel Image Compression and Super-Resolution
articles.content: Learnable Representations (LRs) can fit parametric families of functions to diverse kinds of signals. These emergent neural-native data formats are gathering interest in the scientific community due to their compactness, resolution-agnosticism and amenability to direct neural processing. On the other hand, gigapixel images are becoming increasingly widespread across a variety of scientific, cultural, and industrial domains. In this paper, we present GigaBench, the first benchmark and experimental evaluation focused on deploying LRs with gigapixel imagery. GigaBench includes images collected, acquired, and synthetically rendered across diverse domains, and addresses image compression and super-resolution. We adapt a representative set of LRs, spanning Implicit, Hybrid, and Explicit methods, so as to operate reliably at the gigapixel scale on consumer hardware. Through systematic evaluation across reconstruction quality, model size, compression and inference times, we identify consistent trends across methods and suggest actionable guidance for future investigation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Giga Bench: Gigapixel 图像压缩和超解析的可学习表达基准
articles.content_zh: 可学习的表示力(LRs)可以将函数的参数化家族配合到各种信号中. 这些新兴神经-内生数据格式因其紧凑性,分辨率-不可知性以及可直接进行神经处理的通融性,正在引起科学界的兴趣. 另一方面,千兆像素的图像正在日益普及到各种科学、文化和工业领域。 在本文中,我们介绍了Giga Bench,这是第一个基准和实验评价,重点是部署带有千兆像素图像的LRs. Giga Bench包括不同领域收集、获取和合成的图像,并处理图像压缩和超分辨率问题。 我们调整了一套具有代表性的LR, 包括隐形、混合和显性的方法, 以便以千兆像素规模可靠地运行在消费硬件上。 通过对重建质量、模型规模、压缩和推断时间的系统评价,我们查明了不同方法的一致趋势,并为今后的调查提出了可采取行动的指导。

articles.title: UniVOE: A Removal-Driven Framework for Interaction-Aware Universal Video Object Editing
articles.content: Video object removal and injection are reciprocal editing operations between object-present and object-absent video states, yet they differ substantially in training difficulty. Removal can be effectively bootstrapped from video inpainting and further adapted to erase object-related interaction effects. Injection, however, requires large-scale paired supervision to model object appearance, dynamics, and scene-dependent effects, while perfectly aligned real-world pairs are difficult to collect and synthetic data lacks sufficient realism and diversity. To address this challenge, we present UniVOE, a removal-driven framework for training both video object removal and injection models. We first train an effect-aware remover by transferring video inpainting priors and finetuning on object-present/object-absent pairs. The trained remover converts real object-present videos into object-absent counterparts, creating large-scale paired supervision for injection. An injection model is trained on these pairs in the reverse direction to recover objects together with their dynamics and interaction effects. Moreover, since pixel-level reconstruction alone cannot adequately capture perceptual realism, we introduce a reward-based post-training method that aligns injection results with human preferences using a proprietary reward model. Experiments against strong open-source and commercial systems demonstrate that UniVOE achieves state-of-the-art performance on both object removal and injection, particularly in challenging interaction-effect cases.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: UnivoE: 交互- 智能通用视频对象编辑的删除驱动框架
articles.content_zh: 视频对象清除和注入是对象存在和对象存在视频状态之间的对等编辑操作,但在训练难度方面却大相径庭. 清除可以有效地从视频涂装中解脱出来,并进一步调整以抹去与对象相关的交互效应. 然而,注射需要大规模配对监督,以模型化物体外观,动力学,和场景依赖效应,而完全对齐的真世界配对则难以收集,合成数据缺乏足够的现实性和多样性. 为了应对这一挑战,我们提出了UniVOE,这是一个由移除驱动的框架,用于培训视频物体移除和注射模型。 我们首先通过传输视频涂装前科并微调对对象在场/对象的配对,来训练一种能感知效果的清除器. 训练有素的清除器将真实对象存在的视频转换成对象缺失的对等视频,创建了大规模配对的注射监督. 在反方向的这些对子上训练了一种注射模型,以回收物体及其动力学和相互作用效应。 此外,由于光是像素级的重建无法充分捕捉到感知现实主义,我们采用了一种基于奖励的训练后方法,利用专有奖励模式,将注射结果与人类的喜好相配合. 针对强开源系统和商业系统的实验表明,UniVOE在物体清除和注射方面都取得了最先进的性能,特别是在具有挑战性相互作用效应的案例中.

articles.title: WorldForge V2: Eliciting Camera-Trajectory Alignment in Video Diffusion Models
articles.content: Video diffusion models have learned rich 3D/4D priors, making them promising for scene generation and video re-rendering. However, their use in spatial tasks is limited by imprecise camera control, spatial and temporal inconsistencies, and entangled camera motion with scene dynamics. Existing approaches, such as task-specific fine-tuning and post-process warping, often introduce visual artifacts, generalize poorly, or incur high computational costs. We propose WorldForge V2 to achieve accurate camera control while preserving the generative capabilities of pretrained video models. We first develop a training-free guidance framework using warped references to iteratively refine generation along a target camera path. Optical-flow analysis identifies motion-related latent channels for selective guidance, helping separate motion control from appearance. A dual-path strategy further compares guided and unguided predictions to correct artifacts from imperfect references. Together, these components guide viewpoint changes while preserving scene appearance and object motion. To reduce refinement costs, v-cache approximates the correction using the preceding denoising prediction, avoiding an additional model evaluation. We further extend motion localization from latent channels to network blocks and introduce Trajectory LoRA, which concentrates adaptation on blocks most responsive to trajectory guidance. A two-stage training strategy teaches these adapters to denoise the states encountered during guided generation, using limited supervision effectively. This enables reliable camera control with very little training data, with a single training scene already supporting generalization to unseen scenes. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations across multiple datasets show that our method achieves state-of-the-art generation quality and trajectory accuracy in camera-controlled video generation.

articles.title_zh: WorldForge V2:视频传播模型中的Eliening Camera-Trajectory对齐
articles.content_zh: 视频传播模式已经学会了丰富的3D/4D前科,使得这些模式对场景生成和视频重播充满希望. 然而,它们在空间任务中的使用受到摄影控制不准确、空间和时间不一致以及镜头运动与场景动态缠绕的限制。 现有方法,如针对特定任务的微调和过程后扭曲,往往引入视觉文物,概括性差,或产生高昂的计算成本. 我们提议WorldForge V2实现准确的相机控制,同时保留预先训练的视频模型的基因能力. 我们首先开发一个无培训指导框架,使用扭曲的参考,沿目标相机路径反复精炼一代。 光电流分析确定了选择性引导的与运动相关的潜在通道,有助于将运动控制与外观分离. 双向战略进一步比较有指导性和无指导性的预测,以纠正不完美的参考文献中的文物。 这些组件共同指导视角变化,同时保留场景外观和物体运动. 为降低精细化成本,v-cache使用之前的去名预测来对校正进行近似,避免了额外的模型评价. 我们进一步将运动局部化从潜在通道扩展到网络块,并引入了Trapriotory LORA,它把适应力集中在对轨迹引导最敏感的块上. 一项分两个阶段的培训战略教导这些适配者利用有限的监督,揭穿在制导生成过程中遇到的状态。 这使得可以使用很少的训练数据进行可靠的照相机控制,一个单一的训练场景已经支持了对看不见的场景的泛化. 跨多个数据集的定量和定性评价显示,我们的方法在相机控制的视频生成中实现了最先进的生成质量和轨迹精度.

articles.title: HiP3R: Hierarchical Pose Graphs for Long-Horizon 3D Reconstruction
articles.content: Feed-forward models accurately estimate camera motion and 3D geometry from short video windows. However, computational and memory costs prevent direct inference on sequences containing thousands of frames. Long videos must therefore be processed as overlapping chunks. This division produces independent local reconstructions with inconsistent coordinate frames and duplicate estimates of shared cameras. Achieving global consistency requires propagating constraints from adjacent overlaps and distant revisits across the sequence. This requirement naturally motivates pose graph optimization. However, the choice of graph level creates a trade-off. Chunk-level graphs efficiently resolve scale drift and close large loops. Yet, their rigid transformations cannot correct internal errors or conflicting frame predictions. Conversely, frame-level optimization offers local flexibility, but scaling it globally is computationally expensive and can break metric scale. HiP3R resolves this trade-off using a hierarchical pose graph. HiP3R first optimizes a robust chunk-level $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ graph to establish the global layout and scale. It then holds this layout fixed and estimates one shared $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ camera per frame, turning overlapping window predictions into a single trajectory. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of HiP3R in improving camera trajectories and 3D reconstruction. Our method applies to both chunk-based and streaming backends without additional training or fine-tuning. The codes are available at https://kkakkkka.github.io/HiP3R.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HiP3R: 长视立体重建的分级Pose图
articles.content_zh: Feed-forward模型从短视频窗口准确估计了相机运动和3D几何. 然而,计算和内存成本阻止了对包含千帧的序列的直接推论. 因此,长片必须作为重叠块处理。 该处进行独立的当地重建,坐标框架不一致,共用相机的估计数重复。 要实现全球一致性,就必须宣传来自相邻重叠的制约因素,并在整个序列中进行遥远的重新审视。 这一要求自然激发了图的优化。 然而,图级的选择会产生权衡. 春克级图能高效地解决尺度漂移并关闭大环. 然而,它们的刚性转变无法纠正内部错误或相互冲突的帧预测. 反之,帧级优化则可以提供局部灵活性,但在全球范围扩展则计算成本昂贵,可以打破度量衡. HiP3R用一个等级姿势图来解决这种权衡. HiP3R首先优化了坚固的块级$\mathrm{Sim}(3)$的图表,以建立全局布局和尺度. 然后它会固定这种布局,并估计每个帧一个共享的$\mathrm{SE}(3)$的相机,将重叠的窗口预测变成一个单一的轨迹. 跨越多个基准的实验证明了HiP3R在改进相机轨迹和3D重建方面的有效性. 我们的方法既适用于块式后端,也适用于流式后端,没有额外的训练或微调. 编码见https://kakkkka.github.io/HiP3R。

articles.title: F2G-Pose: Geometry-Aware Foundation Feature Lifting for Direct RGB-D Category-Level Object Pose Estimation
articles.content: This paper studies category-level RGB-D object pose estimation, which recovers an object's 3D rotation and translation without instance-specific CAD models or reference views. This task is highly ambiguous due to intra-class variations, symmetries, and partial observations. Current solutions struggle to balance reliability and efficiency: methods based on intermediate structures are prone to error propagation, while diffusion models suffer from high inference latency and complex post-hoc candidate extraction. To address this, we present F2G-Pose, a real-time direct, single-pass framework that predicts category-level pose, metric size, and camera-frame completed shape from a single RGB-D observation in one feed-forward pass. F2G-Pose lifts dense visual foundation features to partial point clouds, encodes local geometry with DGCNN tokenization, and integrates object-level structure with a Mixture-of-Experts Transformer. Joint size prediction and camera-frame shape completion encourage metric consistency through dense geometric supervision. With its task-specific network trained only on pose-annotated synthetic SOPE data and its frozen RADIO backbone externally pretrained, F2G-Pose achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on SOPE and ROPE while running at 28 FPS for pose-only inference, and further demonstrates strong camera-frame geometry on HouseCat6D and real-object transfer on HANDAL. Analyses of latency, robustness, shape completion, and GenPose++ candidate behavior further demonstrate the efficiency and reliability of F2G-Pose, with real-world manipulation experiments demonstrating deployment potential under segmented RGB-D inputs. The project page, code, and pretrained models are made available at https://jrryzh.github.io/F2G-Pose/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: F2G- Pose: 几何- 智能基金会 用于直接 RGB- D 类- 类- 类- 类对象估计的特性提升
articles.content_zh: 本文研究了类别级RGB-D对象的推算,它恢复了对象的3D旋转和翻译,没有实例特定的CAD模型或参考视图. 由于班内差异、对称和部分观察,这项任务非常模糊。 目前的解决办法难以平衡可靠性和效率:基于中间结构的方法容易发生错误传播,而传播模型则有很高的推论延迟和复杂的热后候选人提取。 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了F2G-Pose,即一个实时的直线,单通道框架,从一个向导的通道中,从单一的RGB-D观测中预测出类别级的姿势,度量大小,以及完成的相机帧形状. F2G-Pose将稠密的视觉基础特征提升至部分点云,用DGCNN的标志化编码局部几何,并整合了带有Mixture-of-Experts Transformer的物体级结构. 联合大小预测和照相机框架形状的完成,通过密集的几何监督,鼓励了计量的一致性。 F2G-Pose在任务特异性网络中只接受姿势附加的合成SOPE数据培训,其冷冻的RADIO主干线在外部经过预先训练后,在SOPE和ROPE上实现了最先进的精度,同时运行在28 FPS上,仅作姿势推断,并进一步展示了HouseCat6D上和HANDAL上的实际对象转移上的强相机框架几何. 对耐久性,稳健性,形状完成性,以及GenPose++候选行为的分析进一步证明了F2G-Pose的效率和可靠性,现实世界的操纵实验在分块的RGB-D输入下证明了部署潜力. 项目网页、代码和预先培训过的模型可在https://jryzh.github.io/F2G-Pose/上查阅。

articles.title: Beyond Best-of-$k$: Prior-Consistent DAPS for Ambiguous Nonlinear Inverse Problems
articles.content: Diffusion models have become strong priors for solving inverse problems. However, nonlinear inverse problems such as phase retrieval remain challenging when multiple measurement-consistent solutions are distinguishable only by the prior; we call such measurements ambiguous. Existing diffusion-based samplers rely on local approximations during reconstruction. For an ambiguous measurement, these approximations can allow measurement guidance to favor a measurement-consistent mode that is close to a prior-supported mode but is itself not supported by the prior. Evaluation often masks this type of failure by reporting the best-of-$k$ runs, where the best is selected by comparison to the ground truth. We introduce Prior-Consistent DAPS (PC-DAPS), a variant of Decoupled Annealing Posterior Sampling (DAPS) designed to address this failure case by maintaining multiple candidate solutions within a single sampling run. As annealing noise decreases, PC-DAPS prunes and replaces weaker candidates according to their prior consistency, without any ground-truth access. PC-DAPS reduces the incidence of prior-inconsistent samples and improves sample quality on nonlinear inverse problems while preserving sample quality and diversity on linear inverse problems.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: B. 超出最佳美元:针对重大非线性反向问题的先发制人DAPS
articles.content_zh: 扩散模式已成为解决反向问题的强项。 然而,当多个符合测量方法的解决方案只能与先前的方法区分时,诸如相位检索等非线性反向问题仍然具有挑战性;我们称这些测量方法模糊不清。 现有的基于传播的采样机在重建过程中依赖于当地近似值. 对于一个模棱两可的测量,这些近似值可以允许测量指导倾向于一种接近于先前支持的模式但本身不受先前支持的测量一致模式. 评价往往通过报告最优的美元运行情况来掩盖这种失败,与地面真相相比,最佳的运行情况是经过挑选的。 我们提出 " 预先一致的DAPS " (PC-DAPS),这是脱钩的Annaling Posessorior Sampling(DAPS)的一个变体,旨在通过在一次抽样中维持多种候选解决方案来解决这一故障。 随着反响的噪音减少,PC-DAPS按其先前的一致性进行挤压和替换较弱的候选人,而没有任何地面真实访问. PC-DAPS可以减少先前不一致的样本的发生,提高非线性反向问题的样本质量,同时在线性反向问题上保持样本质量和多样性.

articles.title: CellTrack-Bench: Microscopic Cell Tracking Benchmark for Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Large language models have shown outstanding performance on text-first tasks such as coding, math, and writing. Recent efforts are shifting models' training to include scientific problems that often live in highly specialized domains beyond text, such as protein structure and biological images. However, in these scenarios, their general-purpose accuracy compared with specialized algorithms remains in question. One such domain is cell tracking, which requires spatiotemporal awareness of cell dynamics. To evaluate this, we created a new benchmark, CellTrack-Bench, which assesses Vision-Language Models' (VLMs) cell-tracking-related performance against specialized trackers. The full benchmark draws from 15 standard cell-tracking datasets across four imaging modalities and comprises 1,537 problems corresponding to 9,041 cell-linking decisions. We selected a hard subset requiring greater reasoning effort by identifying failures shared across distinct algorithmic trackers. With this proposed dataset, we: (i) evaluated different environment harnesses for VLMs; (ii) benchmarked 9 frontier closed-source models and 13 open-weight models; and (iii) provided a detailed analysis of their failure modes. Code, the stored model outputs, and a pipeline that regenerates the benchmark from the source datasets are available at https://github.com/royerlab/celltrack-bench.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 细胞跟踪-奔驰:显微镜 愿景-语言模型的单元格跟踪基准
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型在文本第一任务,如编码,数学,写作等方面表现出杰出的表现. 最近的努力正在转变模型的培训方式,以包括科学问题,这些问题往往生活在文字以外的高度专业化的领域,如蛋白质结构和生物图像。 然而,在这些假设中,它们与专门算法相比的普通用途准确性仍然存有疑问。 其中一个领域是细胞跟踪,这需要瞬间对细胞动力学的认识. 为了评价这一点,我们建立了一个新的基准,即CellTrack-Bench,它对照专门的跟踪者评估Visual-Language Models(VLM)的细胞跟踪相关性能. 整个基准取自15个标准细胞跟踪数据集,涉及四种成像模式,包含1 537个问题,相当于9 041个细胞链接决定。 我们选择了一个硬子集 需要更多的推理努力 通过识别失败 共享不同的算法跟踪器。 有了这个拟议的数据集,我们:(一) 评估了不同环境对VLM的利用;(二) 以9个前沿封闭源模型和13个开放加权模型为基准;(三) 详细分析了它们的故障模式。 编码、存储的模型输出以及从源数据集中重新生成基准的管道可在https://github.com/royerlab/celltrack-bench查阅。

articles.title: Squaring-the-Sphere: Distortion-Free and Seamless Panorama Generation via CubeAtlas
articles.content: Generating 360-degree panoramas requires both local perspective fidelity and global spherical continuity. Existing representations face a trade-off: equirectangular projection (ERP) enables seamless panorama modeling but suffers from severe distortion and a domain gap to pre-trained image generators, whereas cubemaps preserve perspective geometry but often produce inconsistent faces and visible seams. We present Squaring-the-Sphere, a panoramic image generation framework built on a novel representation CubeAtlas, which unfolds all cubemap faces into a single compact canvas. By arranging orientation-aligned, rotated polar regions alongside the equatorial faces, this representation preserves the perspective geometry of cubemaps while organizing the cross-face relationships required for seamless panorama assembly. It further enables a pretrained diffusion transformer to model the complete panorama jointly in a single pass, without altering the backbone architecture or positional encoding. While CubeAtlas has a token count comparable to ERP, its structured layout makes many dense attention interactions unnecessary. We therefore introduce a layout-aware sparse attention mask that preserves the interactions required for panorama continuity while removing geometrically irrelevant token pairs. As a result, CubeAtlas achieves better quality than ERP modeling with lower attention computation. Furthermore, we introduce a training-free super-resolution technique and a fusion scheme that enhance fine details in distortion-free perspective space before achieving the final ERP panorama. Experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate that our method improves geometric fidelity, cross-view consistency, and high-resolution visual quality over previous methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Squaring-the-Sphere:通过CubeAtlas生成的无扭曲无缝全景
articles.content_zh: 生成360度全景既需要局部视角的忠实,也需要全球球面的连续性. 现有表述面对一种权衡:等效投影(ERP)能够无缝的全景模型,但因严重失真和域间隙而导致预先训练的图像生成器,而立方体保存了几何视角,但往往产生不一致的面部和可见的缝隙。 我们介绍Squaring-the-Sphere,一个全景图像生成框架,它基于一个小代表Cube-atlas,它将所有立方体的面孔展开成一个单一的紧凑的画布. 通过在赤道面旁安排定向对接,旋转的极地区域,这种表示保留了立方体的几何视角,同时组织无缝全景组装所需的交叉关系. 它进一步使预先训练的散射变压器能够将完整的全景联合建模为单传,而不改变主干架构或位置编码. 虽然CubeAtlas具有相当于ERP的符号计数,但其结构化布局使得许多密集的注意力互动没有必要. 因此,我们采用了一种布局意识稀少的注意面具,它保留了全景连续性所需的相互作用,同时去除几何不相关的符号对. 因此,CubeAtlas比使用关注度较低的计算方式进行ERP模型制作,提高了质量. 此外,我们引入了无培训的超解析技术和聚变计划,在完成企业资源规划最终全景之前,在无扭曲的视角空间中改进精细细节。 对各种基准的实验表明,我们的方法比以前的方法提高了几何忠诚度,交叉视野的一致性,以及高分辨率的视觉质量。

articles.title: LACToS: Local Anomaly Detection via Conditional Typicality of Superpixels
articles.content: Local anomaly detection is the task of identifying spatially confined anomalous or out-of-distribution (OOD) regions within an otherwise in-distribution (ID) image. Most existing methods are designed for a specific context, with a strong focus on industrial defect detection, where they achieve excellent performance on well-established benchmarks. However, we observe that these methods can exhibit significant performance drops in other contexts, especially when the inlier distribution is multimodal. To account for this inlier complexity, we propose LACToS, a principled local OOD detection method based on statistical typicality and made tractable through two innovations: (i) grouping pixels into superpixels and (ii) using a computationally efficient proxy to estimate typicality. We evaluate LACToS across three diverse applications spanning medical imaging, human faces, and X-ray security screening. LACToS performs more robustly than prior methods across these benchmarks. The code is released here: https://github.com/voilalab/LACToS.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LACTOS: 通过条件性典型的超像素进行局部异常检测
articles.content_zh: 局部异常探测是确定空间限制异常或分布外区域在否则的分布内图像的任务。 现有方法大多是针对具体情况设计的,重点突出工业缺陷检测,在既定基准上取得优异成绩. 然而,我们发现,这些方法在其他情况下,特别是在最优惠的分销是多式联运的情况下,表现会显著下降。 为了考虑到这种更为复杂的情况,我们提出LACTOS,一种基于统计典型性的原则性局部OD检测方法,并通过两个创新使这个方法可以应用:(一) 将像素组合成超像素和(二) 使用计算效率的代词来估计典型性. 我们评价LACTOS的三种不同应用,包括医疗成像、人脸和X光安全检查。 对照这些基准,LACTOS的绩效比以往的方法要强。 该代码在此发布:https://github.com/voilalab/LACTOS.

articles.title: Diffusion-Based Synthesis of Complete 3D Biparametric Prostate MRI
articles.content: Synthetic biparametric MRI (bpMRI) may help alleviate the limited availability of large and representative prostate MRI datasets for deep learning applications. In this work, we present a conditional 3D diffusion framework for anatomy-conditioned synthesis of complete prostate bpMRI from anatomical masks. The framework supports sequential synthesis, in which T2w and diffusion modalities are generated by separately trained models, and joint synthesis, in which all bpMRI modalities are generated simultaneously within a single model. Five configurations were trained using PI-CAI, FastMRI Prostate, and PROSTATEx datasets to investigate different conditioning schemes, target modalities, and synthesis strategies. Evaluation using distribution-based metrics, paired-image similarity, and qualitative assessment demonstrated the feasibility of both synthesis pathways. Joint synthesis achieved competitive distributional fidelity while generating complete bpMRI, whereas direct synthesis of ADC and computed high-b-value DWI outperformed their derivation from synthetic diffusion-weighted images.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 完全三维比对的传播合成 前列腺核磁共振
articles.content_zh: 合成双配体核磁共振(bpMRI)可能有助于缓解用于深层学习应用的大型和代表性前列腺核磁共振数据集的有限可用性. 在这部作品中,我们提出一个有条件的3D扩散框架,用于解剖学条件下从解剖口罩中合成完整的前列腺bpMRI. 该框架支持顺序合成,其中T2w和传播模式由单独训练的模型生成,联合合成,其中所有bpMRI模式在一个单一模型中同时生成. 使用PI-CAI、FastMRI Prostate和PROSTATEx数据集对五个配置进行了培训,以调查不同的配置方案、目标模式和综合战略。 使用基于分配的衡量标准、配对图像相似性以及质量评估进行的评价,证明了两种合成途径的可行性。 联合合成在产生完整的bpMRI的同时实现了竞争性的分布忠实,而直接合成ADC和计算高b值的DWI则比合成扩散加权图像的衍生效果要好。

articles.title: Evaluation of Uncertainty-Aware Multi-Software Ensembles for Hippocampal Segmentation
articles.content: Accurate hippocampal segmentation can be a useful tool for diagnosing and monitoring neurological conditions such as Alzheimer's disease and epilepsy. While numerous automated segmentation methods exist, their clinical adoption remains limited. Reliable uncertainty assessment can enhance trust and facilitate clinical translation. This study evaluates ensembles of five heterogeneous hippocampal segmentation methods - InnerEye, ASHS, FastSurfer, HippoSeg, and FreeSurfer - across two dementia datasets and one epilepsy dataset. The sub-ensemble containing InnerEye, FastSurfer, and HippoSeg emerged as both accurate and efficient, highlighting the feasibility of balancing computational cost and performance. Additionally, ensemble-derived uncertainty quantification with sample variance, mutual information, and predictive entropy is shown to reduce inaccurate segmentations by flagging low-confidence cases, potentially providing a mechanism for automatically escalating ambiguous cases for expert assessment. Lastly, this study explores the downstream clinical utility of ensemble-derived uncertainty, finding a significant correlation with motion artefact severity and a modest contribution to Alzheimer's disease classification.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 评价用于 Hippocampal 分块的不确定- 智能多软件集
articles.content_zh: 准确的河马分化可以成为诊断和监测阿尔茨海默病和癫痫等神经病症的有用工具. 虽然存在许多自动化分解方法,但它们在临床上的采用仍然有限。 可靠的不确定性评估可以增强信任,促进临床翻译。 本研究评价了五种不同的河马分化方法 -- -- 内眼、ASHS、FastSurfer、HippoSeg和FreeSurfer -- -- 跨越两个痴呆症数据集和一个癫痫数据集。 包含InnerEye,FastSurfer,和HippoSeg的子组合出现既准确又高效,突出了平衡计算成本和性能的可行性. 此外,以样本差异、相互信息、预测性等量化共同产生的不确定性,通过标出低信任度病例,可以减少不准确的分解,有可能为专家评估自动升级的模棱两可案例提供一个机制。 最后,本研究探讨综艺衍生的不确定性在临床上的下游作用,发现与动脉动严重性有重大关联,对阿尔茨海默氏病分类作用不大。

articles.title: AgentVQA: A Unified Benchmark for Agentic Visual Understanding
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) can perform a broad range of tasks across diverse settings, yet their performance in agentic contexts remains poorly understood. Although online evaluations in simulators and real-world environments are essential for measuring interactive agent performance, they are costly and challenging to scale. Complementary offline VQA benchmarks can enable faster and more reliable comparisons across agentic domains, yet existing benchmarks remain limited and fragmented. To address this gap, we introduce AgentVQA, an offline benchmark for evaluating VLMs on realistic agentic scenarios across five agent domains: Web Agents, Robotics, Egocentric Videos, Games, and Spatial Planning. We build AgentVQA by manually selecting 1000 challenging, real-world agent examples from 23 source datasets and adapting them for reliable offline evaluation. The resulting benchmark preserves realistic scenarios from interactive environments across diverse domains, and its model rankings track those from corresponding online evaluations. Across the 22 evaluated models, the best achieves only 58.5% accuracy. Our cross-domain analysis shows that errors are driven primarily by failures to ground and maintain accurate representations of the current and evolving visual state, including localizing relevant UI elements, interpreting motion, tracking state changes over time, and inferring 3D spatial relationships, rather than by task misinterpretation or downstream logical reasoning.

articles.title_zh: 代理VQA:代理视觉理解的统一基准
articles.content_zh: 愿景语言模型(VLMs)可以在不同环境之间执行范围广泛的任务,但其在代理环境下的表现仍然不为人所知。 虽然模拟器和现实世界环境中的在线评价对衡量互动代理业绩至关重要,但它们成本高昂,而且难以扩大规模。 补充性离线VQA基准可以使代理领域之间的比较更快和更可靠,但现有基准仍然有限和零散。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了AgentVQA,这是一个线下基准,用于评估网络代理、机器人、爱高中心视频、游戏和空间规划等五个代理领域的VLM。 我们通过手动从23个源数据集中选择1000个具有挑战性的现实世界代理实例,并将其用于可靠的离线评价来构建AgentVQA. 由此产生的基准保留了不同领域互动环境的现实情景,其模式排名跟踪相应在线评价的情景。 在22个评估模型中,最佳的准确度仅为58.5%。 我们的跨域分析显示,错误的驱动力主要在于未能对当前和不断发展的视觉状态进行地面和保持准确的表达,包括将相关的UI元素本地化,解释运动,跟踪状态随时间变化,推断3D空间关系,而不是任务误解或下游逻辑推理.

articles.title: Self-Supervised Multibeam Sonar Restoration via Coherent Forward Modeling
articles.content:
Multibeam imaging sonar produces intensity images degraded by coherent speckle and system-induced blur, while clean reflectivity targets are rarely available. Existing despeckling methods often rely on simplified intensity-domain noise models, synthetic clean targets, or blind-spot self-supervision, and typically do not jointly model deblurring and speckle suppression.
  We propose a physics-consistent self-supervised framework for joint despeckling and deblurring of multibeam imaging sonar. A stochastic coherent image-formation model yields a conditional-mean forward operator that relates latent scene reflectivity to expected intensity through the squared magnitude of the system point spread function. We then use registered multi-frame sonar sequences to train without clean ground truth images, showing that, under an idealized inter-frame conditional-mean condition, the expected paired loss equals the corresponding forward-prediction loss up to a network-independent constant. To stabilize the ill-conditioned inverse problem, we further adapt robust equivariant imaging using stochastic coherent simulation and introduce a paired forward prediction error metric for ground-truth-free evaluation. Experiments on two real multibeam sonar datasets demonstrate a favourable balance between forward-prediction agreement, homogeneous-region speckle suppression, and preservation of visible structural boundaries compared with representative baselines.

articles.title_zh: 通过协同前进模型进行多波束声纳修复
articles.content_zh:
多束成像声纳产生由连贯的光谱和系统引起的模糊而退化的强度图像,而清洁的反射目标则很少存在. 现有的分辨方法往往依赖于简化强度域噪声模型,合成清洁目标,或盲点自控,一般不会联合模型分解和分辨抑制.
我们提出一个符合物理学的自我监督框架,用于多波束成像声纳的联合分光和分光。 一个有条理的、连贯的图像成型模型产生一个有条件的正向操作器,通过系统点扩散功能的平方尺度,将潜在场景反射率与预期强度联系起来。 然后我们使用已注册的多帧声纳序列来训练,不使用干净的地面真象,显示在理想化的跨帧条件-平均值条件下,预期的配对损失等于相应的前预测损失,直到网络独立的常数. 为了稳定条件不佳的反向问题,我们进一步调整了强力等效成像,采用有条理的一致模拟,并引入了用于无地面真实性评价的对联前向预测误差计量标准。 对两个真正的多波束声纳数据集的实验表明,与具有代表性的基线相比,前向预测协议、同区光谱抑制和可见结构边界的保持之间取得了有利的平衡。

articles.title: MoG-VLM: Efficient Video Anomaly Detection through Motion-Guided Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong potential for video anomaly detection, but dense frame-level inference makes them impractical for real-time deployment. Existing acceleration commonly relies on uniform sampling, which ignores content dynamics and can either waste computation on static segments or miss localized anomalies. We propose MoG-VLM a motion-adaptive anomaly detection framework that leverages motion purely as a lightweight control signal to decide when VLM inference is necessary. To this end, we introduce Temporal Gradient Magnitude (TGM) which performs content-aware sampling to concentrate computation on informative regions while avoiding redundant processing. We further introduce a hierarchical dual-stream design in which dense multi-frame VLM reasoning is activated only around frames with elevated anomaly likelihood, via anchor-triggered context-window expansion with early termination. A fusion module then reconciles these instantaneous semantic cues with temporal action dynamics. Across four benchmarks, our method achieves 91.91%, 84.30%, 87.88%, and 78.96% AUC-ROC on XD-Violence, UCF-Crime, MSAD, and ShanghaiTech, respectively, establishing new state of the art on three benchmarks under the zero-shot, training-free setting. On XD-Violence, we improve over the previous best result by +0.57% while delivering a 1.31x inference speedup. These results demonstrate that content-aware allocation of VLM capacity, processing fewer frames more intelligently rather than all frames uniformly, is a more effective axis of progress than uniformly densifying VLM inference across frames. Code is available on GitHub: https://github.com/kdawoud91/MoG-VLM.

articles.title_zh: MoG-VLM:通过运动引导的视觉语言模型进行高效视频异常检测
articles.content_zh: Vision-Langage Models(VLMs)已经显示出强大的视频异常探测潜力,但密集的帧级推论使得它们对于实时部署不切实际. 现有的加速通常依靠统一的取样,这种取样忽略了内容动态,可以浪费在静态片段上的计算,也可以错过局部异常. 我们提议MoG-VLM一个运动适应异常检测框架,利用运动纯粹作为轻量级控制信号来决定何时需要VLM推论. 为此,我们引入了进行内容意识取样的Temperal Gradient Magnitude(TGM),以集中计算信息区,同时避免冗余处理. 我们进一步引入了分级双流设计,即密集的多帧VLM推理仅在有较高异常可能性的帧周围启动,通过锚触上下文窗口扩展,提前终止. 一个聚变模块然后将这些瞬间语义提示与时间动作动态调和. 在四个基准中,我们的方法分别实现了91.91%、84.30%、87.88%和78.96%的AUC-ROC关于XD-暴力、UCF-Crime、SMAD和上海科技,在零射线、无培训设置下的三个基准上建立了新的技术水平。 在XD-暴力方面,我们比以往的最佳结果提高0.57%,同时提供1.31x推论速度。 这些结果表明,对VLM容量的内容认识分配,比对所有帧的处理更加智能化,而不是所有帧的统一,是比对跨帧的VLM推论进行统一分解更有效的进展轴. 代码可见于GitHub:https://github.com/kdawoud91/MoG-VLM.

articles.title: Ask About the Right Moment: Training-Free Object Identity Reasoning for Video-Language Models
articles.content: Many questions about a video concern one physical object. Where does the ball end up after the cups are shuffled? Which card is the queen? How often was the mug covered? Video-language models (Video-LMs) recognise such objects in single frames but do not keep them apart over time. On real shell-game videos, open models from 8B to 235B parameters, their thinking variants, a reinforcement-learned tool agent and three training-free tool agents all stay within ten points of chance. We separate semantic identity binding from temporal identity maintenance. An object's identity should be fixed at a moment when the evidence for it is visible, and carried afterwards by a tracker. \emph{Track, Then Bind} implements this principle without training. A promptable video tracker follows every candidate object and draws it with a track number. A frozen vision-language model answers a static question about the identifying evidence, which binds the target to a track. The answer is then derived from the tracked state in text, without asking the model to reinterpret the original video during read-out. A single configuration covers all benchmarks. With Qwen3-VL-32B it solves both VET-Bench tasks, where a fine-tuned trajectory model reaches 92\% and 90\% and the same VLM voting over 16 samples stays at 30--32\%. It answers 55.4\% of the hardest Perception Test cup games, where the best published model answers 41.5\%, and, using track-derived timelines, 48.6\% of TOC-Bench questions, against 37.1\% for the same model answering directly. Drawing the same tracks on the video and asking the question directly falls 12--19 points short of the agent on real cup games.

articles.title_zh: 询问正确时刻:视频语言模型的无培训对象身份
articles.content_zh: 许多关于视频的问题涉及一个物理物体。 杯子洗完后,球到哪里去了? 哪个牌是皇后? 杯子被盖了多久? 视频语言模型(Video-LMs)在单帧中识别此类物体,但不会在一段时间内将它们分开. 在真实的 shell-game 视频中,8B到235B参数的开放模型,他们的思维变体,一个强化学习工具代理和三个无训练工具代理都停留在十点机会之内. 我们把语义性身份绑定 和时间性身份维护分开 物体的身份应在其证据可见的时刻确定,然后由跟踪器携带。 \emph{跟踪, 然后,宾德] 不经过培训就执行这一原则。 一个快速的视频跟踪器跟踪每一个候选对象,并用音轨编号绘制. 一个冷冻的视觉语言模型解答了一个关于识别证据的静态问题,将目标绑在轨道上. 答案随后从文字中的履带状态中衍生出来,而没有要求模型在读出时重新解释原始视频. 单一配置涵盖所有基准。 通过Qune3-VL-32B,它解决了VET-Bench两个任务,一个微调的轨迹模型达到92\%和90\%,同一个VLM对16个样本的投票停留在30-32\%. 它回答了55.4+Q最难的Perception Test杯游戏,其中最佳公布的模型回答了41.5+X,使用音轨衍生的时段,48.6+X TOC-Bench问题,而同一模型直接回答的则是37.1+X. 在视频中绘制同样的音轨,并直接提问,在真杯游戏中比代理差12-19分.

articles.title: AnyGameRenderer: Entity-Consistent Generative Rendering Across Games and an Entity-Level Benchmark
articles.content:
AI coding agents can now build small playable games in minutes, but the results usually look like programmer art: gray blockouts, colored geometric primitives, and flat semantic blobs. We present AnyGameRenderer, a video-to-video generative renderer that turns such footage into high-quality visuals with characters, motion detail, and effects. Throughout, it keeps the layout, camera, and every entity's position and timing intact.
  Our AnyGameRenderer generalizes across a wide range of genres that agents build, such as tower defense, auto-battlers, top-down survivors, turn-based battles, kart racing, and crowd runners.
  AnyGameRenderer takes plain video as its game-state input, with no complex representations such as engine G-buffers, per-object class labels, or low-poly proxies. Gray blockouts, colored primitives, semantic maps, and wireframes all work as input.
  It also preserves entity correspondence: group counts stay correct, and entities appear and disappear on the right frame.
  We implement AnyGameRenderer by LoRA fine-tuning MiniMax-H3 ref2va, a 33B reference-video-conditioned video generation model. Training uses $\sim$10k paired clips from three sources: (i) multi-stream rendering data from 38 agent-made games exported from GEAR, an AI game-creation tool; (ii) two-stream rendering data from Unreal Engine, with programmatically controlled crowds, count changes, and entity scales; and (iii) real gameplay recordings, with pairs reconstructed via 3D-box detection.
  To evaluate the entity correspondence, we propose an entity-level benchmark of 59 held-out cases with 753 entities, scored against ground-truth boxes. Compared with the base model, AnyGameRenderer better preserves entity correspondence: temporal match rises from 50.9\% to 62.9\%, missed count changes fall from 34.7\% to 21.3\%, and fewer entities are hallucinated or left unrendered.

articles.title_zh: AnyGameRefer: 实体- 恒定的跨游戏基因渲染和实体级基准
articles.content_zh:
AI编码代理现在可以在几分钟内建立小型的可玩游戏,但结果通常看起来像程序员的艺术:灰色屏蔽,彩色几何原始,以及扁平的语义blobs. 我们介绍AnyGameRender, 一个视频到视频的基因渲染器, 将这种镜头变成高质量的视觉, 有人物,动作细节, 和效果。 在整个过程中,它保持了布局,摄像头,以及每个实体的位置和时间的完整.
我们的AnyGameRender 概括了特工们所建立的各种流派,例如塔楼防御,自动击球手,自上而下的幸存者,回合制战斗,Kart赛车,以及人群跑者.
AnyGameRender将纯视频作为其游戏状态输入,没有引擎G-buffers,每个对象类标签,或低波代理等复杂的表示. 灰色挡板,彩色原始,语义图,以及线框都作为输入工作.
它还保存实体函证:组数保持正确,实体出现在右框并消失.
我们执行AnyGameRender,由LORA微调MiniMax-H3 ref2va,一种33B参考视频条件的视频生成模型. 训练使用来自三个来源的$\sim$10k的配对剪辑: (一)来自GEAR输出的38款代理游戏的多流渲染数据,这是AI游戏制作工具; (二)来自Unreal Engine的双流渲染数据,有程序上控制的人群,计数变化,以及实体尺度; (三)真实的游戏剧情录制,通过3D盒检测重建的配对.
为了评价实体的函证,我们提出一个实体一级的基准,即59个搁置案件,有753个实体,与地面真相箱对照。 与基数模型相比,AnyGameRender更好地保存实体对应:时间匹配从50.9\%上升到62.9\%,错失的计数变化从34.7\%下降到21.3\%,幻觉或未触动的实体较少.

articles.title: MixPT: Point Transformer with Interleaved Window and Global Attention
articles.content: Point cloud transformers aim to capture detailed local geometry and relationships across a scene at a manageable computational cost. Two common approaches are window attention and global attention. They differ in how they enable scene-wide interaction, which refers to information exchange among tokens across a scene. Window attention reduces computational cost by restricting self-attention to groups of tokens called windows; in serialized designs, each window contains a fixed number of consecutive tokens from a spatially ordered sequence. Because each block only directly connects tokens within the same window, information exchange across windows relies on changes in window membership across blocks and hierarchical pooling. Global attention, in contrast, directly connects all tokens within a scene, but computing attention over all token pairs can be costly when the number of tokens is large. To balance computational cost and scene-wide interaction, we introduce MixPT, a point transformer that uses a mix of window and global attention blocks in an interleaved schedule, while retaining a single fixed serialization pattern for its window blocks. For scenes with a large number of tokens, MixPT applies global attention to spatially pooled tokens and returns residual updates to the original-resolution stream. Across indoor and outdoor benchmarks, MixPT achieves competitive accuracy with lower latency than representative window and global attention baselines. We further demonstrate the feasibility of scaling the attention stage in depth by repeating the interleaved pattern of window and global attention blocks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MixPT:带互换窗口和全局关注的点变形器
articles.content_zh: 点云变压器旨在以可控的计算成本,捕捉整个场景的详细局部几何和关系. 两种共同做法是窗口关注和全球关注。 它们在如何促成全场互动方面有所不同,这是指整个场景的标志之间的信息交流. 窗口注意通过将自我注意限制在称为窗口的几组信使上,从而降低计算成本;在序列化设计中,每个信使窗口都包含一个空间顺序的固定数的连续信使. 由于每个块只在同一窗口内直接连接符号,所以不同窗口之间的信息交流依赖于不同块间窗口成员的变化和等级集合. 与此相对照,全球关注直接连接一个场景内的所有信物,但当信物数量大时,计算所有信物对的注意力可能代价高昂. 为了平衡计算成本和全场互动,我们引入了MixPT,即一个点变器,它使用窗口和全局关注区块在互换的时表中的组合,同时为其窗口区块保留单一的固定序列化模式. 对于拥有大量符号的场景,MixPT将全球注意力应用于空间集合符号,并将剩余更新返回原解析流. 在整个室内外基准中,MixPT实现竞争性精确度,其延迟度低于代表性窗口和全球关注基线。 我们进一步表明,通过重复窗口和全球关注区块的互开模式来扩大关注阶段的可行性。

articles.title: A Sparse Topometric Graph for Scalable Cross-Session Indoor Navigation
articles.content: A conventional embodied agent in an indoor environment builds a map by accumulating noisy real-world measurements and results from heavy inference to guide navigation. While the detailed measurements may differ due to scene changes or sensor settings, the unique topological structure of navigable passages or the connectivity between rooms may provide training-free guidance that complements local observations. We propose a sparse topometric graph as an efficient structural representation for robust indoor navigation, alleviating the need for fine-grained matching, which is computationally expensive, memory-intensive, and prone to real-world variations. The map consists of nodes that encode local 3D geometry and distance-weighted edges that capture traversable connectivity. A learned graph-matching network finds consistent subgraph structures across sessions by considering both node-level geometric descriptors and neighborhood connectivity. The holistic contextual matching is robust to local ambiguities caused by weak distinctiveness or repetitive structure, and establishes stable correspondences despite local scene changes, different sensor modalities, or limited spatial overlap. We analyze the practicality of the graph through cross-session point-goal navigation, where a goal specified in a prior reference map must be reached from an unknown initial pose in a later session. Experiments show that our method achieves the highest success rates (77.1% on Gibson and 40.0% under 3D-FRONT scene changes), while reducing memory by more than two orders of magnitude compared to point-level representations. The proposed approach further supports cross-session alignment and goal-directed navigation with strong scalability and robust real-world transfer.

articles.title_zh: 可缩放跨会场室内导航的平面图
articles.content_zh: 室内环境中的常规内含剂通过积累吵闹的现实世界测量结果和从沉重的推论中得出指导导航的结果来绘制地图. 虽然详细测量可能因场景变化或传感器设置而有所不同,但可导航通道的独特地形结构或房间之间的连接可能提供无培训指导,补充局部观测. 我们提出一个稀疏的透析图,作为强大的室内导航的高效结构代表,缓解了精细配比的需求,这种配比在计算上昂贵,内存密集,容易发生现实世界的变化. 地图包括将本地3D几何编码的节点和捕捉可逆连接的远程加权边. 一个学习到的图形比对网络通过考虑节点级几何描述符和邻里连接,在整个会话中发现了一致的子图结构. 整体上下文匹配与因差异性弱或重复性结构造成的局部模糊性很强,尽管局部场景变化,传感器模式不同,或者空间重叠程度有限,但仍建立了稳定的对应关系. 我们通过跨会场点-目标导航来分析该图的实用性,即先前参考地图中规定的目标必须在以后一届会议上从未知的初始位置上达到。 实验显示,我们的方法取得了最高的成功率(在Gibson上为77.1%,在3D-FRONT场景变化下为40.0%),同时与点级表示相比,将内存减少了两个以上的数量级. 拟议方法进一步支持跨会场对齐和瞄准导航,具有强大的可伸缩性和强大的现实世界转移.

articles.title: A Task-Centric Survey of Long-Document Visual Question Answering: Taxonomy, Evolution, and Future Directions
articles.content: Visual document understanding is essential for acquiring knowledge from visually rich documents and is attracting growing research interest. Existing surveys emphasize architectures or technical approaches, with limited attention to how task bottlenecks shape technical choices and research priorities. We present a task-centric survey that decomposes long-document visual question answering (VQA) into four components: document parsing, evidence organization and retrieval, generator organization and learning, and evaluation. For each, we develop a fine-grained taxonomy and trace motivations, technical responses, and cross-component connections. We focus on explicit retrieval while covering direct reading. Our temporal analysis traces expanding priorities from multimodal content understanding to sufficient, high-fidelity evidence acquisition and sustained evidence management. We outline future directions in evidence sufficiency, verifiable and correctable understanding, and budget-aware coordination, with an outlook on continual document understanding.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 长文件视觉问题专题调查 答复:分类学、演变和未来方向
articles.content_zh: 视觉文件理解对从视觉丰富的文件中获取知识至关重要,并正在吸引越来越多的研究兴趣。 现有的调查强调结构或技术方法,对任务瓶颈如何决定技术选择和研究优先事项的关注有限。 我们提出了一个以任务为中心的调查,将长文件的视觉问题回答(VQA)分为四个部分:文件解析、证据组织和检索、生成器组织和学习以及评价。 对于每一个,我们发展出精细的分类学和微量的动机,技术反应,以及交叉组件连接. 我们的重点是明确检索,同时涵盖直接阅读。 我们的时间分析可追溯到从了解多式联运内容到充分、高可靠性证据的获取和持续的证据管理等优先事项的扩大。 我们概述了证据充足性、可核查和可更正的理解以及预算意识协调方面的未来方向,并展望持续的文件理解。

articles.title: WeVisOne-VL: Unified Visual Perception from Objects to Pixels
articles.content: Existing vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable for fine-grained visual perception. In this report, we present WeVisOne-VL (WeChat Vision All-in-One), a powerful VLM that unifies object-level and pixel-level perception through structured next-token prediction. It supports multiple visual tasks including object detection, referring localization, counting, OCR, segmentation, and matting, enabling localization at any user-specific granularity, from points and boxes to masks and alpha mattes. Architecturally, we integrate a lightweight pixel decoder into the VLM via a special <OBJ> token to generate instance-level pixel outputs. We train the model with a three-stage curriculum SFT followed by mixed-task RL. Across over 30 benchmarks, WeVisOne-VL demonstrates leading performance on both object-level and pixel-level tasks, while maintaining robust rejection for object-absent queries. By releasing WeVisOne-VL to the open-source community, we hope to advance VLMs from broad visual understanding toward truly reliable perception systems for real-world deployment.

articles.title_zh: WeVisOne-VL:从对象到像素的统一视觉感受
articles.content_zh: 现有的视觉语言模型(VLMs)对于精细的视觉感知仍然不可靠. 在本报告中,我们介绍了WeVisOne-VL(WeChat Vision All-in-One),这是一种强大的VLM,通过结构化的下台预测,统一对象级别和像素级别感知. 它支持多个视觉任务,包括对象检测,转介本地化,计数,OCR,分区化,以及交配,使得任何用户特定颗粒的本地化,从点和盒到面具和α垫. 在建筑上,我们通过一个特殊的<OBJ>令牌,将一个轻量级像素解码器整合到VLM中,以生成实例级像素输出. 我们用三个阶段的课程来训练这个模型 SFT 然后是混合任务RL 在超过30个基准中,WeVisOne-VL在对象级别和像素级别的任务上都显示出领先的性能,同时对对象偏差查询保持强烈拒绝. 通过将WeVisOne-VL释放给开源社区,我们希望将VLM从广义的视觉理解推进到真正可靠的感知系统,用于现实世界的部署.

articles.title: MVLoMa: Multi-View Local Feature Matching with Any Geometry Foundation Model
articles.content: Local feature matching is typically formulated for image pairs, although structure-from-motion and visual localization commonly match one reference image against many retrieved or covisible neighbours. Applying a pairwise matcher independently to these centre-neighbour edges duplicates reference-side computation and prevents the matcher from exploiting complementary multi-view geometric evidence from the remaining observations. To address these limitations, we introduce MVLoMa, a sparse star-graph matcher that extends LoMa from image pairs to multiple views. MVLoMa first uses a frozen multi-view geometry model to jointly describe all images in a star, then injects the resulting cross-view geometric context into local descriptors. It then matches the centre image to all neighbours in a single forward pass through per-view self-attention and bidirectional centre-neighbour cross-attention. For supervision, we derive positive correspondences only from depth-valid, mutually visible dense warps and explicitly penalize high-confidence matches that violate epipolar geometry. On 25-view star graphs from HyperSim, ScanNet++, Mip-NeRF 360, and Tanks and Temples, MVLoMa obtains the best macro-average relative-pose AUC among the compared methods at all three thresholds (58.65/85.41/90.99). Its matcher is 2.20 times faster than sequential evaluation of the 24 centre-neighbour edges. The same design supports four tested frozen geometry encoders -- DA3, $π^3$, VGGT, and VGGT-$Ω$ -- with DA3-Giant performing best on all reported encoder-ablation metrics. Controlled ablations further isolate the effects of geometry-aware descriptors, visibility filtering, geometric negative supervision, and joint multi-view inference.

articles.title_zh: MVLOMA:多维本地特性匹配任意几何基础模型
articles.content_zh: 局部特征匹配一般是为图像对对而设定的,尽管结构-从动和视觉本地化通常会比对一个参考图像与许多被检索或可共见的邻居. 将双向匹配器独立应用到这些中-邻边,重复了参考侧计算,阻止匹配器从剩余观测中利用互补的多视图几何证据. 为了解决这些局限性,我们引入了MVLOMA,一个稀少的星图配对者,将LOMA从图像对到多个视图. MVLOMA首先使用冷冻的多视图几何模型来联合描述一颗恒星中的所有图像,然后将由此产生的交叉视图几何背景注入局部描述符. 然后,它将中心图像与所有邻居一致,通过每个视图的自我观察和双向的中心-邻居交叉观察。 为了监督,我们只能从深度有效、相互可见的密集曲面中得出正面的对应结果,并明确惩罚违反极地几何学的高自信匹配。 在HyperSim,ScanNet++,Mip-NERF 360,以及Tanks and Temples的25景星图上,MVLOMA在所有三个阈值的比较方法中获得了最佳的宏观平均相对率AUC(58.65/85.41/90.99)。 它的配对速度是24个中邻国边缘连续评价速度的2.20倍. 同一设计支持四个经过测试的冷冻几何编码器 -- -- DA3、 $π^3美元、 VGGT 和 VGGT - $ -- -- 其DA3 - Giant 在所有已报告的编码-缩写指标上表现最好。 受控的擦伤进一步隔离了几何-知觉描述器,能见度过滤,几何负监督,以及联合多视推论的效果.

articles.title: Stream4D: Streaming 4D Reconstruction with Training-free Motion Decoupling via Causal KV-Cache Attention
articles.content: 4D scene reconstruction requires robust handling of dynamic objects, yet existing streaming methods commonly assume static scenes, leading to pose drift and ghosting artifacts over long sequences. We introduce Stream4D, a training-free, motion-decoupled streaming reconstruction framework that can be directly integrated into causal Transformer backbones (e.g., StreamVGGT, Stream3R). Our key observation is that causal attention implicitly encodes rich temporal motion cues within the KV cache. We adaptively aggregate these cues from multiple attention layers and across temporal windows, and fuse them with depth priors to handle challenging cases such as occlusions and textureless regions, producing precise dynamic masks that decouple static and dynamic regions. We then apply a soft key masking scheme that leverages these dynamic masks to suppress interference from dynamic regions in causal attention, thereby improving camera pose estimation accuracy. Stream4D inherits the efficiency of causal attention and remains compatible with existing streaming architectures. On diverse dynamic-scene benchmarks, Stream4D significantly improves camera pose estimation and static-scene reconstruction quality, yields reliable dynamic masks, and effectively mitigates long-sequence ghosting.

articles.title_zh: Stream4D:通过Causal KV-Cache 注意,将4D重建流程与无培训运动脱钩
articles.content_zh: 4D场景重建需要强力处理动态物体,然而现有的流线方法通常假设静态场景,导致漂移和幽灵的文物在长序之上摆出. 我们引入了Stream4D(Sream4D),这是一个无训练,运动脱节的流体重建框架,可以直接融入因果变形器主干线(如SreamVGGT,Sream3R). 我们的关键观察是 因果关系隐含地编码了 KV 缓存中丰富的时间运动提示。 我们适应性地从多个关注层和跨时间窗口汇总这些提示,将它们与深度前导线连接起来,以处理诸如隔离和无纹理区域等具有挑战性的案例,产生精确的动态口罩,使静态和动态区域脱钩。 然后我们采用软密钥遮盖方案,利用这些动态遮盖来抑制动态区域在因果关注中的干扰,从而提高相机的估算准确性. Stream4D继承了因果关注的效率,仍然与现有的流体架构兼容. 在多样的动态-场景基准上,Stream4D显著改进了相机的布局估计和静态-场景重建质量,产生可靠的动态口罩,并有效缓解了长序幽灵.

articles.title: Data-Driven Vision-Language Models for Remote Sensing: A Survey
articles.content: During the deep learning era, innovations in remote sensing (RS) vision models primarily focused on optimizing network architectures for specific tasks and conducting end-to-end training. However, with the advent of the Vision-Language Models (VLMs) era, constrained by substantial computational resource demands, the mainstream research paradigm has shifted towards adapting general-purpose VLMs using RS vertical domain data for fine-tuning, rather than modifying their core architectures. This transition marks a change in the innovation pathway from model-centric to data-centric. Despite the increasing importance of data, the academic community still lacks a systematic, data-centric survey to guide researchers in constructing high-quality RS vision-language datasets for various application scenarios and in conducting effective model fine-tuning and performance evaluation based on these datasets. To address this gap, this paper presents a systematic review of the development status of RS datasets tailored for VLMs. It further provides a comprehensive practical guide for RS researchers in the large model era, covering the entire pipeline from data construction to fine-tuning and evaluation. This paper aims to encourage the academic community to build more diverse and higher-quality vision-language datasets for specialized RS sub-fields. Ultimately, the goal is to converge these efforts into a comprehensive RS vision-language corpus that offers extensive task coverage and a wide geographical distribution, thereby laying a solid data foundation for advancing towards general artificial intelligence in RS.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 遥感数据驱动视野-语言模型:调查
articles.content_zh: 在深度学习时代,遥感(RS)愿景模型的创新主要侧重于优化特定任务的网络架构和开展端到端培训. 然而,随着愿景-语言模型(VLM)时代的到来,受到大量计算资源需求的制约,主流研究范式已经转向利用RS垂直域数据来调整通用VLM,而不是修改其核心架构. 这一转变标志着创新途径从以模型为中心转向以数据为中心。 尽管数据的重要性越来越大,但学术界仍然缺乏系统、以数据为中心的调查,以指导研究人员为各种应用情景建立高质量的RS视觉语言数据集,并根据这些数据集进行有效的模型微调和性能评价。 为了弥补这一差距,本文件系统地审查了为甚高频数据专门设计的RS数据集的发展状况。 它还为大模型时代的塞族共和国研究人员提供了全面的实用指南,涵盖从数据构建到微调和评价的整个管道. 本文旨在鼓励学术界为专业的RS子领域建立更加多样化和高质量的视觉语言数据集. 最终目标是将这些努力合并成一个全面的塞族共和国愿景语言教程,提供广泛的任务范围和广泛的地域分布,从而为推进塞族共和国的一般人工智能奠定坚实的数据基础。

articles.title: PiHand: Latent Hand-Object Interaction Priors for Physics-Based Policy Learning
articles.content: Synthesizing physically grounded dexterous hand-object interactions is important for VR/AR, gaming, and robotics, yet remains challenging because subtle contact dynamics, diverse object geometries, and target trajectories must be jointly respected while maintaining natural grasps. Existing methods either track mocap trajectories with limited transfer to novel objects, or rely on hand-only generative priors that fail to capture coupled hand-object motion, sacrificing contact fidelity and sample efficiency. To tackle these challenges, we introduce PiHand, a Physically grounded Interaction-aware Hand motion synthesis framework. PiHand first trains expert policies that track mocap demonstrations in simulation, distills them into a unified hand-object interaction prior using a goal-conditioned VAE, and finally solve diverse dexterous manipulation tasks through bounded residual exploration in its latent space. With only a single reward and no complex curriculum training, this yields general tabletop manipulation policies that generalize to unseen objects and trajectories on GRAB and DexYCB. The same prior transfers to object catching and bimanual handover, two tasks that are rarely seen in its training data. Across all tasks, PiHand consistently outperforms baselines in all metrics. We will release the processed data and model checkpoints.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PiHand:基于物理学的政策学习的Latet Hand-Object交互前科
articles.content_zh: 合成物理上基底的脱落手物相互作用对于VR/AR,游戏,机器人都很重要,然而仍然具有挑战性,因为微妙的接触动态,多样的物体几何,以及目标轨迹在保持自然把握的同时必须共同尊重. 现有的方法要么是追踪摩卡普轨迹,有限地转移给新颖物体,要么是依靠只掌握基因的前科,无法捕捉到结合的手物体运动,牺牲接触忠心和样本效率. 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了PiHand,即一个具有物理基础的互动意识手动综合框架。 PiHand首先训练专家政策,在模拟中跟踪摩卡普演示,在使用有目标条件的VAE之前将其蒸馏成一个统一的手物体交互,最后通过在潜伏空间的有界限的剩余探索,解决了多种多样的离心操纵任务. 仅通过一次奖励和不进行复杂的课程培训,就产生了一般桌面操纵政策,将GRAB和DexYCB上的物体和轨迹普遍化。 先前转让的同样是捕获对象和双人移交,这两项任务很少见于培训数据。 在所有任务中,PiHand始终超越所有衡量基准。 我们将公布经处理的数据和示范检查站。

articles.title: RecallGS: Geometry-Grounded Recall for Online Semantic Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: Online semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables open-vocabulary scene understanding from streaming observations. However, existing methods recover geometric context missing from image-derived semantic features using an additionally learned 3D network, incurring extra training and runtime overhead. We observe that such geometric-semantic evidence may already exist in the agent's observation history and can be retrieved rather than learned. Based on this insight, we introduce RecallGS (Geometry-Grounded Recall for Online Semantic Gaussian Splatting), a lightweight, training-free mechanism that treats past observations as a non-parametric geometric-semantic prior. RecallGS follows a recall-ground-fuse pipeline: CLIP retrieves relevant observations, alpha-compositing weights identify geometrically supported views, and aggregate their semantic features over each Gaussian's rendered footprint. On ScanNet and ScanNet++, RecallGS achieves strong semantic segmentation performance at 2.48 FPS, demonstrating that geometric-semantic context can be effectively recovered from observation history without an additional learned 3D branch.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RecallGS:几何-环绕重回 在线语义高斯白板
articles.content_zh: 在线语义学 3D 高斯平板电脑(3DGS) 能够从流体观测中实现开放-vocabulary场景理解. 然而,现有方法利用另外学习的三维网络,恢复图像衍生语义特征中缺失的几何上下文,进行额外培训和运行时间管理。 我们观察到,这种几何语义证据可能已经存在于代理人的观测史上,可以检索而不是学习. 基于这种洞察力,我们引入了RecallGS(Geometry-Grounded Recall for Online Semantic Gaussian Splateting),这是一种轻量级,无训练的机制,将过去的观测作为非参数几何-语义前置. 召回GS采用召回地面引信管道: CLIP检索相关的观测,α-集成权重识别几何支持的视图,并在每个高斯人得到的足迹上汇总其语义特征. 在ScanNet和ScanNet++上,RecallGS在2.48 FPS上实现强语义分解性能,表明几何语义上下文可以在没有额外学习到的3D分支的情况下从观测历史中有效恢复.

articles.title: Retrieval-Augmented Online Textual Memory for Episodic Memory Video Question Answering
articles.content:
Long egocentric videos pose a central challenge for multimodal language models: the visual stream must be compressed into a memory representation that can be searched efficiently while still preserving the evidence needed for question answering. Building on an online textual-memory framework in which first-person videos are converted into temporally grounded captions, this work systematically studies the role of retrieval in episodic-memory video question answering. We evaluate how different retrieval units, query formulations, context budgets, and reranking strategies affect multiple-choice answering on QAEgo4D-Closed, isolating retrieval as the main variable while keeping the underlying generated memory fixed.
  Our best configuration, Parent, matches fine-grained caption subchunks, then provides their full parent captions to the reasoner. It achieves 56.4 % accuracy, matching strong full-memory and retrieval baselines while exposing only a small fraction of the textual memory at question time. More importantly, our analysis shows that better temporal coverage does not necessarily translate into better answers: increasing the retrieval budget improves temporal Hit@K and Recall@K, but can reduce accuracy by introducing visually plausible distractors and uncertain caption evidence. These findings suggest that retrieval-augmented egocentric memory should not be optimized only for evidence recall, but also for the reliability, specificity, and answer-discriminative value of the retrieved context. The study motivates more structured episodic memories that move beyond raw caption retrieval toward evidence-aware representations for long-form egocentric reasoning.

articles.title_zh: 为 Episodic 记忆视频解答问题而检索的在线文字内存
articles.content_zh:
长长的以自我为中心的视频对多式联运模式构成一个中心挑战:视觉流必须压缩成一个内存代表,可以有效搜索,同时保留回答问题所需的证据. 在将第一人称视频转换成基于时间的字幕的在线文字-记忆框架的基础上,这项工作系统地研究了检索在突发视频问答中的作用。 我们评价不同的检索单位,查询公式,上下文预算,以及重新排序的战略如何影响QAEgo4D-Closed上的多选择回答,将检索隔离为主要变量,同时保持基础生成的内存固定.
我们最好的配置,家长,匹配精细的字幕 子Chunk,然后提供他们 完整的父标题给理性者。 它实现了56.4%的精度,匹配了强烈的全记忆和检索基线,同时在问题时间只暴露了文字内存的一小部分. 更为重要的是,我们的分析表明,时间覆盖的改善并不一定能转化为更好的答案:增加检索预算可以改善时间点击@K和Recall@K,但可以通过引入可视化的可视转移器和不确定的字幕证据来降低准确性。 这些调查结果表明,不应仅仅为了召回证据而优化检索的自我中心记忆,而且还应优化检索的上下文的可靠性、特殊性和回答歧视价值。 这项研究激发了更结构化的零星记忆,这些记忆超越了原始标题检索,而转向对长式自我中心推理的体会到证据的表述。

articles.title: ReCoG: Relational Concept Graph for Training-Free Personalization
articles.content: Training-free personalization adapts a frozen vision-language model (VLM) to recognize user-defined concepts from only a few exemplars by retrieving concept entries at inference time. While recent retriever-based methods enrich each concept with descriptive evidence, they largely treat concepts in isolation, so the retrieved information can be plausible yet non-discriminative, especially when the personalized concept set contains highly confusable, fine-grained categories. We argue that personalization is inherently relational: correct recognition depends on the specific distinctions between a concept and its nearest alternatives. To this end, we propose ReCoG, a Relational Concept Graph for retrieval-augmented personalization. ReCoG represents concepts as nodes and augments them with directed edges that explicitly capture discriminative cues between concept pairs, elicited by a frozen VLM during database construction. At inference, ReCoG retrieves a shortlist and resolves ambiguity via explicit pairwise comparisons conditioned on the corresponding relational edges, selecting the concept that consistently wins against competing candidates. We also introduce FINGER benchmark to test personalized recognition on confusable concept sets. Across FINGER, ReCoG substantially outperforms prior methods, with the largest gains in the most confusable regimes. ReCoG also achieves consistently best performance on established personalization benchmarks including captioning and VQA, confirming that relational evidence is broadly beneficial beyond fine-grained settings. Project Page: https://csy-98.github.io/ReCoG/

articles.title_zh: ReCoG:无培训个人化的关系概念图
articles.content_zh: 无培训的个性化通过在推论时间检索概念条目,使一个冷冻的视觉语言模型(VLM)从仅几个实例中识别用户定义的概念. 虽然最近以检索器为基础的方法用描述性证据丰富了每个概念,但它们基本上孤立地对待概念,因此检索到的信息可以令人信服,但又不具有歧视性,特别是当个性化的概念集包含高度混杂,精细的分类时. 我们认为,个性化是内在的相互关系:正确承认取决于一个概念与其最接近的备选办法之间的具体区别。 为此,我们提出ReCoG,一个可检索的个人化的关联概念图。 ReCoG代表作为节点的概念,并用直接的边缘来增强它们,明确捕捉概念对之间带有歧义的提示,在数据库构建过程中被冻结的VLM所引出. 推论,ReCoG检索了一份短名单,并通过以相应关系边缘为条件的明确对等比较解决模糊问题,选择了始终胜于竞争对手的概念。 我们还采用了FINGER基准,以测试对可互用概念集的个性化识别. 在整个FINGER中,ReCoG的成绩大大超过以前的方法,在最不相容的制度中收益最大。 ReCoG还在包括标题和VQA在内的既定个性化基准上取得一致的最佳业绩,证实关系证据在优劣环境之外广泛有益。 项目网页:https://csy-98.github.io/ReCoG/

articles.title: Reinforcing intra-operative tumour localisation with weak supervision from pre-operative appearances
articles.content: Limited tumour visibility on intra-operative images complicates surgical navigation, including liver hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) targeting on computed tomography (CT) imaging. This makes labelled datasets difficult to curate for deep learning, and transferring pre-operative delineations through registration remains challenging due to intra-operative deformation and lack of paired pre- and intra-operative data. We propose to transfer tumour appearances learned from pre-operative magnetic resonance (MR) images to guide localisation on intra-operative CT through weak supervision. A classifier is trained to classify tumour presence on pre-operative images. This is applied to windows on intra-operative images, and despite the domain gap, it assigns higher tumour-presence probabilities on average to tumour-containing windows. These weak cross-domain signals guide a reinforcement learning agent to localise tumours on intra-operative images. We compare direct transfer, few-shot adaptation and synthetic transfer (trained using unpaired MR and CT), which translates CT into synthetic MR before localisation. On an external HCC cohort, synthetic transfer outperformed other tested methods and CT-only baselines. Our framework enables cross-modality tumour localisation without paired MR-CT training images.
