articles.title_zh: 强化术前外观监测薄弱的术内肿瘤定位.
articles.content_zh: 手术内图像上的肿瘤可见度有限,使手术导航复杂化,包括肝肝细胞癌(HCC)针对计算成像(CT). 这使得贴有标签的数据集难以进行深层的学习,由于操作内变形和缺乏成对的操作前和操作内数据,通过登记转移操作前的划界仍然具有挑战性。 我们提议转移从术前磁共振图像中吸取的肿瘤外观,通过弱监督引导术内CT的局部化. 分类器在手术前图像上被训练为肿瘤存在分类. 这应用于操作内图像上的窗口,尽管域位差距很大,但它平均将较高的肿瘤存在概率分配给含有肿瘤的窗口. 这些薄弱的跨域信号引导一个强化学习剂在手术内图像上将肿瘤本地化. 我们比较直接转移,几发的适应和合成转移(使用未发光的MR和CT进行训练),在本地化前将CT转化为合成MR. 在一个外部合同委员会组群中,合成转移的绩效超过了其他经过测试的方法和只使用CT的基线。 我们的框架可以实现跨模式肿瘤定位,而不配对MR-CT训练图像。

articles.title: Lightweight Frame Compensation for Real-Time Polyp Segmentation under Frame Skipping
articles.content: Real-time polyp segmentation in computer-assisted colonoscopy is hampered by the difficulty of deploying high-accuracy models under strict latency budgets. Frame skipping, which performs inference every K frames and reuses or interpolates the rest, improves throughput but introduces motion blur and lesion misalignment that degrade temporal consistency. To close this gap, we propose the Lightweight Frame Compensator (LFC), a 77K-parameter plug-and-play module inserted before a frozen segmentation backbone. Operating on a three-frame window, LFC fuses consecutive frames via spatio-temporal attention into a single compensated frame, and is trained only on pseudo-labels generated by a differently seeded model, without any expert annotation. Experiments on three polyp video benchmarks show that LFC recovers most of the accuracy degraded by direct frame skipping and, in several settings, reaches the accuracy of frame-by-frame inference, while retaining a 2.05X--2.55X throughput gain. We further evaluate the temporal stability of three backbones spanning CNN, pyramid Transformer, and global-attention Transformer architectures, revealing a spectrum of sensitivity to frame skipping that arises from how locally or globally each architecture aggregates misaligned input. The compensation gain of LFC follows this spectrum: it is largest for high-capacity Transformer backbones, which achieve the best static accuracy but suffer the most under skip-frame inference. LFC thus offers a lightweight, pluggable, and deployment-friendly route to real-time polyp segmentation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 框架跳过下实时多聚的轻量级框架补偿
articles.content_zh: 计算机辅助结肠镜学中的实时多肽分解由于在严格的潜伏预算下难以部署高精度模型而受到阻碍. 框架跳过,它进行每个 K 帧的推论,再利用或插入其余部分,可以提高吞吐量,但引入运动模糊和损害错位,从而降低时间一致性。 为了缩小这一差距,我们提议使用轻量级框架补偿器(LFC),即一个77K参数的插座和游戏模块插入到一个冷冻的分块主干线之前。 LFC在一个三帧窗口上运行,通过斯皮提奥时段的注意将连续的帧线导入一个单一的补偿帧线,并且只接受不同种子模型产生的伪标签培训,没有任何专家注释. 对三个多盘视频基准的实验表明,LFC恢复了大部分通过直接帧跳过而退化的精度,并在一些情况下达到了帧逐帧推断的精度,同时保留了2.05X-2.55X的吞吐量增益. 我们进一步评价横跨CNN、金字塔变形器和全球关注变形器架构的三个主干网的时间稳定性, 揭示出从地方或全球各架构如何聚集错位输入而跳过框架的敏感度。 LFC的补偿收益遵循这个频谱:它对于大容量变形器骨干来说是最大的,它们能达到最好的静态精度,但在跳过框架推论下受的伤害最大. 因此,LFC提供了一个轻量级、可插接和部署友好的路线,可通往实时多肽分解。

articles.title: GLOW-FM: Efficient Generative Low-Light Image Enhancement with One-Step Latent Flow Matching
articles.content: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) aims to recover well-exposed and perceptually faithful images from severely degraded observations. Recent diffusion-based generative methods achieve strong perceptual quality by leveraging powerful image priors, but their iterative sampling incurs substantial computational cost, limiting practical deployment. Despite recent efficiency gains in generative LLIE, high-quality enhancement with a single function evaluation and low overall computation remains challenging, particularly under diverse real-world low-light conditions. We introduce GLOW-FM, a one-step latent flow-matching framework for efficient generative LLIE. GLOW-FM performs conditional transport in the latent space of a frozen Tiny-VAE and leverages Terminal Velocity Matching (TVM) to enable enhancement with a single function evaluation. Matched comparisons with alternative one-step objectives support TVM as an effective design choice, and, to the best of our knowledge, this is its first adaptation to image restoration and specifically to LLIE. Extensive experiments on challenging real-world benchmarks demonstrate that GLOW-FM achieves competitive image quality and state-of-the-art cross-dataset generalization while requiring only a single function evaluation and 34 GFLOPs for the small variant. These findings highlight the potential of GLOW-FM to bring generative LLIE closer to practical deployment through single-step inference and compact latent modeling. Code will be made publicly available upon publication.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GLOW- FM: 高效的 Generative 低光图像增强, 采用单步慢流匹配
articles.content_zh: 低光图像增强(LLIE)旨在从严重退化的观测中恢复暴露良好和感知忠实的图像. 最近的基于扩散的基因方法通过利用强大的图像前身,实现了强烈的感知质量,但其迭代采样需要大量的计算成本,限制了实际部署. 尽管近期在遗传性有限责任公司方面提高了效率,但通过单一职能评价和低总体计算而提高质量仍然是挑战,特别是在不同的现实世界低光条件下。 我们引入了GLOW-FM,这是高效基因LIE的一步潜流匹配框架. GLOW-FM在冷冻的Tiny-VAE的潜在空间中进行有条件的运输,并利用终端高速匹配(TVM),从而能够通过单一功能评价进行增强。 与其它单步目标相匹配的比较支持TVM作为一种有效的设计选择,并且,就我们所知,这是它首次对图像修复,特别是LIE的适应. 对具有挑战性的现实世界基准的广泛实验表明,GLOW-FM实现了具有竞争力的图像质量和最先进的跨数据集通用,同时只需要对小变体进行单一功能评价和34个GFLOP. 这些结论突出了GLOW-FM的潜力,即通过单步推论和紧凑的潜在模型,使基因LIE更接近实际应用。 守则公布后将公布。

articles.title: Moving Regions, Not Moving Objects: Segmenting What Actually Moves under Camera Motion
articles.content: Moving object segmentation is conventionally formulated at the sequence and object level, marking an entire instance as moving once it moves anywhere in a video. Recent instantaneous formulations distinguish moving from stationary intervals, but still generate masks at the object level through frozen segmentation foundation models. Because the mask is derived from an instance-level proposal, motion is typically attributed to the entire instance rather than localized to the regions that actually move. Moreover, such instance-level predictions can produce masks even when no part of the instance is actually moving, revealing a more fundamental issue: motion is not an intrinsic property of an instance; it can only be determined by comparing at least two frames. Building on this premise, we introduce MoRSe, which jointly interprets two frames to predict a moving-region mask, distinguishing actual scene motion from apparent motion induced by the camera. A single RGB encoder replaces multi-stage foundation stacks, so no optical flow, point tracks, or separate mask generator is needed at inference. We release MoRSe-5K, a benchmark of 42 sequences with Static, Dynamic-Static, and Dynamic settings designed to evaluate the model's ability to distinguish and localize moving and stationary regions under different camera and scene motion conditions. MoRSe outperforms both specialized moving object segmentation methods and dense 4D reconstruction methods with motion-thresholded predictions, while producing the fewest false positives on sequences where nothing moves.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 移动区域, 不移动对象: 分割相机运动下实际移动的内容
articles.content_zh: 移动物体分解通常在序列和物体级别上进行,在视频中移动到任何地方后标记整个实例为移动. 最近的瞬间配体区别于静止间隔,但仍通过冷冻分块基模型在物体级别产生口罩. 由于面具来源于一个实例级提案,运动通常归结于整个实例,而不是本地化到实际移动的区域. 此外,这种实例层面的预测即使没有部分实例实际在移动,也能产生遮罩,揭示出一个更根本性的问题:运动不是实例的内在属性;只能通过比较至少两个框架来确定. 基于这个前提,我们引入了MORSe,它联合解释两个帧来预测一个移动区域面具,区分实际场景运动和镜头诱导的表面运动. 单一的RGB编码器取代多级基础堆栈,因此在推论中不需要光学流,点轨,或单独的面具生成器. 我们发布了MoRSe-5K,这是42个序列的基准,带有静态,动态-静态,动态设置,旨在评价模型在不同相机和场景运动条件下区分移动和静态区域的能力和本地化. MoRSe在运动阻断的预测下,既超越了专门的移动物体分解方法,也超越了密集的4D重建方法,同时在无动于衷的序列上产生最少的假阳性.

articles.title: A Visual Grounding Benchmark for Retinal OCT with Multimodal Large Language Models
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can answer clinical questions about medical images, but trustworthy use requires visual grounding: models should localize the pathology they report rather than rely on spurious shortcuts. Whether MLLMs can visually ground clinical findings in retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT), the most widely used imaging modality in ophthalmology, remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce RetinaGroundBench, the first benchmark for biomarker visual grounding in retinal OCT. It comprises 815 B-scans exhaustively annotated by ophthalmologists with 4,537 bounding boxes covering 13 biomarkers across 8 diseases. Because MLLMs often fragment a single lesion into multiple partial predictions, we propose AggIoU, a metric that evaluates whether the union of overlapping predicted boxes covers the annotated region. Across 27 open-source MLLMs (0.8-38B parameters), we find that visual grounding remains largely unsolved: the best general-purpose model achieves a macro F1 of just 23.7%, with consistently low recall, despite reaching up to 73% balanced accuracy on biomarker presence questions. To narrow this gap, we developed RetGrounder, an MLLM fine-tuned using an OCT-specific strategy integrating grounding and textual information. Despite its relatively small size (8B), RetGrounder improves grounding F1 to 33.9%, a 43% relative improvement. Our benchmark provides a reference point for measuring progress in the field of OCT diagnosis with MLLMs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 具有多种大型语文模式的视网膜OCT的视底基准
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)可以回答关于医疗影像的临床问题,但值得信赖的用途需要视觉地面:模型应该将所报道的病理学本地化,而不是依赖虚假的捷径. 在视网膜光学一致性成像学(OCT)中,MLLMS能否在视网膜光学一致性成像学(OCT)中观测到地面临床发现,这是眼科中最广泛使用的成像方式,但基本上仍未加以探索. 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了RetinaGround Bench,这是视网膜OCT中生物标记器视觉地面的第一个基准. 它由815个B-扫描仪组成,由眼科医生详细注释,有4 537个边框,覆盖8种疾病的13个生物标记。 由于MLLMs经常将单个损伤片断成多个部分预测,我们提出AggIoU,这个衡量标准用来评价重叠预测框的结合是否覆盖了注解区域. 在27个开源的MLLMs(0.8-38B参数)中,我们发现视觉地面基本上仍未解决:最好的通用模型只实现了23.7%的宏F1,但回溯率一直很低,尽管在生物标志存在问题上达到了高达73%的平衡精确度。 为了缩小这一差距,我们开发了RetGauer,这是一种利用OCT特定战略进行微调的MLLM,将地面信息和文字信息结合起来。 尽管面积相对较小(8B),但RetGamber改进了F1至33.9%的地基,相对改善43%. 我们的基准为衡量OCT诊断领域用MLLMs进行的进展提供了一个参考点。

articles.title: Inside-JEPA: From Prediction to Relational Grounding in Latent World Models
articles.content: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn world models in latent space, enabling efficient planning but leaving their states opaque. We introduce Inside-JEPA, which places relational channels for ordered entity pairs inside the JEPA latent state and shows that an inverse-dynamics loss can ground these channels without relation labels when its head reads them, either alone or as part of the full state. On Something-Something V2, latent prediction alone performs no better than a random relation head, while inverse-dynamics supervision that recovers actions from channel changes improves relational AUROC by .065-.103 across ten settings with annotated boxes, by .081 on RH20T robot episodes with held-out tasks, and by .050-.061 across five relations using off-the-shelf detection and tracking. An inverse head on entity latents decodes actions more accurately but barely improves relational grounding; shuffled labels, two label-free objectives, and action labels on only 5% of the pairs also fail to ground the channels. Given an action, predicted relational changes approach the quality of observed future relations (AUROC .599 vs .621). For one-step relational goals, a supervised readout of the 16 channels ranks the correct action among the top five of 65 in 43% of cases, compared with 24% for prediction-only latents and 17% for a frequency prior.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 内部-JEPA:从预测到关系定位于后期世界模式
articles.content_zh: 联合组合的预测性结构(JEPAs)在潜在的空间中学习世界模型,从而能够进行有效的规划,但使其状态不透明。 我们引入了内部-JEPA, 将订购的实体对在JEPA潜伏状态内的关系渠道, 并显示,当其头部单独或作为完整状态的一部分读取时, 反向动力学损失可以打碎这些通道而无关系标签。 在Something-Something V2上,仅潜伏的预测并不比随机关系头更好,而从通道变化中恢复动作的反动力学监督则通过下列方式改进了关系AUROC:在附加说明的10个设置中,0.65-103;在RH20T机器人事件上,0.81;在使用现成检测和跟踪的5个关系上,0.50-061。 实体潜伏物的反向头可以更准确地解码动作,但几乎无法改善关系定位;洗牌标签,两个无标签目标,只有5%的对子上的动作标签也未能打下通道. 鉴于一项行动,预测的关系变化将接近所观察到的未来关系的质量(AUROC 599 vs.621)。 就一步步的关系目标而言,16个渠道的监督读取将正确行动排在65个案例的前5位,占43%,而仅预测潜伏的占24%,先前频率的占17%。

articles.title: RaSFNet: Ray-aligned and Scan-aware Fusion Network for LiDAR Semantic Segmentation
articles.content: LiDAR point cloud semantic segmentation is a fundamental component of 3D perception for autonomous driving and robotics. Projection-based methods map 3D point clouds into 2D representations for feature extraction using 2D networks. However, aggregating multiple points during projection can obscure geometric differences within each frustum, while local feature extraction limits the modeling of spatial relationships across scanning regions. Moreover, proximity in the projected representation does not necessarily imply proximity in 3D space, and interactions between point and projected features may mix features from different ranges, reducing semantic discriminability. To address these challenges, we propose the Ray-aligned and Scan-aware Fusion Network (RaSFNet), which incorporates point cloud geometry and LiDAR scanning characteristics into projection-based semantic segmentation. Specifically, the Ray-Aligned Geometric Distribution Encoding (RAGDE) module characterizes point distributions within each frustum using a ray-aligned coordinate system. To model spatial context, a Scan-Topology-Aware Mamba (STAM) block organizes frustum features according to the LiDAR azimuth sampling pattern and captures long-range dependencies across scanning regions. In addition, a Range-Constrained Point-Frustum Fusion (RCPFF) mechanism uses shared range information to guide feature exchange between point and frustum representations while maintaining spatial correspondence. RaSFNet achieves mIoU scores of 70.2% and 77.7% on the SemanticKITTI and nuScenes validation sets, respectively, indicating competitive segmentation performance compared with the evaluated methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RASFNet:LiDAR语义分裂的射线对接和扫描视融合网络
articles.content_zh: LiDAR点云语分区是自主驱动和机器人的3D感知的一个基本组成部分. 基于投影的方法将3D点云映射为2D表示,用于利用2D网络提取特征. 然而,在投影过程中汇总多个点会模糊每个节点内的几何差异,而局部特征提取则限制了跨扫描区域的空间关系的模型化. 此外,预测表达方式的接近并不一定意味着3D空间的接近,点与预测特征之间的相互作用可能混合不同范围的特征,从而减少语义上的区别性. 为了应付这些挑战,我们提议建立雷线相通和扫描感应网络(RSFNet),将点云几何和LiDAR扫描特性纳入投影语义分解中。 具体来说,Ray-accessed几何分布编码(RAGDE)模块使用射线耦合坐标系统来描述每个节内点分布. 为了模拟空间背景,一个Scan-Topology-Aware Mamba(STAM)块按照LiDAR方位角取样模式组织frustum特征,并捕捉跨扫描区域的远程依赖性. 此外,Range-Construction Point-Frustum Fusion(RCPFF)机制使用共享范围信息指导点与节点表示之间的特征交换,同时保持空间对应. RaSFNet在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes验证集上分别取得了70.2%和77.7%的mIoU分数,表明与被评价方法相比,有竞争力的分区性能.

articles.title: Memory before Goal: Role of Pre-History Memory for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
articles.content: Humanoid loco-manipulation in dynamic scenes is non-Markovian: cues vanish as objects change or are hidden, or leave the view as the robot turns and walks, yet whole-body vision-language-action (VLA) policies see only the present. We present WholeBodyMem, an object-guided perceptual memory that keeps the pre-history of object events seen before the robot acts on its goal. SAM3 tracks the task objects, and their events causally select key frames within an adaptive budget, which the action expert reads by cross-attention together with object tokens encoding appearance, geometry and time. We also contribute HuMeGo, a humanoid memory benchmark with six simulated and six real-world Unitree G1 tasks. Keeping the right frames rather than more frames, WholeBodyMem surpasses memoryless and uniform-memory baselines, raising its base policy's success from 29.1% to 72.6% in simulation and from 36.7% to 88.3% on the real robot, while also improving the standard SIMPLE tasks (70.2% to 86.9%).
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 之前的内存 目标:人类历史前记忆的作用
articles.content_zh: 在动态场景中人机loco-management是非马尔科维语:提示随着物体的改变或隐藏而消失,或者随着机器人的转动和行走而离开视图,然而全身视觉语言动作(VLA)政策只看到现在. 我们呈现的是"全博迪Mem",一种以物体为导线的感知记忆,它保持了机器人在行动达到目标之前所看到的物体事件的史前记忆. SAM3跟踪任务对象,它们的事件在适应性预算范围内因果地选择了关键框架,动作专家通过交叉意念与对象符号编码外观,几何和时间一起阅读. 我们还贡献了HuMeGo,这是一个人文记忆基准,它有六个模拟和六个现实世界Unitree G1任务. 保持正确的帧而不是更多的帧,WatherBodyMem超越了无记忆和统一的模组基线,使其基础政策在模拟中的成功率从29.1%提高到72.6%,在真机器人上的成功率从36.7%提高到88.3%,同时也改进了标准SIMPLE任务(70.2%提高到86.9%).

articles.title: HiSTEVE 1.0: Harnessing Human-Interface VLA Agents for Open-World Games
articles.content: Building virtual embodied agents that operate in open-ended games like human players is a long-standing goal requiring both long-horizon autonomy and reliable native-interface control. As a procedurally generated open world, Minecraft provides a natural testbed for studying the integration of these capabilities. Existing agents typically provide either native visuomotor control without long-horizon autonomy or high-level planning executed through environment APIs or predefined skills. To bridge this gap, we propose HiSTEVE, a hierarchical VLA agent with a capability-aware agent harness. At the orchestration level, we equip the harness with structured memory for tracking progress and a VLM planner for selecting subtasks within the VLA's capabilities. To reliably determine subtask completion, we further introduce a policy-coupled task completion state detector that conditions on VLA policy context to signal candidate completion. At the control level, a single VLA executes all subtasks with vision-only perception and native keyboard-and-mouse actions. To mitigate interference between heterogeneous GUI and non-GUI interactions, we introduce regime-specific RMSNorm branches and separate mouse-movement token embeddings. We also train the VLA through world knowledge injection, imitation learning, and reinforcement learning with environment feedback to improve reliability and recovery. HiSTEVE achieves state-of-the-art atomic-task performance, scoring 85.0% on MineStudio Bench and a 37.4% average success rate on OpenHA, while also completing long-horizon tasks such as crafting an iron pickaxe from scratch like human players.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 飞起来 1.0:为开放世界运动会利用人与人界面VLA代理
articles.content_zh: 构建像人类玩家一样在开放式游戏中运行的虚拟内涵代理是一个长期的目标,既需要长视野自主,也需要可靠的本土界面控制. 作为一个在程序上产生的开放世界,Minecraft为研究这些能力的整合提供了天然的试验床. 现有代理人通常要么提供本地维乌莫托尔控制,而不具有长远的自主性,要么通过环境API或预先界定的技能执行高级规划。 为了弥补这一差距,我们提议HiSTEVE,一种具有能力意识的VLA代理。 在管弦乐方面,我们配备了跟踪进展的结构化内存和一个VLM计划员,以便在VLA能力范围内选择子任务. 为了可靠地确定次级任务的完成情况,我们进一步采用了一种与政策相关的任务完成状态探测器,该探测器对志愿军的政策背景提出了条件,以表明候选人的完成情况。 在控制层面,一个单一的VLA执行所有子任务,只有视觉感知和本土键盘-和-mouse动作. 为了减少不同GUI与非GUI相互作用之间的干扰,我们引入了针对制度的 RMSNorm 分支和单独的鼠标移动符号嵌入. 我们还通过世界知识注入、仿真学习、强化学习以及环境反馈来培训VLA,以提高可靠性和恢复性。 HiSTEVE实现了最先进的原子任务性能,在MineStudio座椅上得分85.0%,在OpenHA上的平均成功率达到37.4%,同时也完成了长视距任务,如像人类玩家一样从头到尾地巧妙地制作一把铁 pick.

articles.title: Beyond Watching and Searching: Benchmarking Agents for Video-centered Deep Research Reports
articles.content: Deep research agents synthesize open-web evidence into long reports, but current benchmarks do not evaluate research centered on a source video. We introduce Video-Centered Deep Research Report Generation. Given a video and user request, an agent identifies research questions, retrieves external multimodal evidence, and produces an interactive report linked to relevant video moments. This task has direct practical value because it helps users locate relevant moments, verify claims, reproduce demonstrated procedures, and make informed decisions from video content. We present a skill-based workflow and OmniDR-Bench for this task. For evaluation, we propose Omni Atomic Rubric Trees (Omni-ARTs). Each tree contains three dimensions, 23 shared directions, and task-specific atomic binary criteria. The directions test audiovisual grounding, multimodal evidence use, and interactive presentation. Audited Rubric Construction (ARC) builds these trees through independent evidence collection, automated checks, behavioral calibration, and iterative human review. OmniDR-Bench contains 50 Chinese and English tasks across 19 realworld subcategories. It includes 6,414 criteria. Across 18 agent configurations, the best system scores 63.3 out of 100. Current agents still need broader content coverage, stronger causal and logical analysis across modalities, and more accurate citation support. We further analyze models, harnesses, skill configurations, video categories, and research trajectories. The code and data are released at https://github.com/marinero4972/OmniDR-Bench.

articles.title_zh: Beyond Watching and Searching: 以视频为核心的深入研究报告的基准代理
articles.content_zh: 深层研究代理人将开放式网络证据合成长篇报告,但目前的基准并不评价以源视频为中心的研究. 我们介绍以视频为中心的深入研究报告生成。 根据视频和用户请求,一名代理人确定研究问题,检索外部多式联运证据,并制作与相关视频时刻相关的互动报告。 这项任务具有直接的实际价值,因为它有助于用户找到相关时刻,核实索偿要求,复制已显示的程序,并从视频内容作出知情的决定。 我们为这项任务提出了基于技能的工作流程和OmniDR-Bench。 为了评价,我们提议Omni原子Rubric树(Omni-ARTs). 每棵树包含三个维度,23个共同方向,以及任务特定的原子二进制标准. 方向检验视听定位、多式联运证据的使用和互动介绍。 经审计的Rubric Construction(ARC)通过独立收集证据,自动检查,行为校准,以及迭代的人类审查来建造这些树. OmniDR-Bench包含50项中英文任务,跨越19个现实世界亚类. 其中包括6 414项标准。 跨18个代理配置,最佳系统得分63.3分100分. 目前的代理人仍然需要更广泛的内容覆盖面,更强有力的因果和跨模式的逻辑分析,以及更准确的引用支持. 我们进一步分析模型、绳索、技能配置、视频类别和研究轨迹。 该代码和数据公布于https://github.com/marinero4972/OmniDR-Bench.

articles.title: WildFakeToolBench: Benchmarking AI-Generated Image Detectors with Web-Sourced Image Processing
articles.content: As AI generated images are getting popular these days, discussions on such generations are widely existed in current public forums, software repositories, and photography tutorials. Moreover, with the help of LLM-assisted code translation, malicious actors can adopt such information to evade detectors without specialized knowledge or local GPU execution of the resulting tools. To evaluate such risks, we introduce \textsc{WildFakeToolBench}, a benchmark suite of $156$ executable image-processing tools derived from $220$ public sources across $142$ domains. Each tool retains its source evidence and passes syntax, execution, and output-distortion checks without using feedback from the evaluated detectors. On $105$ generated images from five generators, we evaluate six state-of-the-art detectors with images processed by the tools in our collected bench to assess their effectiveness against such in-the-wild risks. The strongest individual tools achieve attack success rates of $25.25\%$--$100\%$ across detectors, exceeding the strongest of six selected image-processing baselines for each detector. Evaluating subsets of an eight-tool pool yields worst-case coverage above $80\%$ for every detector. Effectiveness is sparse and detector-specific: high coverage across candidates does not imply reliable one-shot evasion. These findings not only highlight the potential of such web-sourced risks, but also show the potential on establishing AI-image detector robustness evaluation framework based on those in-the-wild information.

articles.title_zh: 野生假工具 座椅:将AI-Generated图像探测器与网络源图像处理的基准化
articles.content_zh: 由于AI生成的图像如今越来越受欢迎,关于这些世代的讨论在目前的公共论坛,软件寄存器和摄影教程中广泛存在. 此外,在LLM辅助代码翻译的帮助下,恶意行为者可以采用此类信息来逃避探测器,而无需具备专业知识或对由此产生的工具执行当地GPU. 为了评估这些风险,我们采用了\textsc{WildFakeTool Bench},这是一套由22万美元公共来源衍生而来、跨越142美元领域的156美元可执行图像处理工具。 每个工具保留其源证据,并通过语法,执行和输出扭曲检查,而不使用被评价的探测器的反馈. 用从五台发电机生成的105美元图像,我们用我们收集的工具处理的图像,对六台最新探测器进行评估,以评估其有效性,防范这种巨大的风险。 最强的单个工具对探测器的攻击成功率为25.25美元-100美元,超过了每个探测器六个选定的图像处理基线中最强的。 评估一个8个工具池的子集,每台探测器的覆盖率最差,超过80美元。 效力很少,而且有探测器的特点:候选人的高度覆盖率并不意味着可靠的一弹而逃。 这些调查结果不仅突出了这种网络来源风险的潜力,而且表明有可能根据这些复杂信息建立AI-图像探测器强健性评价框架。

articles.title: Navigating human-robot interaction challenges in private and residential aged care homes
articles.content: This chapter explores how robotic systems and ambient intelligence can enhance care for older adults in residential aged care (RAC) homes and private homes. Although these settings differ, we frame both as extreme and challenging environments for human-robot interaction (HRI), characterised by cluttered and dynamic layouts, diverse resident needs, and limited on-site technical support. We review embodied and non-embodied systems that assist with daily living, safety monitoring, and social engagement, highlighting hybrid deployments where robots complement fixed and wearable sensors. To ensure these technologies are usable and effective, design considerations consider the cognitive, physical, and social needs of older adults. Interaction design prioritises accessibility for older adults with low digital literacy, using robust but simple voice interfaces, small sets of non-verbal cues, accessible screen-based companions, and safe object handovers. Privacy, trust, and acceptability are addressed via practical strategies such as on-device inference, data minimisation, visible consent controls, and transparent data handling aligned with emerging artificial intelligence (AI) and privacy regulation. Evaluation emphasises real-world metrics including false alarms per day, time to recover from faults, staff workload, and long-term system reliability. We close by outlining open research challenges and future directions for scalable, regulation-ready deployments that support aging with dignity, safety, and independence.

articles.title_zh: 在私人和住宅式老年护理院指导人与机器人的互动挑战
articles.content_zh: 本章探讨了机器人系统和环境智能如何加强养老院和私人院对老年人的护理。 虽然这些环境不同,但我们将人与机器人互动作为极端和具有挑战性的环境,其特点是布局复杂和动态,居民需求多样,现场技术支持有限。 我们审查协助日常生活、安全监测和社会参与的成形和非健全的系统,强调机器人补充固定和可穿戴传感器的混合部署。 为了确保这些技术能够使用和有效,设计方面的考虑考虑到老年人的认知、身体和社会需要。 互动设计优先为数字文化水平低的老年人提供无障碍环境,使用强健但简单的语音界面,小套非语言提示,无障碍屏幕伴奏,安全对象交接. 隐私、信任和可接受性是通过实用战略加以解决的,例如根据新出现的人工智能和隐私条例进行推断、尽量减少数据、明显的同意控制以及透明的数据处理。 评价强调现实世界的衡量标准,包括每天的虚假警报、从过失中恢复的时间、工作人员的工作量和长期系统的可靠性。 最后,我们概述了开放的研究挑战和未来方向,以便进行可扩展的、准备就绪的部署,支持有尊严、安全和独立的老龄化。

articles.title: RankAlign: Vision-Language Representation Alignment via Rank Transformation
articles.content: While the Platonic Representation Hypothesis posits that vision and language models converge toward compatible latent geometries, recovering class-level correspondences between unpaired modalities without cross-modal supervision remains challenging. Existing relational matching methods compare within-modality similarity kernels directly, although the same semantic structure may be represented through different numerical parameterizations across modalities. We propose RankAlign, a rank-based normalization strategy for class-level unpaired vision-language matching. RankAlign transforms each within-modality similarity kernel into an ordinal relational representation before permutation matching, while leaving the correspondence space and matching solver unchanged. The resulting representation is invariant to strictly increasing reparameterizations of similarity values while preserving the ordinal structure used for matching. We provide exact-recovery and stability guarantees that characterize correspondence recovery under both exact and partial ordinal agreement. Experiments across diverse frozen vision and language encoders and multiple datasets demonstrate improved and more stable class-level correspondence recovery, including under label corruption and domain shift.

articles.title_zh: RankAlign: 愿景-语言代表对齐 军衔转换
articles.content_zh: 虽然柏拉图式代表假说认为,远景和语言模型趋同到兼容的潜在几何面体,但在没有跨模式监督的情况下,恢复不同模式之间的班级对应关系仍然具有挑战性。 现有的关系匹配方法直接比较模式内相似性内核,尽管相同的语义结构可以通过不同模式的不同数字参数化来表示. 我们建议RankAlign, 一个基于等级的常态战略, 班级级的无奖视觉语言匹配。 RankAlign将每种模式内相似性内核在通量匹配前转换为正数关系表示,同时保留对应空间和匹配解析器不变. 由此产生的表示方式在保持用于匹配的正线结构的同时,无法严格增加类似值的重新参数化。 我们提供确切的回收和稳定保障,这是根据确切的和部分的正常协议收回信件的特点。 跨越多种冷冻视觉和语言编码器以及多个数据集的实验显示,包括标签腐败和域位转移下,阶级级通信恢复得到改进和更稳定.

articles.title: GM-GReFEL: Geometry-Guided Spatiotemporal State-Space Learning for Robust Dynamic Facial Expression Recognition
articles.content: Recognizing facial expressions in unconstrained video suffers from two coupled problems: self-attention grows quadratically in cost with clip length, and crowdsourced labels are noisy. We present GM-GReFEL, a spatiotemporal state-space network with a geometry-aware decision stage. Its Modulated GroupMamba backbone replaces a spatiotemporal Vision Transformer. Six channel groups are scanned separately, four over the frame plane and two over time, so the cost grows linearly with sequence length ($\mathcal{O}(N)$); after each layer, a Channel Affinity Modulation gate mixes the groups again. On top of the backbone, a GReFEL reliability module turns the normalized entropy of each prediction into a mixing weight between the classifier output and a vote from trainable geometric anchors, so that facial geometry counts for more when the network is unsure. The model is initialized by static-to-dynamic weight transfer and trained with a Triple Loss. In five-fold cross-validation, the best fold scores 66.57\%/76.46\% UAR/WAR on DFEW, 0.3 points or less below the strongest compared method, and 45.66\%/62.27\% on MAFW, ahead of all compared methods; on FERV39k the mean over five splits, 42.30\%/52.66\%, is competitive. The five-fold means are 64.07\%/74.54\% on DFEW, on par with recent large pre-trained models, and 38.90\%/54.37\% on MAFW, below the best of them. A paired $t$-test on DFEW indicates a modest benefit of temporal modeling (+1.61 UAR points, one-sided $p=0.031$). Attention stays on plausible facial regions, and latency is close to a ViT-B/16 baseline (47.4 vs.\ 46.8 ms per clip). Code: https://github.com/ardiytama/GroupMamba-DFER.

articles.title_zh: GM-GREFEL: 几何 -- -- 指导的Spatiotemporal 国家 -- -- 空间学习,用于强力动态表征识别
articles.content_zh: 在不受限制的视频中识别面部表情有两种连带问题:自觉性以剪辑长度以四倍的成本增长,以及众包标签的噪音. 我们介绍GM-GREFEL,这是一个具有几何意识决策阶段的瞬间状态-空间网络。 其Modulated GroupMamba骨干取代了spatiopal Vision变形器. 6个频道组单独扫描,4个在帧平面上扫描,2个在时间上扫描,因此成本随序列长度(\mathcal{O}(N)$)而呈线性增长;每层之后,一个频道Afffinity Modulating门再次混合各组. 在骨干之上,一个GREFEL可靠性模块将每个预测的常态化的演化演化成分类器输出和可训练几何锚的投票之间的混合重量,这样,当网络不确定时面部几何就算数更多. 该模型通过静态到动力的重量转移进行初始化,并经过三重损失的训练. 在五倍的交叉验证中,最佳折叠分数在DFEW上为66.57=76.46=UAR/WAR,比最强的比法低0.3分或更低;在MAFW上为45.66=62.27=,领先于所有比较方法;在FERV39k上,平均分数超过5分,42.30=52.66===,具有竞争力. 这五重手段是:在DFEW上是64.07+74.54++,与最近培训过的大型模型相同;在MAFW上是38.90+54.37+,低于其中最好的。 对DFEW进行一对美元测试表明,时间建模的效益不大(+1.61 UAR点,单侧美元=0.031美元)。 注意力集中在貌似合理的面部区域,延迟接近Vit-B/16基线(每片47.4对46.8毫秒). 代码:https://github.com/ardiytama/GroupMamba-DFER. 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-03-02.

articles.title: Pos4CHD: A Positive-Free Mask-Guided Counterfactual Synthesis Framework for Fetal Congenital Heart Defect Analysis
articles.content: The scarcity of positive cases remains a major bottleneck in developing automated diagnostic systems for fetal Congenital Heart Defects~(CHDs), particularly for rare subtypes. Although normal cases are accessible with effort, positive cases are hard to collect due to low incidence rates and privacy concerns, causing severe class imbalance or absence of positive training samples. Existing works resort to synthesizing positives with conditional generative models, but they are task-specific and require positive training samples, hindering application for fetal CHDs. To this end, we propose a positive-free mask-guided counterfactual generation framework for fetal echocardiography, namely Pos4CHD, which enables realistic, high-quality synthesis of pseudo-positive samples from semantic masks, with only normal samples at hand. Technically, we first develop FE-Gen, a mask-guided generative model tailored for fetal heart ultrasound synthesis that mitigates histogram drift and enhances image-mask spatial alignment. Building on FE-Gen, Pos4CHD employs a mask-to-image generation paradigm for CHD synthesis. It first manipulates semantic masks to simulate fetal-heart structural anomalies and then renders anatomically consistent images. Extensive experiments on in-house datasets, together with expert evaluations, demonstrate the visual fidelity~($-12.97$ FID) and anatomical consistency~($+3.96\%$ DSC) of synthesized images. Further validations across diverse real-world CHD diagnosis tasks exhibit promising results and consistent increments, including zero-shot classification~(achieving $93.25\%$ ACC on EbA and $72.92\%$ ACC on TAPVC), lesion detection~($+6.95\%$ mAP50 on VSD), and anatomy segmentation~($+10.49\%$ DSC on fetal heart) compared with baselines. Codes and models are publicly available on \href{https://github.com/DREAMXFAR/Pos4CHD}{GitHub}.

articles.title_zh: Pos4CHD: 胎儿先天性心脏缺陷分析的正向无遮罩引导反事实合成框架
articles.content_zh: 阳性病例的稀缺仍然是开发胎儿先天性心脏缺陷(CHD)的自动诊断系统的一个主要瓶颈,对于罕见的亚型而言尤其如此。 虽然可以努力找到正常病例,但由于发生率低和隐私问题,很难收集到阳性病例,造成严重的班级不平衡或缺乏阳性培训样本。 现有作品采用有条件的基因模型合成阳性,但都是任务特异性的,需要阳性训练样本,阻碍了胎儿的CHD的应用. 为此,我们提出了胎儿回声心电图的无阳性口罩制导反事实生成框架,即Pos4CHD,它能够对来自语义口罩的伪阳性样本进行现实,高质量的合成,只有普通的样本在手. 从技术上讲,我们首先开发了FE-Gen,这是一种为胎儿心脏超声合成量身定制的蒙面导基因模型,可以缓解直方图漂移,增强图像-面具空间对齐. 在FE-Gen的基础上,Pos4CHD采用了CHD合成的面具到图像生成范式. 它首先操纵语义面具来模拟胎儿-心脏结构异常,然后使解剖学上一致的图像. 对内部数据集的广泛实验,连同专家评价,证明了合成图像的视觉可靠性~(12.97美元FID)和解剖一致性~(+3.96美元DSC). 对各种现实世界的CDD诊断任务的进一步验证显示出有希望的结果和连续不断的增量,包括零镜头分类(EbA的ACC为93.25美元,TAPVC的ACC为72.92美元),损伤检测~(VSD的+6.95\%mAP50美元)以及解剖学分解~(胎儿心脏的+10.49\%DSC)与基线比较。 代码和模型在\href{上公开 https://github.com/DREAMXFAR/Pos4CHD+GitHub} (中文(简体) ).

articles.title: WildDepth-v2: A Synchronized RGB--LiDAR--Radar Dataset and Benchmark for Metric Depth, Motion, and Tracking of Wildlife
articles.content: Measuring animal distance and motion in metric units underpins abundance estimation, morphometrics, and movement ecology, yet monocular video lacks metric scale and wildlife datasets lack metric ground truth. We present WildDepth 2, extending the synchronized RGB-LiDAR WildDepth dataset in three directions. (i) Imaging radar: 37 RGB-LiDAR-4D-radar sequences (19,716 frames) with per-point Doppler velocity and a measured error budget, to our knowledge the first imaging-radar wildlife recordings. (ii) Benchmarking: a frozen, checksummed hidden test set for RGB-only distance estimation and RGB+sparse-LiDAR depth completion, evaluated separately on animal and background pixels. (iii) Motion and tracking: metric 3D trajectories obtained by lifting 2D tracks using LiDAR, radar, or monocular depth. Across 48,723 animal frames, object-level radar calibration improves monocular depth over scene-level LiDAR calibration without requiring LiDAR at inference (AbsRel 0.120 vs. 0.198), although animal-level LiDAR remains more accurate (0.052). Across 431 tracks, once-per-track radar scaling reduces 3D position error four-fold (2.20 to 0.58 m) and distance-sampling detection-function bias from -13% to -2%, matching once-per-track LiDAR calibration. Transferring radar Doppler onto LiDAR produces motion masks 3.7 times denser than radar alone at 72% precision, reduces moving-animal LiDAR accumulation error by 37%, and estimates radial speed (r = 0.60), albeit with approximately 50% underestimation.

articles.title_zh: Wild Depth-v2:同步RGB-LiDAR-Radar数据集和计量深度、运动和野生动物跟踪基准
articles.content_zh: 测量动物的距离和运动(以度量单位计)是丰度估计、测尸和运动生态的基础,但单视视频缺乏度量尺度,野生动物数据集缺乏度量地面真理。 我们提出Wild Depth 2,将同步的RGB-LiDAR Wild Depth数据集向三个方向扩展. (一)成像雷达:37个RGB-LiDAR-4D-雷达序列(19,716帧),每点多普勒速度和测量误差预算,据我们所知,这是第一次成像雷达野生动物录音。 (二)基准化:用于RGB唯一距离估计和RGB+sparse-LiDAR深度完成的冷冻,验收的隐藏测试集,分别对动物和背景像素进行评估. (三)运动和跟踪:通过使用LiDAR,雷达,或单体深度的2D轨道升空获得的度量三维轨距. 在48,723个动物框架上,物体级雷达校准比场景级LiDAR校准提高了单体深度,无需LiDAR推断(AbsRel 0.120 vs.0.198),不过动物级LiDAR仍然更准确(0.052). 穿越431个轨道,一次逐轨雷达缩放将3D位置误差减少4倍(2.20至0.58米),远距离采样检测功能偏差从-13%降至-2%,匹配一次逐轨LiDAR校准. 将雷达多普勒转移到LiDAR上,产生的运动罩密度比雷达高3.7倍,精度为72%,将移动动物的LiDAR积存误差减少37%,并估计射线速度(r=0.60),尽管低估了大约50%。

articles.title: Through a PRISM, Clearly: Step-Sequence Reasoning for Mistake Recognition in Procedural Videos
articles.content: Procedural mistake recognition requires identifying deviations from valid multi-step activities. We study post-completion recognition from videos with benchmark-provided step boundaries. We introduce PRISM (Procedural mistake Recognition via Interpretable Semantic Modeling), which grounds video segments in language and maps their descriptions to procedural states using a lightweight hidden Markov model trained on correct executions. Reference alignment and semantic checks identify errors in step content and order. To support evaluation across heterogeneous benchmarks, we map dataset-specific annotations to four edit-based error types: insertion, deletion, substitution, and transposition. Across three benchmarks, we compare gold and VLM-generated descriptions in raw, semantic-role, and action-object forms. Decoder controls show consistent gains from the trained local decoder over nearest-candidate matching, with additional, dataset-dependent benefits from sequence decoding. Semantic role labeling improves Any-F1 in all six matched grounded comparisons, although the gains vary across datasets and do not translate into uniform improvements under separate configuration selection. These results establish language grounding as an effective interface for explicit procedural mistake reasoning and characterize the contributions of representation and decoding.

articles.title_zh: 透过PISM, 很明显: 程序视频中错误识别的步序
articles.content_zh: 程序错误的确认要求查明偏离有效的多步骤活动的情况。 我们研究完成后识别 视频与基准提供的阶梯界限。 我们引入了PISM(通过可解释的语义模型识别程序错误),它用语言将视频部分作为依据,并使用经过正确处决培训的轻量级隐藏的Markov模型将其描述映射到程序状态。 参考对齐和语义检查识别步骤内容和顺序的错误. 为了支持跨不同基准的评价,我们将特定数据集的说明映射到四个基于编辑的错误类型:插入、删除、替换和转置。 在三个基准中,我们用原始、语义作用和动作对象形式比较黄金和VLM产生的描述。 解码器控制显示,从训练有素的本地解码器得到的一致收益大于最近的扫描匹配,还有序列解码带来的更多依赖数据集的好处. 语义角色标签在全部6个匹配的基底比较中改进了Any-F1,虽然收益因数据集而异,在不同的配置选择下并没有转化为统一的改进. 这些结果确立了语言基础,作为明确程序错误推理的有效界面,并说明了代表性和解码的贡献。

articles.title: Where Do Long Captions Fail? Position-Aware Diagnosis and Reinforcement Learning for Detailed Image Captioning
articles.content: Detailed image captioning is usually framed as an amount problem: a model should mention more visual facts while avoiding hallucination. However, autoregressive VLMs generate captions as ordered sequences, and later generations may be produced under weaker or noisier visual grounding. We therefore argue that long-form captioning should be studied not only by what facts are mentioned, but also by where they appear. We introduce a position-aware rubric representation that decomposes dense human references into atomic visual claims, verifies generated captions against those claims, and induces a quartile-wise composition of supported, hallucinated, and generic content. This lens reveals two qualitatively different failures in long captions: models tend to produce unsupported specificity in the middle, while the final portion often escapes into vague, non-evidential language rather than simply accumulating more hallucination. A same-reference human control does not exhibit these patterns; additional human audits examine the visual validity of the induced labels. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose PAGER (Position-Aware Grounded Evidence Reinforcement), a GRPO training objective with separate signals for supported fine-grained middle evidence, evidence-bearing tail continuation, claim coverage, and content-aware length control. The result is a closed loop: the same ordered claim representation identifies where long captions fail and supplies the position-specific reward needed to repair those failures. Experiments on detailed-caption benchmarks show that PAGER improves position-wise grounding and pairwise caption preference while preserving competitive global caption quality.
