articles.title_zh: 长篇小说在哪里失败? 为详细图像说明而进行的立场- 警觉诊断和加强学习
articles.content_zh: 详细的图像标题通常被设定为数量问题:一个模型应该提及更多的视觉事实,同时避免幻觉. 然而,自递式VLM作为顺序生成标题,后世可能在弱或噪声视觉地面下产生. 因此,我们主张,长式标题不仅应当根据提到的事实加以研究,而且应当根据其出现地点加以研究。 我们引入了一种能感知位置的标语,将密集的人类参考物分解为原子视觉权利主张,验证生成的针对这些权利主张的字幕,并诱导一种四分法构成,即支持的、幻觉的和通用的内容。 这个镜头揭示了长标题中两个质量不同的失败:模型往往在中间产生无支持的特异性,而最后部分往往会逃到模糊的,非显性的语言中,而不是简单地积累更多的幻觉. 同样参照的人类控制没有显示出这些模式;额外的人类审计检查了诱导标签的视觉有效性. 基于这种诊断,我们提议PAGER(Pasition-Awared Studies Information),即GPRO培训目标,其单独的信号用于支持的细纹中间证据、有证据的尾巴延续、索赔覆盖和内容意识长度控制。 结果形成了一个封闭的循环:同一份命令的索赔陈述指明了长标题失效的地方,并提供了修复这些失效所需的职位奖励。 关于详细标题基准的实验表明,PAGER在保持具有竞争力的全球标题质量的同时,改善了位置定位和双向标题偏好。

articles.title: DRAFT: Decoding and Reconstructing 3D Room Layouts from fMRI and Camera Trajectories
articles.content: While functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) decoders reconstruct images and 3D objects, recovering the metric geometry of rooms from a moving viewpoint remains an open challenge. We introduce, to our knowledge for the first time, the task of reconstructing 3D layouts of held-out scenes using only the known camera trajectories and the fMRI signals of participants watching indoor walkthroughs, without any visual frames. The task is hard because of the temporal mismatch between rapid visual changes and blurred fMRI signals. Our method, DRAFT (Decoding and Reconstructing 3D room lAyouts from fMRI and Trajectories), extracts a compact layout representation from the early visual cortex and fuses this neural code with the geometric free space derived from camera motion. To evaluate it, we propose layout r, the Pearson correlation between predicted and ray-cast log depths. On ten held-out scenes (20 participants), DRAFT reaches a layout r of 0.480, outperforming the camera path alone (0.446) and seven fMRI decoders (at most 0.429). DRAFT also works as a plug-in that improves all seven decoders without retraining, raising their layout r from 0.171-0.429 to 0.487-0.493. Brain activity and camera motion can thus recover the metric layout of unseen rooms, a first step toward reconstructing the 3D spaces people see.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 草案:从 fMRI 和相机轨迹解码和重构 3D 房间布局
articles.content_zh: 虽然功能磁共振成像(fMRI)解码器重建图像和3D物体,但从移动的角度恢复房间的几何特征仍然是一个公开的挑战。 我们第一次向我们介绍,我们的任务是重建被搁置的场景的3D布局,只使用已知的相机轨迹和参与者观看室内行走的fMRI信号,没有任何视觉框架. 由于快速视觉变化和模糊的fMRI信号之间的时间不匹配,任务很困难. 我们的方法,Draft(从fMRI和轨迹提取一个紧凑的布局表示,并用相机运动产生的几何自由空间来引导这个神经编码。 为了评价它,我们提出布局r, 皮尔逊关联 预测和射线广播的日志深度。 在10场被搁置的场景(20名与会者)中,Draft达到了0.480的布局r,单是镜头路径(0.446)和7个fMRI解码器(最多0.429)。 草案还起到插件的作用,在不进行再培训的情况下改进所有7个解码器,将其版式r从0.171-0.429提高到0.487-0.493. 因此,大脑活动和摄像头运动可以恢复看不见的房间的度量布局,这是重建人们看到的3D空间的第一步。

articles.title: I$^2$-KAN: Interpretable Intra- and Inter-Modal Multi-Pathway Representation Learning for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
articles.content: Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) aims to infer sentiment by integrating linguistic, acoustic, and visual information. However, many fusion methods integrate modality-specific representations and cross-modal interactions into joint representations, making it difficult to determine whether predictive utility arises from a modality itself or from its interactions with others. More fundamentally, a modality's standalone predictive utility may not faithfully reflect its interaction-conditioned predictive utility. To address this issue, we propose I$^2$-KAN, an interpretable multi-pathway framework that explicitly maintains intra-modal and pairwise inter-modal information in separate structural pathways. Each pathway is refined by a Task-Decoupled Linear-Gated Denoising Bottleneck (TDL-GDB) to learn compact and task-relevant representations, followed by structured Kolmogorov-Arnold Network fusion that retains explicit pathway associations and supports multi-level interpretation. Extensive experiments on CMU-MOSI, CMU-MOSEI, and CH-SIMS v2 demonstrate strong overall performance. Ablation and interpretability analyses consistently show across the three benchmarks that low standalone predictive utility does not necessarily imply low interaction-conditioned predictive utility: a modality that appears weak in isolation can remain informative through pairwise interactions. These findings highlight the interaction-dependent nature of multimodal utility and suggest that modality utility should be characterized from both standalone and interaction-conditioned perspectives.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: I$^2美元-KAN:可解释的多途径间和山区间多途径代表性学习,用于多式联运感知分析
articles.content_zh: 多式联运情绪分析旨在通过综合语言、声学和视觉信息推断情绪。 然而,许多聚变方法将特定模式的表示和跨模式的相互作用纳入联合表示,因此难以确定预测效用是来源于一种模式本身,还是来源于它与其它模式的互动。 更根本的是,一种模式的独立预测效用可能无法忠实地反映其具有相互作用条件的预测效用。 为了解决这一问题,我们提议采用2美元-KAN美元这一可解释的多路径框架,在不同的结构路径中明确保持模式内和双向模式间信息。 每一条路径都由一个任务解密的线性-Gated Denoising Bottleneck(TDL-GDB)加以完善,以学习紧凑和任务相关的表述,然后是结构化的Kolmogorov-Arnold网络组合,保留明确的路径协会并支持多层次的解释。 关于CMU-MOSI、CMU-MOSEI和CH-SIMS v2的广泛实验显示,总体性能强劲。 差异性和可解释性分析在三个基准中一致显示,低独立预测效用并不一定意味着低相互作用条件预测效用:一种在孤立状态下看来很弱的模式可以通过双向相互作用保持信息性。 这些结论突出了多式联运效用的相互作用依赖性,并建议从独立和相互作用条件的角度来描述模式效用。

articles.title: A General-Purpose Dual-Path Interaction Framework for Multi-View Medical Image Segmentation: Alleviating Data Volume Dependency in Small-Sample Regimes
articles.content: The performance of medical image segmentation depends on a large amount of annotated data, and most segmentation models experience a significant drop in performance in low-sample-size scenarios. Existing semi-supervised and weakly supervised methods rely on specific network architectures, while traditional multi-view-assisted segmentation methods require strictly paired samples, which limits their clinical applications. To address these issues, we propose DPIF, a general-purpose plug-and-play dual-path interaction framework compatible with arbitrary encoder-decoder segmentation networks, which leverages cross-view anatomical complementarity to reduce annotation reliance. DPIF first performs Sinkhorn optimal transport-based cross-view distribution alignment to establish global semantic correspondence without sample-level pairing. It then adopts conditional mutual information-guided feature decoupling to enable bidirectional knowledge transfer only within the shared semantic space, suppressing view-specific noise. Finally, persistent homology-based topological regularization encodes anatomical invariants as unsupervised priors to mitigate overfitting. Experiments were conducted using 24 baseline models on a private multicenter echocardiography dataset and two public datasets. The results show that DPIF-enhanced models outperform single-view baseline models when trained on comparable amounts of data. Notably, most dual-path variants trained on 40\% - 60\% of the data achieve performance comparable to that of single-view models trained on the full dataset. This demonstrates that DPIF provides a general-purpose and scalable solution for data-scarce multi-view medical image segmentation problems.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 多维医学影像分解的通用双帕相互作用框架:减轻小样本制度中的数据量依赖性
articles.content_zh: 医学影像分解的性能取决于大量附加说明的数据,大多数分解模型在低样本大小的假想中,性能显著下降. 现有的半监督制和弱监督制的方法依赖于特定的网络架构,而传统的多景辅助分化方法则需要严格的配对样本,这限制了它们的临床应用. 为了解决这些问题,我们提议DPIF,一个通用的插件和游戏双路径交互框架,兼容任意的编码器-解码器分割网络,它利用跨视图解剖互补来减少对注释的依赖. DPIF首先进行Sinkhorn最优的基于传输的交叉视图分布对齐,在不进行样本级对齐的情况下建立全球语义对应. 然后采用有条件的相互信息引导特征脱钩,使双向知识只在共享语义空间内进行转移,抑制特定视图噪声. 最后,持续的基于同义的地形规范化将解剖学的不变量编码为无监督的前科,以减轻过度适应. 利用24个基准模型对一个私人多中心回声心学数据集和两个公共数据集进行了实验。 结果显示,DPIF增强模型在接受可比数据量培训时,优于单景基线模型. 值得注意的是,接受过40++-60+++数据培训的大多数双向变体的性能与接受过完整数据集培训的单视模型的性能相当。 这表明DPIF为数据稀缺的多视图医学图像分解问题提供了一个通用和可伸缩的解决方案.

articles.title: ResGVC: Residual Coding for High-fidelity Generative Video Compression
articles.content: Generative video compression (GVC) methods usually employ decoder-side diffusion models to denoise reconstructed signals based on generative priors. Besides, most of these methods perform denoising in latent space rather than directly in pixel domain. In this paper, we propose ResGVC, a residual coding framework for GVC that guides denoising toward original pictures by transmitting residual signals. ResGVC first encodes the original pictures within a learned video codec, and then decomposes the distortion between the codec reconstruction and the original pictures into a sequence of residual segments, where each residual segment is acquired at each denoising step. Residual segments can further be compressed by a novel residual codec with a diffusion transformer as an entropy model. Unlike prior methods, ResGVC introduces explicit source constraints throughout denoising rather than relying on decoder-side generation alone. The diffusion-based entropy model also enables more effective distribution modeling capability based on the powerful generative priors. Moreover, denoising directly in pixel space avoids the irreversible information loss caused by latent representation bottlenecks. Experimental results show that, compared with the previous state-of-the-art method, ResGVC achieves 63.7% and 83.8% BD-rate reductions in terms of LPIPS and PSNR, respectively, while also delivering superior visual quality.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ResGVC: 高纯度基因视频压缩的剩余编码
articles.content_zh: 基因视频压缩(GVC)方法通常采用解码器侧传播模型,根据基因前传重建信号. 此外,这些方法大多在潜在空间而不是直接在像素域中进行去诺. 在本文中,我们提出ResGVC,作为GVC的剩余编码框架,通过发送剩余信号来引导对原创图片的称呼. ResGVC首先将原始图片编码在一个学习到的视频编码器内,然后将编码重建与原始图片之间的扭曲分解成一个剩余片段的序列,在每个解密步骤中每个剩余片段都在此获得. 残留的片段可以进一步通过以扩散变压器作为 en模型的新型残留编码器进行压缩. 与先前的方法不同,ResGVC在整个解码过程中引入了明确的源限制,而不是仅仅依赖解码器侧生成. 基于扩散的乙烯基模型还能够根据强大的遗传学前科建立更有效的分布模型。 此外,直接在像素空间中发号施令可避免潜在表达瓶颈造成的不可逆转的信息损失。 实验结果显示,与之前最先进的方法相比,ResGVC分别实现了LPIPS和PSNR的63.7%和83.8%的BD率降低,同时也提供了更高的视觉质量.

articles.title: Revisiting Distribution Matching for State-to-Vision Policy Distillation in Laparoscopic Robotic Manipulation
articles.content: End-to-end control policies trained via Reinforcement Learning (RL) have emerged as an alternative to conventional surgical robotic control approaches, with recent studies exploring state-based policies trained on privileged state observations. However, such approaches rely on precise physical states that are difficult to obtain reliably in surgical environments. Vision-based RL provides an alternative by learning manipulation policies directly from RGB observations, avoiding explicit state estimation and manually engineered perception pipelines while enabling policies to acquire task-relevant visual representations. Nevertheless, obtaining vision-based policies via pure RL methods for surgical manipulation remains challenging. Thus, imitation learning (IL) becomes another solution, yet it requires a large number of expert demonstrations, which are difficult to obtain in minimally invasive surgery. In this work, we propose a framework for state-to-vision policy distillation in laparoscopic robotic manipulation. Specifically, a state-based policy with privileged observations is employed as the teacher, and a vision-based policy learns from RGB observations and robot proprioceptive information, which requires less expert demonstrations than IL and introduces superior performance than RL methods. We conduct extensive experiments on various surgical manipulation tasks in the simulated environment. Experimental results show that, in the context of laparoscopic robotic manipulation, training vision-based policies with general-purpose RL methods is challenging, whereas our proposed state-to-vision policy distillation leads to more consistent and stable performance across tasks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 重新审视《国家与愿景政策》在Laparocographic 操纵机器人中的蒸馏
articles.content_zh: 通过强化学习(RL)培训的端到端控制政策已成为常规外科机器人控制方法的替代方法,最近的一些研究探索了以国家为基础的政策,就国家特权观察进行了培训。 然而,这种方法依赖于在外科手术环境中难以可靠获得的精确物理状态. 基于愿景的RL通过直接从RGB观察中学习操纵政策,避免明确状态估计和人工设计感知管道,同时使政策能够获得与任务相关的视觉表现,从而提供了一个替代方案. 然而,通过纯RL方法获得基于视力的政策进行手术操作仍然是一项挑战。 因此,模仿学习(IL)成为另一种解决方案,然而它却需要大量的专家演示,在最小的入侵手术中很难获得. 在这项工作中,我们提出一个框架,用于在大脑机器人操纵中进行国家到视觉政策提炼。 具体来说,采用以国家为主,有特权观察的政策作为教师,以视觉为主的政策从RGB观察和机器人自主信息中学习,这需要的专家演示比IL少,引入的性能优于RL方法. 我们在模拟环境中对各种手术操纵任务进行了广泛的实验. 实验结果表明,在脑膜机器人操纵的情况下,采用通用遥控飞行器方法的基于培训视觉的政策具有挑战性,而我们提议的国对国政策提炼则导致各项任务的绩效更加一致和稳定。

articles.title: Direct Pass@$k$ Optimization for Thought Pruning: Balancing Quality and Diversity in Test-Time Reasoning
articles.content: Test-time scaling has emerged as a key inference strategy for reasoning models, where a model generates a large number of candidate solutions in the hope of finding at least one correct solution. Running all candidate solutions to completion can be computationally demanding, so recent work prunes the candidate pool after generating only a short prefix, committing further computation only to the surviving candidates. Existing pruning strategies divide broadly into two categories: Quality-based methods assign a score to each partial solution and discard those predicted to ultimately lead to an incorrect final solution, while diversity-based methods select partial solutions that follow different reasoning trajectories and are therefore likely to cover different final solutions. The tension between these two objectives is an instance of exploration versus exploitation, yet little to no prior work on pruning exposes this trade-off directly, let alone optimizes it. In this paper, we introduce a pruning procedure that addresses this trade-off directly by optimizing pass@$k$ over the selected solution pool. In particular, it chooses the pool to maximize the probability that at least one of its partial solutions, when continued to completion, yields a correct answer. Because this objective simultaneously rewards high-quality partial solutions and penalizes redundancy among them, quality and diversity are naturally balanced by the criterion itself rather than through separate ad-hoc design choices. On eight open-weight reasoning models, our method outperforms existing quality-based and diversity-based pruning strategies. The gains are particularly pronounced when the pruning procedure keeps a moderate number of partial solutions for continued generation, highlighting the value of directly balancing quality and diversity during pruning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 直接通行证@ $k$ 优化思源: 在测试-时间理性中平衡质量和多样性
articles.content_zh: 测试时间缩放已成为推理模型的关键推论策略,一个模型会产生大量候选解决方案,希望至少找到一个正确的解决方案. 在计算完成所有候选人解决方案时可能要求很高,因此,最近的工作在只产生一个短的前缀之后便对候选人人才库进行精选,只对幸存的候选人进行进一步计算。 现行战略大致分为两类: 基于质量的方法为每个部分解决方案分配一个分数,并丢弃那些预计最终会导致不正确的最终解决方案的方法,而基于多样性的方法选择部分解决方案,这些解决方案遵循不同的推理轨迹,因此很可能涵盖不同的最终解决方案. 这两个目标之间的紧张关系是勘探与开发的一个例子,然而,以前几乎没有任何关于钻探的工作直接暴露了这种取舍,更不用说优化了。 在本文中,我们采用了一种套用程序,通过优化选定解决方案池的通过率,直接解决这种权衡问题。 特别是,它选择池子是为了最大限度地增加其至少一个部分解决方案在继续完成时得出正确答案的可能性。 因为这一目标同时奖励高质量的部分解决办法,并惩罚它们之间的冗余,所以质量和多样性自然是由标准本身而不是通过单独的临时设计选择来平衡的。 在8个开放量的推理模型上,我们的方法比现有的基于质量和多样性的计算策略要好。 当钻探程序为持续生成保留了一定数量的局部解决方案时,收益尤其显著,凸显了钻探过程中直接平衡质量和多样性的价值.

articles.title: Cost-Aware Abstention for LLM-Based IT Ticket Classification
articles.content: Wrong automatic routing of an IT support ticket can cost more than human triage. We evaluate cost-aware abstention as an offline, cost-conditional readiness assessment: select a routing policy on calibration data under explicit costs, then evaluate that frozen policy once on held-out test data. On a public 47,837-ticket, eight-class corpus, we compare four trained non-LLM classifiers with four large language models under zero- and few-shot prompting. Under the illustrative cost model (c_ok, c_triage, c_wrong) = (0, 1, 5), TF-IDF with logistic regression and a threshold of 0.60 selected on calibration reduces test cost from 0.763 to 0.472, a 38.1% relative reduction (paired ratio-bootstrap 95% CI [35.7%, 40.4%]), while lowering wrong routes from 15.3% to 3.5%. Frozen calibration-selected policies also beat both always-route and always-defer on held-out test data in 14 of 16 settings in a post-hoc cost-parameter analysis. The strongest prompted configuration reaches 0.477 accuracy on a stratified 1,000-ticket test subset, versus 0.879 for fine-tuned DistilBERT on the same tickets. Isotonic lowers expected calibration error without reliably improving discrimination: GPT-4o-mini few-shot has one confidence value before and after recalibration and correctness AUROC 0.500. We therefore report correctness AUROC and tie-aware risk-coverage area alongside ECE. At the analytically derived break-even probability 0.80, seven prompted configurations defer all tickets; Haiku few-shot routes only 19/1,000. An LLM-only agreement control and margin/entropy rejection baselines further separate calibration from discrimination. The findings are scoped to this dataset, prompt design, model endpoints, and illustrative costs; the work is an evaluation framework, not a new abstention algorithm or universal deployment certification.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 基于 LLM 的IT 车票分类
articles.content_zh: 错误的自动路由 IT 支持票 可能比人类分拣成本更高。 我们评价成本意识的弃权作为一种离线、成本条件的准备状态评估:在明确费用下选择校准数据的路线政策,然后在停产测试数据上评价冻结政策。 在一个公开的47,837-ticket,8级的教程上,我们比较了4个经过训练的非LLM分类器和4个大语言模型在0和数镜头的提示下. 根据说明性成本模型(c_ok, c_triage, c_wrong)=(0, 1, 5),TF-IDF具有物流回归性,在校准上选择了0.60的阈值,将测试成本从0.763降至0.472,相对降低38.1%(比比比比比比-坡度95%CI[35.7%,40.4%]),同时将错误的路线从15.3%降至3.5%. 冻结校准 -- -- 选定的政策在一次热量成本参数分析中还击败了16个环境中中14个中始终如一的预留测试数据,并始终拖延。 最强的促动配置在一个分级的1000个计程器测试子集上达到0.477的精度,而同一张门票上的微调DistilBERT则达到0.879. 同位素降低预期的校准误差,而又不可靠地改进区别:GPT-4o-mini number-shot在校准和正确度AUROC 0.500前后具有一个信任值. 因此,我们与欧洲经委会一起,报告阿拉伯团结和团结组织以及领带风险覆盖区是否正确。 根据分析推算出的断裂-均匀概率0.80,7个诱导配置推迟所有门票;海库数射径仅19/1000. 只有一个LLM协议控制和比值/拒绝基准进一步将校准与歧视分开。 调查结果被限定在这个数据集的范围,即时设计,模型终点,以及说明性成本;工作是一个评价框架,而不是新的弃权算法或通用部署认证.

articles.title: Low-Bit N-Gram Embeddings for Language Models
articles.content: Many recent open-weight language models use n-gram embedding tables to improve performance. These tables store learned representations of short token sequences, such as pairs or triples of consecutive tokens, which the model retrieves during processing. However, they can require substantial memory: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, for example, allocates 196 billion parameters to its Engram n-gram memory. We therefore investigate whether this memory cost can be reduced while preserving the performance improvement that the tables provide. We propose storing n-gram embeddings at low precision and systematically investigate different quantization methods and bit allocations across tables. Across nanochat-, Llama-, and GPT-2-family models trained from scratch, four-bit tables save approximately 75% of table memory while preserving more than 99% of the validation-loss improvement from adding the tables. Using fewer bits leads to a larger drop in performance, although we find that a short fine-tuning phase recovers a significant part of this loss. In addition, reinvesting the saved memory in larger tables can improve performance beyond that of the original full-precision tables while still using less memory. These table memory savings also extend to large existing models: on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, low-bit tables save 47-55% of table memory, with perplexity increases of less than 1.2% and largely preserved downstream task performance. These findings establish low-bit precision as a practical way to reduce the memory requirements of n-gram embeddings and use the saved capacity to improve model performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语言模型的低比特 N-奶奶嵌入
articles.content_zh: 许多近期的开放量级语言模型使用n格嵌入表来提高性能. 这些表格存储着学习到的短令牌序列的表示,如对子或连续令牌的三重表示,模型在处理过程中检索到这些表示. 然而,它们可以需要大量的内存:例如,DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash为它的Engram n-gram内存分配了1,960亿参数. 因此,我们调查是否可以降低这种记忆成本,同时保留表格所提供的业绩改进。 我们提议以低精度储存正格嵌入,并系统调查不同的量化方法和各表的位分配。 在整个纳米聊天、Llama和GPT-2家庭模式中,四位表格从零开始培训,节省了约75%的表格内存,同时保留了99%以上的验证-损失改进。 使用更少的位数会导致性能的更大下降,尽管我们发现短微调相可以收回这一损失的很大一部分. 此外,将保存的内存重新投资到更大的表格中,可以改善超出原全精度表格的性能,同时仍然较少使用内存. 这些表格内存节省也扩展到了大型现有模型:在DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash和Qune3.8-Flash-Next上,低位表保存了47-55%的表格内存,模糊度增加不到1.2%,基本上保留了下游任务性能. 这些发现确立了低位精度,作为减少n-gram嵌入的内存要求,并利用保存的能力来改进模型性能的实用方法.

articles.title: Can an Agent Debug a Web Corpus? Agentic Auditing of Slovak FineWeb2
articles.content: Multilingual pipelines such as FineWeb2 apply one recipe across a thousand languages, leaving the failure modes of individual languages unanticipated. We use an LLM once, as a corpus debugger rather than a classifier: a tool-using agent explores the corpus through a read-only, budgeted API and compiles each finding into an executable test, which a native speaker then validates. On the 26.5M-document Slovak portion of FineWeb2, three runs costing \$2.21-\$2.84 each found seven findings over four phenomena. The largest is a machine-generated content farm of 1,408,437 documents (5.32%) that passed the pipeline's filters, 86.6% of it passing even stricter thresholds. Blinded labels support 6 of the 7 findings (defect rates .53-1.00 against .08 in a random control) and do not support one. The compiled suite scans the full corpus in 0.7 s of wall-clock time without a GPU, against \$12k-\$90k per LLM classification pass. The best static sampling baseline validates more selectors than any agent run, at under half the cost. The agent contributes exact prevalence, a precision estimate checked against sampled documents, an account of why the pipeline missed each slice, and a reusable test. We release the framework, Slovak test suite, validation data and agent trajectories.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 一个代理调试一个网络公司? 斯洛伐克 FineWeb2 代理审计
articles.content_zh: FineWeb2等多种语言管道在千种语言中应用一种食谱,使得个别语言的失败模式出乎意料. 我们曾经使用过一个LLM,作为一个实体调试器而不是一个分类器:一个工具使用代理人通过一个只读的,预算编列的API来探索该实体,并将每个发现汇编成一个可执行的测试,然后一个母语者验证. FineWeb2的26.5M文件斯洛伐克部分, 最大的是1,408,437份文件(532%)的机器生产内容场,这些文件通过了管道的过滤器,其中86.6%超过更严格的阈值。 盲标支持7项调查结果中的6项(随机控制中53-1.00的缺陷率比0.08),不支持1项. 编译的套件在没有GPU的0.7s的壁时扫描全体,而每LLM分类合格证为\$12k-\$90k. 最好的静态采样基线比任何物剂都更能验证选择者,费用不到一半。 毒剂提供准确的流行程度,对照抽样文件进行精确估计,说明输油管为何漏掉每一片,以及可重复使用的测试。 我们发布了框架、斯洛伐克测试套件、验证数据和代理轨迹。

articles.title: Bilingual Language Models Capture Cross-Linguistic Influence in Second-Language Reading
articles.content: While monolingual language model (LM) surprisal is widely established as a predictor of reading times, it cannot capture the non-native (L2) reading dynamics that are shaped by the reader's first language (L1). In this work, we investigate whether the cross-lingual transfer within bilingual models aligns with human L1-driven biases during L2 reading. We evaluate bilingual models on eye-tracking data of readers from 12 diverse L1 backgrounds reading English texts. To isolate L1-specific transfer, we compare bilingual models trained on an L1 that matches the readers' L1 background to both a monolingual English baseline and bilingual models trained on other L1s. We demonstrate that matching the readers' L1 improves the prediction of L2 reading times. This predictive advantage is concentrated in late-stage eye-tracking measures, modulated by L1-L2 script overlap, and peaks among intermediate-proficiency readers. These findings provide evidence that bilingual LMs capture aspects of cross-linguistic influence, and that such influence is present in L2 reading behavior.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 双语语言模型 影响第二语言阅读
articles.content_zh: 虽然单语语言模型(LM)超音速被广泛确立为阅读时间的预测器,但是它无法捕捉到由读者第一语言(L1)塑造的非本土(L2)阅读动态. 在这项工作中,我们调查双语模式内的跨语言转移是否与L2阅读过程中人类L1驱动的偏见一致. 我们评价来自12个不同L1背景阅读英文文本的读者的双眼跟踪数据。 为了隔离L1的特异性转移,我们比较了在L1上受过训练的双语模型,这些模型将读者的L1背景与单一语言的英语基线和在其他L1上受过训练的双语模型相匹配. 我们证明,匹配读者的L1可以改善L2阅读时间的预测. 这种预测优势集中在后期的眼跟踪措施上,由L1-L2脚本重叠调制,中间速率读取器之间达到峰值. 这些研究结果提供了双语LMs捕捉跨语言影响方面的证据,这种影响存在于L2读取行为中.

articles.title: How Ground Truth Shapes Retrieval Scores: Evidence-Aware Evaluation of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation System for Breast Lesions
articles.content: Purpose: To describe an evidence-aware retrieval evaluation protocol for a clinical retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system over breast lesion management literature, addressing the dependence of retrieval scores on annotation coverage. Methods: An 18-document corpus and an 18-query development benchmark, with one Yes/No or WH-question per document, were used. Retrieval combined dense embeddings, BM25, and cross-encoder reranking. Chunk sizes of 128 to 1024 tokens, overlaps of 0 to 20%, and four retriever configurations were evaluated. Relevance was defined by evidence spans mapped to all containing chunks, treating overlapping chunks with equivalent evidence as relevant. Retrieval was evaluated using R-Precision, Recall@K, MRR, and nDCG@K. Separately, generation was assessed on a 512-token index at K=1 to 5 using DeepEval claim-level metrics, with deepseek-v4-pro as the LLM judge, and BLEU/ROUGE metrics. Results: The selected hybrid retriever, using 384-token chunks and 20% overlap, retrieved accepted evidence in the top three results for 17 of 18 queries. Recall@3, R-Precision, MRR@3, and nDCG@3 each reached 0.94. Ground-truth curation increased evidence spans from 25 to 37 and accepted chunk targets from 36 to 51 without changing retrieval rankings. Conclusion: Cross-encoder reranking achieved the highest retrieval scores. Expanded relevance annotations increased recognized evidence without changing rankings, highlighting annotation sensitivity. The small development set and retrieval-informed curation require independent validation, including radiologist assessment of evidence sufficiency.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 地面真相形状 检索分数:对乳腺癌检索强化生成系统的证据 -- -- 知情评价
articles.content_zh: 目的: 描述对乳腺损伤管理文献进行临床检索强化生成(RAG)系统的证据意识检索评价协议,解决检索分数依赖注释覆盖的问题。 方法: 采用了18个文件汇编和18个村发展基准,每个文件有一个是/否或WH问题。 检索集成密集嵌入,BM25,以及交叉编码器重排. 春克尺寸128至1024令牌,重叠0至20%,4个检索器配置得到评价. 相关性由与所有含有块的证据跨度所界定,将重叠块和同等证据视为相关。 检索使用R-精确度、Recall@K、MRR和nDCG@K进行了评价。 另外,采用DeepEval索赔水平的度量衡,以512吨指数(K=1至5)评估生成量,深层Seek-v4-pro为LLM法官,BLEU/ROUGE计量。 结果: 选定的混合检索器使用384个托肯块和20%的重叠,在18个查询中的17个查询中检索到前三个结果中接受的证据。 召回@3,R-精密度,MRR@3和nDCG@3各达到0.94. 地面真相调查把证据从25个增加到37个,接受的块指标从36个增加到51个,而不会改变检索的排名。 结论:Cross-encoder重排实现最高检索分数. 扩展的关联性说明增加了公认的证据而不改变排名,突出了注释的敏感性. 小型开发组和检索信息化的目录需要独立的验证,包括放射学家对证据充足程度的评估。

articles.title: Would an LLM Match into a Residency? Uncertainty, Reasoning and Image Use of Open Language Models on the Spanish MIR Examination
articles.content: Accuracy on medical examinations is common evidence offered for the clinical use of language models, yet a health system that intends to run an open model on its own hardware needs to know considerably more: whether the model recognizes when it is likely to be wrong, whether medical fine-tuning improves this ability, whether its correct answers rest on sound clinical reasoning, or whether it actually uses the images it is given. We examine these questions for four open models of 8 to 27 billion parameters on the Spanish MIR residency examination, scoring 1,552 questions from eight editions under the exam's own rules. Answering every question, the three larger models would rank among roughly the first 600 to 3,000 candidates, with 41 to 43 specialties still open to them. Abstention, however, never pays, because even their least confident answers are right more often than the 25% break-even. Medical fine-tuning reduced overconfidence at the cost of accuracy, without improving how well confidence separates right from wrong answers. Moreover, 13-38% of correct answers rejected a distractor for a clinically unsound reason that confidence did not reflect, and removing or swapping the provided contextual images left accuracy unchanged.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 一个LLM匹配到居住区吗? 西班牙MIR考试开放语言模型的不确定性、理由和图像使用
articles.content_zh: 医学检查的准确性是临床使用语言模型的常见证据,然而一个打算用自己的硬件运行一个开放模型的卫生系统需要知道更多:模型是否承认可能错误时,医学微调是否改善了这种能力,其正确答案是否依赖于合理的临床推理,或者是否实际使用了它给出的图像. 在西班牙的MIR居住考试中,我们为四个80至270亿参数的开放模型来审查这些问题,根据考试本身的规则,从8个版本中得1 552个问题。 在回答每一个问题时,三个较大的模式将大致排在第一批600至3 000名候选人中,其中41至43个专业仍然开放。 然而,弃权从不给钱,因为即使他们最没有信心的答案也比25%的平分率更正确。 医学微调以准确性为代价降低了过度自信,而没有改善信心如何将正确与错误的答案区分开来. 此外,有13-38%的正确答复拒绝分心者,理由是临床上不健全,信心不能反映,删除或交换所提供的背景图像的准确性保持不变。

articles.title: Diffusion Language Models for Perplexity-Aware Black-Box Attacks
articles.content: \emph{Continuous-space} attacks find prompts that trigger malicious behaviors, such as overthinking, in black-box LLMs by sampling or optimizing over a low-dimensional Gaussian latent space and decoding it to text through a \emph{random mapping} and nearest-token lookup. Because the random mapping is not learned from language, its prompts can be highly unnatural, and as such easily detectable through input guardrails, and the risk estimates they yield are not grounded in natural prompts. In this paper, we demonstrate that the same continuous latent-space framework can be coupled directly to a learned generative distribution over language, a continuous diffusion language model (dLLM), which removes the artificial random mapping while preserving the standard-Gaussian latent formulation and the downstream sampling or optimization procedure. We evaluate this approach under two settings: sampling-based estimation using \emph{RareTrap} and optimization-based search using \emph{ThinkTrap}. We find that character-level perplexity drops from $10^3$--$10^7$ to 3--5 in RareTrap and from 20--28 to 4.3--5.4 in ThinkTrap. We also find that model risk estimates can differ by an order of magnitude across the two mappings.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 复杂- 智能黑盒攻击的传播语言模型
articles.content_zh: \emph{ continuous-space} 攻击在黑盒 LLMs 中找到触发恶意行为的提示, 如过度思考, 通过采样或优化低维的 Gaussian 潜在空间, 并通过\emph{random 映射} 和最近的调试查找将其解码为文本 。 由于随机映射没有从语言中学习到,其诱因可能非常不自然,因此很容易通过输入护栏被探测到,它们产生的风险估计并不基于自然诱因. 在本文中,我们表明,同样的连续潜伏空间框架可以直接与语言上已学会的基因分配、持续扩散语言模型(dLLM)结合起来,这种模型在保留标准-古西潜质配方和下游取样或优化程序的同时去除人工随机绘图。 我们在两种情况下评价这一方法:使用\emph{ RareTrap} 进行采样估计和使用\emph{ ThinkTrap} 进行优化搜索。 我们发现,人物层面的迷惑度从10^3美元-10^7美元降至稀有特拉普的3–5美元,从20–28美元降至4.3–5.4美元。 我们还发现,模型风险估计可能因两种绘图的规模而异。

articles.title: An Empirical Study of Recent Large Language Models for Knowledge Graph to Text Generation on Standard Benchmarks
articles.content: Knowledge graph-to-text (KG-to-text) generation verbalizes a set of knowledge graph triples into fluent natural language. While fine-tuned encoder-decoder models have long been the standard approach, recent LLMs are becoming increasingly competitive. We benchmark recent LLMs against fine-tuned encoder-decoder models, using reference-based metrics and graph-grounded reference-free LLM-based evaluation validated against human annotations. We observed that recent LLMs substantially narrow, and in several settings close, the gap with fine-tuned models on reference-based metrics, while performing better on graph-grounded metrics. LLM-based evaluation scores show limited correlation with reference-based metrics, suggesting that the two approaches capture different aspects of generation quality. Graph-grounded evaluation reveals that prompted models produce fewer contradictions and triple omissions than fine-tuned models, and these errors increase more rapidly with graph size for fine-tuned models, highlighting differences between the two approaches that reference-based metrics may not fully capture.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 关于最新大语言模型的经验研究,用于根据标准基准生成文本的知识图
articles.content_zh: 知识图对文本(KG-to-text)生成将一组知识图对三进制成流畅的自然语言. 虽然经过微调的编码器-解码器模型长期以来一直是标准方法,但最近的有限责任公司越来越具有竞争力。 我们以微调编码器-解码器模型为基准,使用基于参考的衡量尺度和基于图表的无参考LLM评价,对照人类说明加以验证。 我们注意到,最近的有限责任管理办法大大缩小了与参照度量衡的微调模型的差距,并在一些环境下缩小了这种差距,同时在以图表为基础的度量衡上表现较好。 基于LLM的评价分数显示与基于参考的衡量标准的相关性有限,表明这两种方法捕捉到生成质量的不同方面. 以图表为基础的评价显示,与微调模型相比,被激发模型产生的矛盾和三重遗漏较少,这些错误随着微调模型的图表大小而增加得更快,凸显了基于参考的衡量标准可能无法完全捕捉到的两种方法之间的差异.

articles.title: The Geometry of Metaphor: Probing and Steering Metaphor Representations in Large Language Models
articles.content: Metaphor is a crucial aspect of human cognition. As such, we would like to understand how it is represented in large language models (LLMs) and how it might be controlled. We use mechanistic interpretability techniques to identify causal subspaces in a range of LLMs covering different architectures and sizes. We show that we are able to steer output on classification tasks across different parts of speech. We are also able to steer output on generation tasks, indicating that these techniques can be used to control the metaphoricity of LLM output.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Metaphor的几何:大语言模型中的检测和引导Metaphor代表
articles.content_zh: 隐喻是人类认知的一个关键方面. 因此,我们想了解它是如何在大语言模型中体现的,以及如何加以控制。 我们使用机械解释技术来识别一系列涵盖不同架构和大小的LLMs中的因果子空间. 我们显示,我们能够在发言的不同部分指导产出的分类工作。 我们还能够引导输出完成生成任务,表明这些技术可以用来控制LLM输出的隐喻性.

articles.title: Towards User Simulators That Stay On Task And Still Sound Natural
articles.content: Users increasingly rely on AI systems for extended, multi-turn tasks, yet evidence indicates that LLM-based system performance degrades over prolonged interaction. To evaluate and improve AI assistants in such settings, we need user simulators that faithfully follow complex user intents while exhibiting realistic conversational behavior. Existing approaches manifest a trade-off: prompted assistants can follow complex user intents but lack behavioral fidelity, while specialized user simulators better approximate conversational behavior but struggle to remain faithful to complex intents. In this paper, we propose a reinforcement learning (RL) recipe that jointly rewards task intent adherence and behavioral naturalness. A crucial contribution of the method is operationalizing naturalness with a lightweight discriminator trained in an alternating, adversarial loop with the user simulator. We release the resulting model, UserLM-2.0, which produces valid simulated conversations (i.e., meeting both task-faithfulness and naturalness criteria) 46.2% of the time, over three times the rate of the strongest prior user simulator (14.1%).
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 面向继续执行任务的用户模拟器, 并且仍然声音自然
articles.content_zh: 用户越来越多地依赖AI系统来完成扩展的,多回合的任务,然而有证据表明基于LLM的系统性能会因为长时间的相互作用而退化. 为了在这样的环境下评价和改进AI助手,我们需要忠实地遵循复杂的用户意图的用户模拟器,同时表现出现实的对话行为. 现有方法体现了一种权衡:被激励的助手可以遵循复杂的用户意图,但缺乏行为上的忠诚,而专业的用户模拟器则更接近对话行为,但努力保持对复杂意图的忠诚. 在本文中,我们提出了一个强化学习(RL)的配方,共同奖励任务意向守信和行为自然. 这种方法的一个重要贡献是,在与用户模拟器交替、对抗性循环中,对轻量级歧视者进行训练,使自然性发挥作用。 我们释放了产生的模型UserLM-2.0,该模型产生有效的模拟对话(即同时满足任务可靠性和自然性标准)46.2%的时间,是最强的前用户模拟器(14.1%)的三倍以上.

articles.title: Measuring the Verifier's Floor: How Much Apparent Rare-Word Text-to-Speech Error Is ASR Error?
articles.content: Text-to-speech (TTS) is usually evaluated by transcribing its output with an automatic speech recognition (ASR) system, so the word error rate also counts recognizer errors. We measure these errors on human recordings of the test sentences. On LibriSpeech and FLEURS, the evaluation recognizer misses 33-67% of very rare words even in human speech, and all three recognizers miss 22-42%. Checking every word with two more recognizer families lowers the apparent TTS error on words that at least one recognizer hears two- to three-fold (very rare LibriSpeech words: from 10-13% to 3-5%), yet very rare words remain the hardest. Ignoring words the recognizer misses in human speech is biased: the other recognizers find TTS errors far more often on these words (4-6% vs. 0.2-0.3%) and overturn about half of the errors this mask keeps. As half of the remaining adjudicated errors may be spelling variants, a listening test is needed.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 测量验证器的底部: ASR 错误是多少外显的稀有文字对语言错误 ?
articles.content_zh: Text-to-speech(TTS)通常通过在自动语音识别(ASR)系统中转录其输出来评价,因此单词错误率也算作识别器错误. 我们用测试句的人类录音来测量这些错误。 在LibriSpeech和FLEURS上,评价识别器错过了33-67%的非常罕见的单词,即使是在人类的演讲中,三个识别器都错过了22-42%. 用另外两个识别家来检查每个单词会降低至少一个识别家听到2到3倍的单词上明显的TTS错误(非常罕见的LibriSpeech单词:从10-13%到3-5%),然而非常罕见的单词仍然是最难的. 忽略识别器在人类语音中忽略的词是偏颇的:其他识别器在这些词上发现TTS错误的频率要大得多(4–6%对0.2–0.3%),并且推翻了这个面具所保存的大约一半错误. 由于剩余的裁定错误中,有一半可能是拼写变体,因此需要一个监听测试.

articles.title: From Structured Records to Patient Narratives: Preserving Clinical Alignment in LLM-Generated Health Summaries
articles.content: As wearable and digital health systems increasingly generate longitudinal physiological records, communicating these observations in patient-accessible language remains a significant challenge. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising mechanism for translating structured clinical information into readable narratives, but this process may introduce semantic drift, where clinically precise meaning is distorted during simplification. We investigate evidence-grounded health summarization for menstrual health monitoring using a constrained generation framework that combines structured evidence conditioning with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using a prompt-based constrained generation framework. We evaluate semantic alignment using Natural Language Inference (NLI), atomic factuality metrics, and readability measures. Across three LLMs and 4,500 generated summaries, explicit grounding constraints consistently improve clinical alignment, particularly by improving uncertainty preservation and, once faithfulness is evaluated against retrieved evidence, generally preserving or improving faithfulness, while effects on omission remain model-dependent. We also find that improved clinical alignment comes at the cost of increased reading difficulty and medical terminology. These findings highlight the need to jointly evaluate faithfulness, uncertainty preservation, and readability when developing patient-facing medical LLM systems.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从结构化记录到病人叙述:在LLM-Gened保健摘要中保留临床对齐
articles.content_zh: 由于可穿戴和数字化的保健系统越来越多地产生纵向生理记录,用患者可使用的语言传播这些观测结果仍然是一个重大挑战。 大型语言模型(LLMs)为将结构化的临床信息翻译为可读的叙事提供了一个很有希望的机制,但这一过程可能会引入语义漂移,在简化过程中,临床上准确的含义被扭曲. 我们利用一个限制生成框架,将结构化的证据条件与利用快速生成限制生成框架的检索增强生成(RAG)结合起来,对月经健康监测的循证健康总结进行调查。 我们利用自然语言推论、原子事实度量和可读性度量来评价语义的校正。 在三个法学硕士和4,500个研究摘要中,明确的制约因素不断改善临床一致性,特别是通过改进不确定性的保存,一旦根据收集的证据评估忠诚性,一般保持或提高忠诚性,而对疏漏的影响仍然取决于模式。 我们还发现,由于阅读困难和医学术语增加,临床一致性得到改善。 这些调查结果突出表明,在发展患者的医学LLM系统时,需要共同评价忠诚性、不确定性的保存和可读性。

articles.title: How Different, or Different How? Stance Granularity in Viewpoint Selection for Dialog Systems that Engage Users with Alternative Views
articles.content: Systems that aim to help a user engage with viewpoints other than their own have to decide how different those viewpoints should be. Viewpoints are mainly represented on a scalar scale, too coarse to distinguish viewpoints that disagree with the user about different things. We introduce a selection policy in which a bandit sets how far viewpoints may sit from the user, and the policy selects the most novel viewpoint within that bound. We vary only its stance encoder, comparing a scalar score with Perspectivized Stance Vectors, which break a position into separate stances on concepts. We integrate it inside a dialog system and run a between-subjects study (N=63). Concept-level stance produces more varied exposure sequences and broader coverage of the topic's positions, but does not change how deeply users justify viewpoints or how accurately they reconstruct them. Finally, we analyze user--viewpoint relations at the concept level, showing that users reconstruct a viewpoint least accurately on concepts that one side took no position on, rather than on concepts where the two disagreed. Our findings open up opportunities for dialog systems that support engagement with alternative viewpoints by acting on which concepts a user and a viewpoint disagree on, rather than on distance alone.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 如何不同,还是如何不同? 吸引用户使用另类视图的对话框系统视图点选择中的 Stance Granularity
articles.content_zh: 旨在帮助用户表达自己不同观点的系统必须决定这些观点应如何不同。 视图点主要以scalar比例表示,过于粗糙,无法区分不同事物上与用户有分歧的观点. 我们实行一种选择政策,由土匪确定与使用者的观点可能相距多远,而政策则在其中选择最新颖的观点。 我们只改变它的立场编码器, 比较一个标分 和Perspectified Stance Vectors, 它打破了一个位置 在概念上 分开的立场。 我们把它整合在一个对话系统中,并进行一个学科间研究(N=63)。 概念层面的立场产生更多样化的曝光顺序和对专题立场的更广泛涵盖,但并不改变用户如何深刻地说明观点的合理性或如何准确地重建观点。 最后,我们在概念层面分析用户-观点关系,显示用户对一方没有立场的概念,而不是对双方意见不一的概念,重建最准确的观点。 我们的研究结果为对话系统提供了机会,这些系统支持采用其他观点,其做法是,一个用户和观点在哪些概念上存在分歧,而不只是在距离问题上。

articles.title: Multi-Token Prediction and Alternative Tokenization Improve Learning Latent Multi-Hop Graph Search at Scale
articles.content: Given an unseen graph, a start node, $s$, and an end node, $t$, can a language model generate the shortest path from $s$ to $t$? Prior work has found that models fail to learn this task as the graphs scale. We show that this failure has two causes: the supervision signal and the tokenization. First, we theoretically establish and empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of multi-token prediction (MTP), and show that the benefits of MTP are topologically agnostic. Second, we introduce alternative tokenizations and show that the two causes are orthogonal. Using these methods, we break through the scaling wall observed by prior work, consistently and stably learning to solve the task at scales far beyond previous limits.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 多语种预测和替代语种化 改进学习后期多语种图搜索
articles.content_zh: 鉴于一个看不见的图表,一个起始节点,美元,和一个终点节点,美元,一个语言模型能够产生最短的路径,从美元到美元? 以前的工作发现,模型未能将这一任务作为图表尺度来学习. 我们显示,这一失败有两个原因:监督信号和象征。 首先,我们理论上建立并实证地证明多键预测(MTP)的有效性,并表明MTP的好处是地形不可知的。 其次,我们引入了替代的象征性表示,并表明这两个原因是正交的。 使用这些方法,我们突破了以前工作所观察到的缩放墙,一致而稳定地学习如何以远超以前极限的尺度解决任务.

articles.title: How Well Do Decision Models Transfer to Vietnamese? An Empirical Study of Text Classification
articles.content: Recent advances in specialized decision models have expanded the possibilities for zero-shot classification, yet their effectiveness on Vietnamese remains underexplored. This study evaluates four specialized decision models across 13 classification settings spanning six task groups, examining zero-shot performance, sensitivity to label-description language, and robustness to Vietnamese linguistic variations. The evaluation considers English, Vietnamese, and bilingual label descriptions, alongside common linguistic perturbations involving teencode, typographical errors, and diacritic removal. Under English label descriptions, JEV achieves the strongest overall performance, ranking first in 11 classification settings. The effects of label-description language vary across models and datasets, with bilingual descriptions providing no consistent improvement. Robustness experiments reveal that diacritic removal causes the most substantial performance degradation, reducing mean macro-$F_1$ by 9.51--15.47 points across model configurations, considerably more than teencode or typographical errors. These findings highlight the importance of label-description choices and Vietnamese orthographic variation when evaluating specialized decision models for zero-shot text classification.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 决策模式如何向越南人转让? 关于文本分类的实证研究
articles.content_zh: 最近专门决策模式的进展扩大了零射线分类的可能性,但对越南语的效能仍然没有得到充分利用。 这项研究评价了13个分类设置的4个专门决策模型,涉及6个任务组,审查零镜头性能,对标签描述语言的敏感性,以及对越南语言差异的稳健性。 评估考虑了英文、越南文和双语标签描述,以及涉及十进制码、打字错误和去除批评的常见语言扰动。 在英文标签描述下,JEV实现最强的整体性能,在11个分类设置中排名第一. 标签描述语言的效果因模型和数据集而异,双语描述没有提供一致的改进. 强健性实验显示,二甲酸去除导致性能最大幅度的退化,将模型配置的平均值宏F_1降低9.51-15.47分,大大超过十进制码或打字错误. 这些结论突出了标签描述选择和越南在评价零镜头文本分类的专门决定模型时的正体变化的重要性。

articles.title: How Depth Growth and Looping Shape In-Context Learning in Language Models
articles.content: Looped and depth-grown language models reuse computations across depth and have attracted interest for their reasoning capabilities. Building on prior suggestive evidence of improved in-context-learning (ICL), we investigate how such reuse favors ICL, including how it shapes the acquisition, retention, and mechanisms of this ability. Our analysis spans pretrained language models up to 3B parameters and controlled tasks. The experiments provide evidence for a shared inductive bias toward learning from context: grown and looped models rely more on information in context and, compared with a full-depth dense reference, acquire ICL earlier in controlled tasks and retain it more strongly when learning fixed associations in the weights is also possible. Tracing attention heads through training reveals that depth growth propagates early induction heads across layers. Ablations show that grown and looped models rely more strongly on induction-ranked heads for both few-shot performance and later-token prediction. Together, these findings provide evidence for a shared inductive bias toward learning from context and suggest that (soft) parameter reuse shapes how this ability develops and which attention mechanisms support it.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语言模型中的深度增长和循环形状
articles.content_zh: 循环和深度发展的语言模型跨深度再利用计算,并引起了对其推理能力的兴趣。 根据先前关于改进内文学习的明显证据,我们调查这种再利用如何有利于《国际商业法》,包括它如何塑造这种能力的获取、保留和机制。 我们的分析跨越了预先训练的语言模型,最多可达3B参数和可控任务. 这些实验提供了证据,证明对从上下文学习有共同的诱导偏好:在上下文中,成长和循环的模型更多地依赖信息,与充分深入的参考相比,在控制任务中更早地获得ICL,并在也有可能学习权重中的固定关联时更强烈地保留它. 通过培训追踪关注头,发现深度增长将早期上岗头像传播到各个层次。 缩写显示,成长和循环的模型在少发性能和后发性能的预测中,都更依赖感应级头. 这些结论共同提供了证据,证明对从上下文中学习具有共同的诱导性偏见,并表明(软的)参数再利用决定了这种能力的发展方式以及支持这种能力的注意机制。

articles.title: SyRA-CS: Synthetic-to-Real Adaptation for Code-Switched ASR with Meta-Learning
articles.content: Code-switched (CS) automatic speech recognition (ASR) remains difficult because real CS speech is scarce and synthetic speech does not fully match it. We investigate whether synthetic CS speech is more useful for learning an adaptation-friendly initialization than for ordinary continual fine-tuning. We propose SyRA-CS, a pair-specific synthetic-to-real adaptation framework based on Reptile meta-learning. For each language pair and pretrained model, we meta-train on the corresponding synthetic CS-FLEURS subset and then adapt using one hour of labeled real target speech. We evaluate four architectural settings: Encoder-CTC, FastConformer-RNN-T, Attention Encoder-Decoder (AED) and Speech-LLM. Experiments cover on Arabic-, French-, German-, and Hindi-English, against synthetic-only transfer, real-only fine-tuning, and continual fine-tuning. SyRA-CS improves over continual fine-tuning on WER in all 16 model-pair comparisons and on CER in 15 of 16, with relative macro WER reductions of 17.7% for XLS-R and 5.3-5.8% for the other three models. The gains hold across the tested models but vary in size across architectures, language pairs and metrics.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SyRA-CS:与Meta-Learning合作对代码切换ASR的合成到真实适应
articles.content_zh: 代码切换(CS)自动语音识别(ASR)仍然困难,因为真实的CS语音很少,合成语音不完全与之匹配. 我们调查合成CS演讲是否比普通的不断微调更有助于学习适应的初始化。 我们提议采用SyRA-CS,这是基于Reptile meta-learning的一对特定的合成-现实适应框架。 对于每种语言对称和预训模型,我们对相应的合成CS-FLEURS子集进行元训练,然后使用1小时的标签真实目标语句进行调适. 我们评价四个建筑设置:编码器-CTC,快讯-RNN-T,注意编码器-解码器(AED)和Speech-LLM. 实验覆盖了阿拉伯语、法语、德语和印地语英语,反对只进行合成转移,只进行真正的微调,持续微调。 SyRA-CS在所有16个模型-平面比较中改进了WER的连续微调,在16个模型中改进了CER的连续微调,XLS-R的相对宏观WER减少17.7%,其他三种模型减少5.3-5.8%。 这些收益掌握在经过测试的模型中,但结构、语言对称和衡量尺度的大小各不相同。

articles.title: SQuAT: Spherical Lattice Vector Quantization-Aware Training
articles.content: Vector quantization (VQ), in particular lattice-based methods, offer strong rate-distortion trade-offs for low-bit large language models (LLMs), yet their behavior under quantization-aware training (VQ-QAT) remains poorly understood. We scale lattice VQ-QAT to billion-parameter LLMs and multi-billion-token training regimes, and introduce SQuAT, a shape-gain VQ-QAT approach trained with a separate straight-through estimator (STE) for the shape and gain. SQuAT decomposes weights into direction and magnitude: normalized directions are quantized using an $E_8$-derived spherical codebook, while gains are quantized independently with low-bit scalar quantizers. We show that, unlike a standard STE applied to the full quantizer, which ignores the shape-gain structure, these separate STEs induce tangent-space updates for directions, yielding an implicit form of spherical (Riemannian) optimization. To enable scalability, we develop a distributed exact nearest-neighbor assignment scheme, in which workers quantize disjoint weight blocks and communicate only discrete indices, reducing VQ-QAT training time by 12.8$\times$ and allowing us to scale it to 10B tokens. Across instruction-tuned LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B, Qwen3-4B, and base Qwen3-1.7B, SQuAT consistently outperforms standard VQ-QAT STE under identical quantizers and initialization, and achieves SOTA VQ-QAT accuracy.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SQuAT:球形拉蒂斯矢量化-智能训练
articles.content_zh: 矢量量化(VQ),特别是基于lattice的方法,为低位大语言模型(LLMs)提供了强大的速率扭曲权衡,然而他们在量化-意识训练(VQ-QAT)下的行为仍然不易理解. 我们把拉蒂斯 VQ-QAT 放大到十亿参数的 LLMs 和数十亿托肯的训练系统, 并引入 SQuAT,一种形状增益 VQ-QAT 方法, 训练了单独的直通计算器, 用于形状和收益 。 SQAT将权重分解为方向和量级: 归正方向使用$E_8元衍生的球形代码簿进行量子化,而增益则用低位的阶梯量子独立进行量子化. 我们显示,与适用于全量子的标准STE(它忽略了形状增益结构)不同,这些单独的STE会诱导正切空间更新方向,产生一种隐含的球形(Riemannian)优化形式. 为了实现可扩展性,我们开发了一个分布式的精确近邻分配计划,其中工人对离散重块进行定量,只交流离散指数,将VQ-QAT培训时间缩短了12.8美元\时间,并允许我们将其扩大为10B令牌. 纵观指令调制LLaMA-32-1B/3B,Quen3-4B,以及基础的Quen3-1.7B,SQuAT在相同的量子和初始化下,一贯超越标准VQ-QAT STE,实现SOTA VQ-QAT精度.

articles.title: Same Entity, Different Script: Diagnosing Cross-Script Entity Matching Failures in Language Models
articles.content: Multilingual language models can give different identity judgments when the same people's names are written in different scripts. We study this effect using 601 audited identity pairs with attested Devanagari and Latin forms, holding the question and relation fixed. Qwen2.5-7B's same-person accuracy falls from 35.1% in Latin to 8.5% in Devanagari under Marathi prompts, while different-person accuracy remains above 98%. Evaluation across five models reveals distinct response biases, and reduced tokenization fragmentation does not reliably close the gap. Replicating the design on 374 audited Malayalam pairs built from the same entities reproduces the effect in a second script and language family: same-person accuracy falls to 5.3%, about half the matched Devanagari rate, while the margin still ranks matching above non-matching names at 0.925 AUROC. Latin-trained probes recover label information from Devanagari states, exceeding a string-feature baseline under similarity-matched negatives. Scalar calibration recovers 87% of the raw model-probe balanced-accuracy gap, identifying decision criterion placement as a major contributor. Activation patching localises causal sensitivity to the second entity in Qwen's middle layers; one shared sensitivity direction transfers about half the full-state margin correction. A fact-independent intervention at this site raises held-out Marathi same-person accuracy from 6.5% to 33.5%, with 98.5% different-person accuracy. Together, these results distinguish script-dependent discrimination from criterion placement and identify a causal site for improving identity judgments.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 同一实体, 不同的脚本: 诊断跨脚本实体匹配语言模型中的失败
articles.content_zh: 多语言语言模型可以在同一个人的名字用不同的脚本书写时给出不同的身份判断. 我们利用601个经审计的身份配对与经过验证的Devanagari和拉丁文形式来研究这种效果,并持有问题和关系。 Quen2.5-7B的同人精度从拉丁文的35.1%下降到马拉地语的Devanagari的8.5%,而不同人精度仍然高于98%. 对五个模式的评价显示出明显的反应偏差,减少象征性分散并不能可靠地弥补差距。 在374个被审计的马来亚拉姆对子上复制设计,由同一个实体建造,复制了第二个脚本和语言家族的效应:同人精度降至5.3%,约为对应的德瓦纳加里率的一半,而比值仍以0.925 AUROC在非匹配名称之上排列. 拉丁训练的探测器从德瓦纳加里州回收标签信息,在相似度匹配的底片下超过弦特征基线. Scalar校准恢复了87%的原始模型-概率平衡-准确性差距,确定决定标准位置为主要贡献者. 激活补丁对Quen中层第二个实体的因果灵敏度;一个共享灵敏度方向转移大约一半的全态比值修正. 现场的实事求是干预使被搁置的马拉地同人精度从6.5%提高到33.5%,不同人精度达到98.5%. 这些结果共同将基于脚本的歧视与标准位置区分开来,并确定了改进身份判断的因果地点。

articles.title: HERD: Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation for Continual Learning
articles.content: Continual learning requires a model to keep acquiring new skills and knowledge without compromising its existing capabilities. Parametric methods suffer from catastrophic forgetting and loss of plasticity. Non-parametric methods, such as prompts, skills, and harnesses, leverage in-context learning but are limited by context length and lossy plain-text compression. To effectively combine their complementary strengths, we propose HERD (Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation), a hybrid continual learning framework that learns efficiently in the harness and internalizes experience into cumulative capabilities via distillation. On the harness side, HERD continually refines its skills to capture reusable patterns, while retaining high-residual examples that the skills fail to capture in a bounded memory. On the parameter side, HERD performs drift-constrained distillation with dual anchors, substantially reducing forgetting over long recursive runs. On the 25-stage task stream of TRACE+17, under fixed memory and compute budgets, HERD matches the strongest parametric baseline in new-task acquisition while exhibiting the least forgetting and the strongest retention of general capabilities.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HERD: 持续学习的适应性变化
articles.content_zh: 持续学习需要一种模式,在不损害现有能力的情况下不断获得新的技能和知识。 参数方法有灾难性的遗忘和丧失可塑性。 非参数化方法,如提示,技能,和调用,调用context学习,但受上下文长度和丢失的纯文本压缩的限制. 为了有效地结合它们互补的长处,我们提出HERD(Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation),这是一个混合的不断学习框架,通过蒸馏有效地学习利用经验并将经验内化为累积能力. 在拉带方面,HERD不断完善其技能,以捕捉可重复使用的模式,同时保留技能未能捕捉到在限定内存中的高残留实例. 在参数方面,HERD用双锚进行漂移受约束的蒸馏,大大减少长时间的递归运行导致的遗忘。 在TRACE+17的25个阶段任务流中,在固定内存和计算预算下,HERD匹配新任务获取中最强的参数基线,同时表现出对一般能力的最小遗忘和最强保留.

articles.title: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Large Language Models to a Low-Resource Agglutinative Language: A Corpus, Datasets, and a Reproducible Benchmark for the Bashkir Language
articles.content: Bashkir is a low-resource agglutinative language written in Cyrillic and remains poorly represented in modern LLMs. We present an open resource suite and a systematic benchmark of adaptation methods: the Bashkir Web Corpus (71,567 documents, 46.9M tokens, 16 sources) and three labelled datasets for binary, multiclass and multilabel text classification; the benchmark covers the first two. Experiments use eight architectures (82M-8B: DistilGPT2, GPT-2 base/medium, Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B, YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B, mBERT, XLM-R) and three adaptation groups (full fine-tuning, QLoRA, in-context learning), plus continual pretraining (CPT). (1) QLoRA on 3.8-8B models outperforms encoder-only fine-tuning on binary classification: YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B with CPT reaches macro-F1 0.748 vs 0.653 (XLM-R) and 0.650 (mBERT); pairwise differences are significant after Holm correction (p<0.001). (2) YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B significantly outperforms Mistral-7B and Phi-3-mini on multiclass classification, BPB and native-speaker ratings (mean 3.28 vs 2.52 and 2.22; n=100; alpha=0.69-0.77; p<0.05); on binary classification its QLoRA advantage is not significant (p>=0.084). (3) CPT effects depend on model and task: perplexity improves for Phi-3-mini (+0.58) and YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B (+0.33) but worsens for Mistral-7B (-1.15, p<0.001); on binary classification CPT helps Mistral-7B most (+4.0 macro-F1). (4) Tokeniser fertility on Bashkir varies 2.67x (2.92-7.80) and tracks adaptation quality, while perplexity across tokenisers is not comparable. Cyrillic tokenisers with Russian pretraining are preferable; LLM judges reproduce native ratings for grammar and coherence (rho=0.33-0.46) but not language correctness (rho=0.16, p=0.11); native evaluation remains necessary. All artefacts are open-licensed.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Bashkir 语言可复制基准
articles.content_zh: 巴什基尔语(Bashkir)是一种用西里尔语书写的低资源杂质语言,在现代LLMs中仍然代表性差. 我们提出了一个开放的资源套件和适应方法的系统基准:Bashkir Web Corpus(71 567份文件,46.9M令牌,16个来源)和三套标签数据集,用于二进制、多类和多标签文本分类;基准涵盖前两个。 实验采用8个架构(82M-8B:DistilGPT2,GPT-2基/中,Phi-3-mini,Mistral-7B,YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B,mBERT,XLM-R)和3个适应组(全微调,QLORA,内文学习),外加持续预训(CPT). (1)3.8-8B型号上的QLORA在二进制分类上仅优于编码器的微调:带有CPT的YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B达到宏F1 0.748对0.653(XLM-R)和0.650(mBERT);在Holm校正(p<0.001)后,成对差异相当大. (2) YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B在多类分类,BPB和本地语的评分(平均3.28对2.52和2.22;n=100;alpha=0.69-0.77;p<0.05)上明显优于Mistral-7B和Phi-3-mini;在二进制分类上其QLORA的优势并不显著(p>=0.084). (3)CPT效应取决于模型和任务:Phi-3-mini(+0.58)和YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B(+0.33)的复杂度提高,但Mistral-7B(-1.15,p<0.01)的复杂度则恶化;关于二进制分类,CPT帮助Mistral-7B(+4.0宏-F1)最多. (4) Bashkir的Tokeniser生育率为2.67x(2.92-7.80),并跟踪适应质量,而不同标志剂之间的复杂程度是无法比较的。 带有俄语预训的西里尔语代词器更为可取;LLM法官对语法和一致性进行复制(rho=0.33-0.46),但不进行语言正确性(rho=0.16,p=0.11);本土评价仍有必要. 所有艺术品都持有开放许可证。

articles.title: A Task-Centric Survey of Long-Document Visual Question Answering: Taxonomy, Evolution, and Future Directions
articles.content: Visual document understanding is essential for acquiring knowledge from visually rich documents and is attracting growing research interest. Existing surveys emphasize architectures or technical approaches, with limited attention to how task bottlenecks shape technical choices and research priorities. We present a task-centric survey that decomposes long-document visual question answering (VQA) into four components: document parsing, evidence organization and retrieval, generator organization and learning, and evaluation. For each, we develop a fine-grained taxonomy and trace motivations, technical responses, and cross-component connections. We focus on explicit retrieval while covering direct reading. Our temporal analysis traces expanding priorities from multimodal content understanding to sufficient, high-fidelity evidence acquisition and sustained evidence management. We outline future directions in evidence sufficiency, verifiable and correctable understanding, and budget-aware coordination, with an outlook on continual document understanding.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 长文件视觉问题专题调查 答复:分类学、演变和未来方向
articles.content_zh: 视觉文件理解对从视觉丰富的文件中获取知识至关重要,并正在吸引越来越多的研究兴趣。 现有的调查强调结构或技术方法,对任务瓶颈如何决定技术选择和研究优先事项的关注有限。 我们提出了一个以任务为中心的调查,将长文件的视觉问题回答(VQA)分为四个部分:文件解析、证据组织和检索、生成器组织和学习以及评价。 对于每一个,我们发展出精细的分类学和微量的动机,技术反应,以及交叉组件连接. 我们的重点是明确检索,同时涵盖直接阅读。 我们的时间分析可追溯到从了解多式联运内容到充分、高可靠性证据的获取和持续的证据管理等优先事项的扩大。 我们概述了证据充足性、可核查和可更正的理解以及预算意识协调方面的未来方向,并展望持续的文件理解。

articles.title: AfterDeleteBench: Auditing Post-Deletion Information Persistence in LLM Agents
articles.content: Many LLM agents maintain external persistent memory and derive additional state from past interactions, such as summaries. Deleting an original memory record therefore need not remove information carried by its descendants. We introduce AfterDeleteBench, a controlled behavioral audit for this failure mode in fixed-weight LLM agents. For each synthetic secret, we compare an exposed-then-deleted agent with an otherwise matched agent that was never exposed to the secret, allowing post-deletion recovery to be attributed to the original exposure. In our primary setting, a single query recovers the deleted secret from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct in roughly two thirds of cases, while matched never-exposed controls have zero recovery. Crucially, recovery does not require a surviving verbatim copy: when the complete secret string is absent and only separately stored components remain under a public composition rule, exact reconstruction succeeds in 62-99% of cases across Qwen, Mistral, and Phi-3. We also show that the response interface is part of the measurement system: target-bearing replies can be scored as failures when the requested format and parser are misaligned. Finally, we separate reconstruction from write-back and fresh-session recall. Provenance-aware closure eliminates observed recovery in the tested positive-baseline settings, whereas an exact-literal write filter blocks reinsertion but cannot erase information already present. Together, these results show that source deletion should be evaluated behaviorally at the level of the agent and its memory system, not only as a storage operation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Delete Bench之后: LLM 代理中审计删除后信息持久性
articles.content_zh: 许多LLM代理维持外部持久性内存,并从以往的相互作用中获取额外的状态,如摘要. 因此,删除原始记忆记录无需删除其后代携带的信息。 我们引入了AfterDelete Bench, 一个控制的行为审计 对于这种故障模式的固定重量LLM代理。 对于每一个合成秘密,我们比较一个当时被曝光的被删除的剂与一个从未接触过该秘密的原本匹配的剂,使得去除后的恢复可以归结于最初的暴露. 在我们的初级设定中,一个单一的查询在大约三分之二的情况下恢复了Quen2.5-7B-Instruct中被删除的秘密,而匹配的永不暴露的控制则零恢复. 关键是,恢复不需要幸存的逐字记录:当完全秘密字符串不存在,并且只有单独储存的组件仍然处于公共构成规则之下时,准确的重建成功在Quen,Mistral,和Phi-3等62-99%的病例中. 我们还显示,响应界面是测量系统的一部分:当所请求的格式和解析器错配时,有目标的响应可以作为失败计分. 最后,我们把重建与回信和复会分开。 证据意识的关闭消除了在经过测试的正基线环境中观察到的恢复,而精确的书写过滤块则重新输入,但不能抹去已经存在的信息。 这些结果共同表明,源删除应在代理及其内存系统层面的行为评价,而不仅仅是作为存储操作.

articles.title: CrisiLangs: A Multilingual Resource for Crisis Warning Generation
articles.content: Communicating with the public during an emergency entails issuing warning messages promptly. In Europe, it often requires producing them in more than one language. Recent work has shown that language models can be trained to generate warning messages as a crisis unfolds, but the available data covers only English. To fill this gap, we present CrisiLangs, a multilingual extension of CrisiText (an English dataset of crisis events paired with warning messages written according to expert communication guidelines) to Italian, Bulgarian, German, and Greek. Expert native speakers translated the warning messages of 1,000 events drawn from 411 scenarios, for a total of 5,000 event-message pairs across five languages. We test the resource to fine-tune a multilingual model on all five languages jointly, with and without the emergency guidelines in the prompt, and compare it with a zero-shot baseline. The fine-tuned models outperform the baseline on ROUGE-L, BLEU and BERTScore in every language and configuration. In a human preference study, low decoding temperatures receive the most preferences in all five languages and in both configurations, while the effect of the guidelines varies by language.

articles.title_zh: CrisiLangs:用于危机预警生成的多种语言资源
articles.content_zh: 在紧急情况下与公众沟通需要迅速发布警告信息。 在欧洲,它常常需要用一种以上语言制作. 最近的工作表明,随着危机的发生,可以培训语言模型生成警告信息,但现有数据只涵盖英语。 为了填补这一空白,我们向意大利、保加利亚、德国和希腊介绍CrisiText(危机事件的英文数据集,加上根据专家通信准则编写的警告信息)。 本地专家演讲者翻译了从411场情景中提取的1 000个事件的警告信息,共计5 000个事件信息对5种语言。 我们测试资源,对所有五种语言的多语种模式进行精细调整,同时迅速制定和不制定应急指导方针,并与零镜头基线进行比较。 微调模型在每种语言和配置上都超过了ROUGE-L、BLEU和BERTScore的基线。 在一项人类偏好研究中,低解码温度在所有五种语言和两种配置中都得到最多的偏好,而准则的效果则因语言而异.

articles.title: SurveyGraph: Generating Academic Surveys via Methods-Entity Knowledge Graphs
articles.content: Most automated survey generation systems retrieve papers as flat documents, limiting their ability to capture research structure. We present SurveyGraph, a framework built around a Methods-Entity Knowledge Graph (MEKG) encoding method-level follow-on, competition, and shared-resource relations. The graph supports core-paper discovery, retrieval, hybrid outlining, and evidence-gated narrative synthesis. We evaluate retrieval, semantic edges, citation grounding, collection coverage, and generation-stage components. In a controlled seven-method equal-budget benchmark, MEKG-anchored fusion balances recall and structural density, with an independent co-citation check. In a separate archived graph-native diagnostic, graph-aware retrieval nearly doubles recall over flat lexical baselines across eight runs (p = 0.004). A semantic evidence gate achieves AUC = 0.75. Audits of 160 generated sentences find 80.6% anchored-or-partial citation support. Human adjudication of 108 stratified semantic edges finds 68.5% supported-or-partial relations (binary-support Cohen's kappa = 0.64), with improves strongest (80.6%) and extends weakest (52.8%). A SurveyBench-facing collection probe reaches mean reference coverage of 0.521 across four topics with an eight-paper budget. Same-backend Qwen diagnostics on a 30-paper/74-relation graph show reduced organization signals when hybrid outlining is removed. Concurrent-system comparisons provide bounded context rather than matched-backend end-to-end evidence. The results position MEKG as an auditable structural layer for typed diagnostics, relation-specific filtering, and controlled survey generation. Code and artifacts: https://github.com/xzzvsxd/SurveyGraph.
