articles.title_zh: SurveyGraph:通过方法-实体知识图生成学术调查
articles.content_zh: 大多数自动化的勘测生成系统将论文作为平面文件检索,限制了它们捕捉研究结构的能力. 我们介绍调查Graph,这是一个围绕方法-实体知识图(MEKG)编码方法层面的后续、竞争和共享资源关系的框架。 该图支持核心纸的发现,检索,混合概述,以及证据化的叙事综合. 我们评价检索、语义边缘、引号定位、收集覆盖和生成阶段组件。 在受控的七法平预算基准中,MEKG-安心核聚变平衡召回和结构密度,并有独立的引用检查. 在单独存档的图-内在诊断中,图-知的检索几乎翻了一番,比八行的平面法基线(p=0.004)。 语义证据门实现AUC=0.75. 对160个生成的句子的审计发现有80.6%的锁定或部分引用支持. 对108个分层语义边缘的人类判断发现68.5%的支持-或部分关系(二元-支持科恩的kappa=0.64),改善最强(80.6%),扩展最弱(52.8%). 一项调查奔驰收集探测器在有8份文件预算的四个题目上的平均参考覆盖率为0.521。 30纸/74-关系图上的同后端Quen诊断显示混合图解时组织信号减少. 同时期系统比较提供了有约束的上下文,而不是匹配的后端端到端的证据. 结果将MEKG定位为可审计的结构层,用于打字诊断,针对关系进行过滤,以及可控调查生成. 代码和文物:https://github.com/xzzvsxd/SurveyGraph. 中国植物物种信息数据库.

articles.title: When LLMs Forget What They Believe: Characterizing State Integrity Collapse in Long-Horizon Dialogues
articles.content: Large language models can repeat an instruction while failing to keep obeying it. We study this recall-compliance dissociation in long-horizon dialogue and define State Integrity Collapse: a model preserves a stated constraint in memory but stops applying it to later turns. We introduce StateTrack-Bench, a controlled suite of conversations covering numerical, format, role/persona, factual-memory, and logical-rule constraints. Across seven provider-pinned model snapshots and five dialogue-depth probes, strict joint retention ranges from 62.4% to 100.0%, with degradation concentrated in symbolic constraints and in one especially brittle model. A forked recall audit shows that 88.6% of observed failures are behavioral-drift failures rather than ordinary forgetting; excluding the brittle outlier preserves this diagnosis (84.4% of failures). Extended evaluations at depths up to 50 turns confirm that the dissociation persists beyond the core benchmark, while Structured State Anchoring recovers up to 24.4 points on immutable constraints. The results show that reliability cannot be inferred from single-turn instruction following alone; evaluation must track whether remembered constraints remain operational as dialogue state grows. Code and artifacts are available at: https://github.com/xzzvsxd/StateTrack.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当LLMS忘记他们相信的东西:在长视野对话中描述国家廉政崩溃
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型可以重复一个指令,同时无法继续遵守它. 我们研究了这种在长距离对话中的召回遵守分离,并界定了国家廉政崩溃:一个模式保留了已申明的记忆限制,但不再将其应用于以后的转变。 我们介绍"国家追踪-奔驰"(StateTrack-Bench),这是一套控制下的对话套件,涵盖数字,格式,角色/人物,事实记忆,逻辑规则限制. 在7个供应商支持的模型快照和5个对话深入的探针中,严格的联合留存率从62.4%到100.0%不等,退化集中在象征性制约和一种特别简陋的模型中。 一次伪造的召回审计表明,88.6%的观察到的失败是行为驱动的失败,而不是普通的遗忘;排除脆性外延则维持了这种诊断(84.4%的失败)。 深入到50度的扩展评价证实,分离持续超过核心基准,而结构化国家安打则在不可改变的制约下恢复了24.4分。 结果显示,仅靠单回合指示是无法推断可靠性的;评价必须跟踪人们所铭记的制约因素是否随着对话国的增长而仍在运作。 密码和文物见:https://github.com/xzzvsxd/StateTrack.

articles.title: Cola2: Co-Adaptive Hierarchical Language Modeling with Continuous Semantic Compression and Balanced Discrete Generation
articles.content: Hierarchical language generation separates continuous semantic modeling from discrete text realization, but its effectiveness depends on what the latent space compresses and how the discrete generator uses it. We propose Cola2, a framework that jointly studies continuous semantic compression, the balance between reconstruction and generation, and continuous-discrete co-adaptation. Cola2 dynamically segments text into semantic spans, controls the compression rate through auxiliary-loss-free negative feedback, and combines reconstruction and generation supervision to learn compact, predictive latent representations. A block-causal masked diffusion decoder is trained with clean, noisy, and dropped latent conditions, while classifier-free guidance adjusts the balance between semantic reconstruction and autonomous generation. Token-prediction gradients update the encoder through the latents, whereas Flow Matching prior learning is decoupled from representation learning by stop-gradient. During inference, generated text is re-encoded under a fixed span layout to keep the latent history consistent with the actual text context. Experiments on five downstream tasks with about 210 billion training tokens validate the core designs and show competitive, unsaturated scaling. With 346.03 billion source tokens, an unconverged checkpoint reaches a 60.10 average across eight tasks and surpasses Llama-3-8B on HellaSwag and StoryCloze despite its reported pretraining budget being over 43 times larger. These results demonstrate the potential of continuous-latent hierarchical language generation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Cola2: 具有连续语义压缩和平衡分解生成功能的共动等级语言模型
articles.content_zh: 分级语言生成将连续语义模型与离散文本实现区分开来,但其有效性取决于潜在空间压缩的内容以及离散生成器如何使用. 我们提出可乐2,这个框架共同研究连续语义压缩,重建与生成的平衡,以及连续-分散共适应. Cola2动态地将文本分解为语义跨度,通过辅助-无损失的负反馈控制压缩速率,并结合重建与生成监督来学习紧凑,预测潜在的表达. 区块-caus的遮盖扩散解码器以干净、吵闹和下降的潜在条件进行训练,而无分类的制导则调整语义重建和自主生成之间的平衡。 Token-预测梯度通过潜伏更新编码器,而Flow匹配之前的学习则通过停级来与表现学习脱钩. 在推论期间,生成的文本在固定的跨度布局下重新编码,以使潜在的历史与实际文本上下文保持一致. 5个下游任务的实验用约2100亿的训练符号验证了核心设计,并表现出有竞争力,不饱和的缩放. 拥有3460.3亿个源代码的检查站在8项任务中平均达到60.10个,在HelaSwag和SoryCloze上超过了Llama-3-8B,尽管其培训前预算是43倍以上。 这些结果显示了连续的层次语言生成的潜力.

articles.title: The Value of Memory in Language Agents
articles.content: Memory enables language agents to carry useful distinctions from past experience into future decisions. Its value depends on which distinctions survive, whether a bounded agent can use them, and what can be recovered or revised as demands evolve. We develop a decision-theoretic framework that follows this value from raw history through persistent state, operational use, and costly recovery and revision. Original and retained value are expressed in units of avoided task loss; risk-cost frontiers describe attainable recovery and preservation across uses. Unknown demand yields value profiles, while interactive feedback changes the distribution of future work. A cost-aware simulation condition and five minimal counterexamples expose the roles of information timing, retrieval access, component interaction, feedback and demand uncertainty. In particular, a pointer with zero mutual information about the answer can still reduce the cost of exact recovery. Diagnostics on LoCoMo, a two-project update task and longitudinal cases exhibit failures of preservation, use and measurement. At fixed retrieved evidence, a saved ledger changes subsequent answers; at fixed agent outputs, an evaluator revision changes scores. The framework connects these distinctions to operational risk bounds and testable principles for allocating memory, preserving recovery options and revising evidence dependencies.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语言代理人记忆的价值
articles.content_zh: 记忆使语言代理人能够将过去经验的有益区别带入未来决策。 其价值取决于哪些区别继续存在,受约束的代理人是否可以使用这些区别,以及随着需求的演变可以回收或修订哪些区别。 我们发展了一个决策理论框架,通过持续状态、实际使用以及代价高昂的复原和修订,从原始历史中遵循这一价值。 原始价值和留存价值以避免任务损失的单位表示;风险成本边界是指可实现的回收和各种用途的保全。 未知的需求输出值配置,而交互式反馈则改变未来工作的分布. 具有成本意识的模拟条件和五个最小的反例揭示了信息时间、检索访问、组件互动、反馈和需求不确定性的作用。 特别是,一个对答案没有共同信息的指针仍然可以降低准确回收的成本. 关于LoCoMo的诊断,一个两项目更新任务和纵向病例显示保存、使用和衡量失败。 在固定检索的证据中,保存的分类账会改变随后的答案;在固定代理产出中,评价员的修订会改变分数。 该框架将这些区分与业务风险界限和可验证的原则联系起来,用于分配内存、保存恢复选项和修订证据依赖性。

articles.title: CoWriter: Guiding Methodological and Synergetic Human-LLM Co-Authoring
articles.content: While LLMs have transformed text generation, standard chat-and-canvas interfaces often reduce human authoring to quite passive supervision, causing review fatigue, over-reliance on AI, and the sidelining of the human role in long-form, source-grounded writing. Prior systems typically address isolated writing phases, leaving comprehensive end-to-end human-LLM collaboration largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce CoWriter, a proactive agentic scheme that adapts expert human (co-)authoring methodologies from cognitive science to flexibly steer the entire writing workflow while actively encouraging the user to engage. In an exploratory user study, compared to a standard LLM baseline, authors using CoWriter better expressed their perspectives and maintained a higher sense of document ownership, supported quantitatively by $2.2\times$ more successful agent engagements. Furthermore, external reader judges rated the resulting texts higher in "human touch" qualities like storytelling and integrating unique personal experiences. Overall, our results demonstrate that proactively engaging users through established human practices is beneficial for effective LLM-supported co-authoring, providing useful methodologies, techniques and insights for future research on collaborative agents.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 作者:指导方法和协同人类-LLM 共同授权
articles.content_zh: 虽然LLMS改变了文本生成方式,但标准聊天和canvas接口往往将人类的作者化为相当被动的监督,导致审查疲劳,过度依赖AI,在长形式,源头基础的写作中将人类角色放在一边. 先前的系统一般处理孤立的写作阶段,使得全面的端对端人-LLM合作基本上没有得到探讨. 在本文中,我们引入了CoWriter,这是一种主动的代理计划,它从认知科学中调整了专家的(共同)作者方法,以灵活地引导整个写作工作流程,同时积极鼓励用户参与. 与标准的LLM基线相比,在一项探索性用户研究中,使用CoWriter的作者更好地表达了他们的观点,并保持了更高的文件所有权感,在数量上得到了2.2美元更成功的代理业务的支持。 此外,外部读者评委将由此产生的文字评为"人类触摸"的品质更高,如讲故事和融合独特的个人经历. 总体而言,我们的成果表明,通过既定的人类做法,主动让用户参与,有利于由LLM支持的有效共同撰写,为今后关于协作代理人的研究提供有用的方法、技术和见解。

articles.title: Memory-Aware Reward Modeling: Learning Human Preferences for LLM Memory Use
articles.content: Memory enables language model assistants to maintain continuity across sessions and generate personalized responses, but knowing more about a user does not necessarily produce responses they prefer. Existing evaluations assess memory capabilities without directly establishing whether memory use benefits the user. To study this gap, we collect approximately 1,000 pairwise judgments from 87 participants using their own ChatGPT queries and personal memories. We find that memory-conditioned responses are not consistently preferred over responses generated without memory and in some cases, users strongly prefer the latter. Automatic evaluators also show limited agreement with users and favor memory-conditioned responses substantially more often than users do. Motivated by these gaps, we introduce a memory-aware reward model that learns from user judgments, achieving 72.8\% preference prediction accuracy and outperforming the existing baselines. Our findings motivate evaluation and optimization objectives that align memory use with the preferences of the people whose information is being used.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 内存- 提醒奖励建模: 为 LLM 内存使用学习人类首选项
articles.content_zh: 内存使语言模型助理能够保持会话的连续性,生成个性化的响应,但更多了解一个用户并不一定产生他们喜欢的响应. 现有评价评估内存能力时没有直接确定内存的使用是否有利于用户. 为了研究这一差距,我们利用他们自己的ChatGPT查询和个人记忆,从87名参与者那里收集了大约1 000个双向判断。 我们发现,与无记忆反应相比,有内存条件的反应并非一贯优先,在某些情况下,用户更倾向于后者。 自动评价员也显示与用户的一致程度有限,比用户更倾向于内存条件化的回复。 基于这些差距,我们引入了一个记忆意识奖励模型,从用户判断中吸取教训,实现72.8+Q偏好预测准确性,并超越现有基线。 我们的调查结果激励着评价和优化目标,使记忆的使用与信息使用对象的偏好相一致。

articles.title: A Systematic Comparison of Search Space Complexity and Efficiency for Time-Synchronous End-to-End ASR Models
articles.content: Search is a central component of Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems and has been deeply investigated for classical ASR modeling based on Hidden Markov Models (HMMs). However, in work on current sequence-to-sequence ASR architectures it is often simplified to a small fixed-size beam search without external Language Model (LM). In this work, we present a comparative analysis of search space complexity and efficiency for Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) and neural transducer models under different pruning strategies and LM configurations. We show that these end-to-end (E2E) models work with a small search space most of the time but exhibit large temporary peaks in hypothesis count during periods of uncertainty. Score-based pruning dynamically adapts the search to model uncertainty, leading to a significantly lower Real-Time Factor (RTF). Our results highlight the limitations of search with low fixed-size beam pruning and provide practical guidelines for efficient search in E2E ASR.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 搜索空间复杂度和效率的系统比较
articles.content_zh: 搜索是自动语音识别(ASR)系统的核心组成部分,对于基于Hide Markov Models(HMMM)的经典ASR模型,已经进行了深入的调查. 然而,在目前序列到序列的ASR架构的作品中,往往被简化为没有外部语言模型(LM)的小型固定大小束搜索. 在这项工作中,我们根据不同的推力战略和LM配置,对连接器时间分类(CTC)和神经传导器模型的搜索空间复杂性和效率进行了比较分析。 我们显示,这些端对端(E2E)模型在大部分时间都与一个小的搜索空间一起工作,但在不确定时期的假说计数中却表现出了很大的临时峰值. 基于分数的奔跑动态地将搜索调整为模型不确定性,导致实时因子(RTF)显著降低. 我们的成果突出了使用低固定尺寸光束进行搜索的局限性,并为在E2E ASR中高效搜索提供了实用指南.

articles.title: IndoNutriQA: An Indonesian Clinical Nutrition Question Answering Benchmark
articles.content: Clinical Question Answering (QA) underpins Clinical Intelligent Decision Support Systems, but progress is severely limited for low-resource languages such as Indonesian by the absence of public domain-specific data. We introduce IndoNutriQA, an expert-curated Indonesian clinical QA benchmark of 911 question-answer pairs built from real clinical-nutrition reports. Rather than a large-scale training corpus, it is positioned as a high-quality evaluation resource: every pair is grounded in a clinically relevant context, enriched with structured metadata (anthropometric assessment, medical diagnosis, document provenance, chunk segmentation). Eight standardised question types following the Nutrition Care Process (NCP), including the Problem, Etiology, Sign and Symptom (PES) diagnosis statement, are answered for every report, which was written by a graduate-level dietetic intern, by one of three nutritionists. Answers are free-form clinical prose rather than extractive spans, and an expert validation study finds 6-10% of reference answers contestable. The dataset supports generative, extractive and retrieval-augmented QA as well as zero- and few-shot LLM evaluation. We report fine-tuned baselines (IndoBERT variants, mT5, RAG) with 5-fold cross-validation, learning curves and bootstrap 95% confidence intervals, and benchmark eight contemporary LLMs zero- and five-shot. We further calibrate our LLM-as-judge rubric against three expert raters (one RD, two nutritionists), finding it human-comparable on factuality and completeness but unreliable on clinical safety, and a human error analysis shows it misses unsupported content that the raters identify. IndoNutriQA is released to foster research in Indonesian clinical NLP and nutritional decision support.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: IndoNutriQA:印度尼西亚临床营养问题回答基准
articles.content_zh: 临床问答(QA)支撑了临床智能决策支持系统,但由于缺乏公共领域特定数据,印尼语等低资源语言的进展受到严重限制. 我们介绍IndoNutriQA,这是根据真实的临床营养状况报告构建的911个问答对印尼临床QA的专家测试基准. 与其说是大规模的培训大纲,不如说是高质量的评价资源:每对评价都以临床相关背景为基础,以结构化的元数据(人体测量评估、医学诊断、文件出处、块块分割)为基础。 营养护理进程之后的8个标准化问题类型,包括问题、胚胎学、征兆学和症状学诊断说明,每份报告都得到回答,由3名营养学家之一的研究生一级营养实习生撰写。 答案是自由形式的临床传言而不是采掘跨度,专家论证研究发现6-10%的参考答案有争议. 该数据集支持基因、采掘和检索强化的质量保证以及零镜头和几镜头LLM评价。 我们报告微调基线(IndoBERT变体,mT5,RAG),有5倍的交叉验证,学习曲线和95%的置信间隔,以及8个当代LLMs零和5发的基准. 我们进一步校准我们的LLM-as-judge语句与3位专家测评员(一位RD,两位营养学家)的对比,发现它与事实和完整性相比,但对于临床安全来说并不可靠,而一项人为误差分析显示它错过了测评员认定的不支持的内容. IndoNutriQA的发布是为了促进印度尼西亚临床NLP的研究和营养决策支持.

articles.title: Predicting Music Valence and Arousal via Textual and Multimodal In-Context Learning in Large Language Models
articles.content: While arousal can be reliably predicted from musical audio, emotional valence remains difficult to model due to its subjective and context-dependent nature. In this work, we investigate the potential of in-context learning (ICL) with large language models to advance continuous valence and arousal prediction. Rather than predicting emotion scores directly, our framework leverages contextual demonstrations from an auxiliary dataset to refine the initial predictions produced by a small, task-specific base model. We systematically evaluate a text-based ICL variant using lyrics and generated audio captions, alongside a multimodal variant that incorporates raw audio signals. Using the entire MER60 dataset strictly as a held-out test set, our experiments demonstrate substantial performance gains, particularly for valence. Text-based ICL improves the valence $R^2$ from 0.110 to 0.427 with 80 demonstration shots, while the multimodal variant achieves 0.346 with only 10 shots. These findings suggest that training-free ICL offers an effective inference-time strategy for current language models to predict continuous music emotion.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过大语文模式的文字和多式文体学习预测音乐的安定和振奋
articles.content_zh: 虽然从音乐音频中可以可靠地预测出振荡,但由于其主观性和环境依赖性,情感的华丽仍然难以建模. 在这部作品中,我们研究了用大语言模型来推进连续的振荡和振奋性的预测(ICL)学习(ICL)的潜力. 我们的框架不是直接预测情绪的得分,而是利用辅助数据集的背景演示来完善由小型任务特定基模型产生的初步预测. 我们利用歌词系统地评价一个基于文本的ICL变体,并生成音频标题,以及一个包含原始音频信号的多式联运变体。 严格地将整个MER60数据集用作一个搁置的测试集,我们的实验显示出了巨大的性能收益,特别是对于价值。 基于文本的ICL改进了价值$R^2美元,从0.110美元提高到0.427美元,并配有80个演示镜头,而多式联运变体仅配有10个镜头就达到了0.346个. 这些发现表明,无培训的ICL为当前语言模型预测持续音乐情感提供了一个有效的推论时间策略.

articles.title: Investigating Multi-Cultural Value Selection Biases in LLMs
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) serve users whose cultural identities are multi-layered, yet cultural evaluations commonly reduce identity to one label. In this work, we study LLMs under simultaneous identity cues, with a country persona in the system prompt and a second identity signaled in the user turn, either by naming a country (explicit cue) or through the query language (implicit cue). We test World Values Survey (WVS) multiple-choice probing and open-ended sociopolitical generation. In multiple-choice probing, language cues shift answers about three times more than explicit cues but away from the associated country's distribution, and explicit cues do not consistently move answers toward the named country. Across 1.6 million open-ended responses, naming a country closes 30-44% of the gap to the model's own responses for that country, and explicit cues produce more differentiated value changes than language cues. Our results suggest that country and language cues should be evaluated as distinct signals rather than interchangeable proxies for culture.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 调查多种文化 LLMs 中的数值选择比喻
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)服务于其文化特征多层次的用户,然而文化评价通常将身份缩减为一个标签. 在这项工作中,我们同时在身份提示下研究LLMS,系统中的一个国家人物a迅速,用户转弯时第二个身份信号,要么通过命名一个国家(明确提示),要么通过查询语言(隐含提示). 我们测试世界价值调查(WVS)多选择测试和开放的社会政治一代. 在多选择的测试中,语言提示转移的答案大约是明确提示的三倍,却远离了相关国家的分布,而明确提示的答案并不一致地向被点名的国家移动。 在160万个无限制的回复中, 我们的结果表明,国家和语言提示应被评价为不同的信号,而不是文化的可互换代词。

articles.title: When More Metadata Misleads: Probing Field-Level Grounding in LLM-Generated Museum Descriptions
articles.content: Metadata-conditioned generation is often framed as a data-to-text task in which additional input fields should improve grounding. Museum description generation challenges this assumption because catalogue records are heterogeneous, partially visual, and unevenly documented across geographic regions. We study how metadata composition shapes the generation of artefact descriptions through a two-phase framework. Phase 1 analyses natural metadata variation in a large museum collection, where field count, field type, image availability, and Place co-vary. Phase 2 introduces controlled field probes that hold object identity fixed while varying metadata quantity, field type, and image access. Our results show that metadata quantity alone does not explain generation behaviour. Field type determines whether models ground, omit, or infer information, while images can both support visual grounding and increase unsupported interpretation. More broadly, our findings show that metadata-conditioned data-to-text evaluation should assess field- and claim-level support, rather than relying only on aggregate input coverage or reference similarity.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当更多元数据时 错误领导:在LLM-Generated博物馆进行实地地面探测
articles.content_zh: 以元数据为条件的生成常常被设定为数据到文本的任务,在这种任务中,额外的输入字段应改善基础。 博物馆描述生成质疑这一假设,因为目录记录多种多样,部分可视化,而且各地区的记录不均匀。 我们研究元数据组成如何通过两个阶段的框架来形成人工描述的生成。 第1阶段分析大型博物馆藏品中的自然元数据变异,其中的场数,场型,图像可用性,以及Place Co-vary. 第2阶段引入了具有固定对象身份和不同元数据数量、字段类型和图像访问的可控域探测器。 我们的结果显示,仅元数据数量并不能解释生成行为。 字段类型决定模型是地面,省略,还是推断信息,而图像既可以支持视觉地面,又可以增加不支持的解释. 更广泛地说,我们的调查结果表明,以元数据为条件的数据对文本的评价应评估实地和索赔一级的支助,而不应仅仅依赖总输入覆盖面或参考相似性。

articles.title: Prompting Strategy Effects Depend on the Judge: A Multilingual Study of LLM-as-a-Judge Robustness
articles.content: LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation is increasingly applied to multilingual tasks, yet prompting strategies such as Chain-of-Thought and Role Conditioning are recommended based solely on English benchmarks. Whether their effectiveness transfers across judge models and languages remains unknown: prompt-sensitivity studies are largely English-centric, while existing multilingual judge studies fix the prompt template. In this work, we address this gap by measuring this interaction through a benchmark of 9 prompting strategies, 4 open-weight judges, 27 languages, and 4 tasks across 13 datasets, yielding over 1M pointwise scores on gold-reference outputs, validated against human judgments. We find that prompting strategies are not transferable: the choice of the judge model dominates the choice of prompting strategy, strategy effects reverse direction across judges, and stability degrades in low-resource languages, where these effects are concealed by aggregate reporting. These findings show that prompting effects in multilingual evaluation are conditioned on the judge, task, and language. Consequently, prompting strategies should be validated for the intended evaluation setting, and cross-study comparisons should account for both judge and prompt configuration.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 迅速战略影响取决于法官:作为法官的LLM多种语文研究
articles.content_zh: 以法官身份进行的LLM评价越来越多地应用于多种语文任务,但诸如 " 思考链 " 和 " 作用条件 " 等推动性战略完全根据英文基准提出。 其效力在法官模型和语言之间的转移是否仍然未知:即时敏感性研究主要是以英语为中心的,而现有的多语种法官研究则固定了即时模板. 在这项工作中,我们通过衡量这种互动,通过9项激励战略、4名公开量级法官、27种语言和13个数据集的4项任务的基准,解决了这一差距,根据人类的判断,在黄金参考产出上得出了超过1M点的分数。 我们发现,促动战略是不可转移的:选择法官模式主导了促动战略的选择,战略影响在法官中间反向,稳定以低资源语言下降,而综合报告掩盖了这些影响。 这些调查结果表明,多语种评价的促进效果取决于法官、任务和语言。 因此,应该为预期的评价环境验证激励战略,相互学习比较应该既考虑到法官,也考虑到迅速的配置。

articles.title: Beyond Watching and Searching: Benchmarking Agents for Video-centered Deep Research Reports
articles.content: Deep research agents synthesize open-web evidence into long reports, but current benchmarks do not evaluate research centered on a source video. We introduce Video-Centered Deep Research Report Generation. Given a video and user request, an agent identifies research questions, retrieves external multimodal evidence, and produces an interactive report linked to relevant video moments. This task has direct practical value because it helps users locate relevant moments, verify claims, reproduce demonstrated procedures, and make informed decisions from video content. We present a skill-based workflow and OmniDR-Bench for this task. For evaluation, we propose Omni Atomic Rubric Trees (Omni-ARTs). Each tree contains three dimensions, 23 shared directions, and task-specific atomic binary criteria. The directions test audiovisual grounding, multimodal evidence use, and interactive presentation. Audited Rubric Construction (ARC) builds these trees through independent evidence collection, automated checks, behavioral calibration, and iterative human review. OmniDR-Bench contains 50 Chinese and English tasks across 19 realworld subcategories. It includes 6,414 criteria. Across 18 agent configurations, the best system scores 63.3 out of 100. Current agents still need broader content coverage, stronger causal and logical analysis across modalities, and more accurate citation support. We further analyze models, harnesses, skill configurations, video categories, and research trajectories. The code and data are released at https://github.com/marinero4972/OmniDR-Bench.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Beyond Watching and Searching: 以视频为核心的深入研究报告的基准代理
articles.content_zh: 深层研究代理人将开放式网络证据合成长篇报告,但目前的基准并不评价以源视频为中心的研究. 我们介绍以视频为中心的深入研究报告生成。 根据视频和用户请求,一名代理人确定研究问题,检索外部多式联运证据,并制作与相关视频时刻相关的互动报告。 这项任务具有直接的实际价值,因为它有助于用户找到相关时刻,核实索偿要求,复制已显示的程序,并从视频内容作出知情的决定。 我们为这项任务提出了基于技能的工作流程和OmniDR-Bench。 为了评价,我们提议Omni原子Rubric树(Omni-ARTs). 每棵树包含三个维度,23个共同方向,以及任务特定的原子二进制标准. 方向检验视听定位、多式联运证据的使用和互动介绍。 经审计的Rubric Construction(ARC)通过独立收集证据,自动检查,行为校准,以及迭代的人类审查来建造这些树. OmniDR-Bench包含50项中英文任务,跨越19个现实世界亚类. 其中包括6 414项标准。 跨18个代理配置,最佳系统得分63.3分100分. 目前的代理人仍然需要更广泛的内容覆盖面,更强有力的因果和跨模式的逻辑分析,以及更准确的引用支持. 我们进一步分析模型、绳索、技能配置、视频类别和研究轨迹。 该代码和数据公布于https://github.com/marinero4972/OmniDR-Bench.

articles.title: Prompt Sensitivity in Tool-Augmented Model Comparisons
articles.content: Language models are compared on question-answering benchmarks that pose each question in one wording, and a reworded question can change which of two models scores higher. We ask whether giving the models tools makes such comparisons more stable. An accuracy gain cannot answer this, because tools change several steps between the question and the scored answer at once. We propose a matched protocol that separates those steps: the answer readout, reasoning, the decision to call, the tool's answer, and the report supplied without a call. We apply it to six open models in five domains under five wordings. We find that tools raise accuracy where a program answers the question and widen the wording sensitivity of many pairwise comparisons. The widening follows how often a model calls, and call frequency follows the wording for some models and not others. It also depends on the interface and the instructions: a native tool-calling interface and a second tool description leave no detected widening in molecules, and sensitivity persists where tools return intermediate results. These findings show that deterministic reports do not guarantee stable comparisons. We recommend reporting call frequency and comparison stability under several wordings beside accuracy.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 工具强化模型比较中的提示灵敏度
articles.content_zh: 语言模型在以一个措辞提出每个问题的问答基准上进行比较,一个重新措辞的问题可以改变两个模型中哪一个得分较高. 我们问,提供模型工具是否使这种比较更加稳定。 精度增益无法回答这一点,因为工具会同时改变问题和得分答案之间的几个步骤. 我们提出一个将这些步骤分开的匹配协议:答案宣读、推理、打电话的决定、工具的答案和在没有电话的情况下提供的报告。 我们把它应用于五个领域的六个开放模式,五个措辞。 我们发现,当程序回答问题时,工具提高了准确性,并扩大了许多双向比较的措辞敏感性。 拓宽时遵循的是一个模型的调用频率,调用频率也遵循一些模型而不是其他模型的措辞. 它还取决于界面和指令:一个本土的工具调用界面和第二个工具描述没有在分子中检测到的拓宽,当工具返回中间结果时,灵敏度持续. 这些调查结果表明,确定性报告不能保证稳定的比较。 我们建议报告呼叫频率和比较稳定性,除准确性外,还有若干措辞。

articles.title: Mixing Matters: Evidence Position Bias Across Sequence Mixers in Long-Context Question Answering
articles.content: Long-context models often use answer-bearing evidence less effectively when it appears away from a prompt boundary. We compare this position bias across Transformer, state-space, and hybrid Mamba architectures by moving one gold document through a fixed set of nine distractors. The evaluated Transformers show a beginning advantage that the evaluated state-space models lack, while both families favor evidence near the end. A matched pure-versus-hybrid Mamba comparison points in the same direction but remains statistically uncertain. The family difference appears among models that can answer the task. Transformer primacy reappears on synthetic retrieval, where state-space ceiling prevents a family comparison. A corpus swap within one state-space architecture changes overall accuracy without a detectable change in curve shape. Prompt changes can create or nearly remove a beginning advantage. Position remains decodable across architectures even when response curves differ, and attention concentration near initial tokens covaries with beginning sensitivity in the tested Transformer family. These exploratory results show that effective context use depends on the evaluated architecture family, capability, task, and prompt, without isolating the sequence mixer as the sole cause.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 混合事项: 长文问答中的证据位置偏差
articles.content_zh: 长文本模型往往在远离快速边界时使用含答证据的效果较差. 我们比较了变形器、状态空间和混合Mamba架构之间的这种位置偏差, 通过一套固定的9个分散器移动一个金色文件。 被评价的变形金刚显示一个开始的优势,即被评价的状态空间模型缺乏,同时两个家庭都倾向于接近尾声的证据. 与此相对应的纯和假的曼巴比较指向同一方向,但统计上仍然不确定。 家庭差异出现在能够应对任务的模型中. 变形器的首要地位在合成检索中再次出现,其中的状态-空间上限阻止了家庭的比较. 在一个状态-空间架构内进行方块互换,会改变整体准确性,而不发生可察觉的曲线形状变化. 即时变化可以创造或几乎消除开始的优势. 即使在反应曲线不同时,各个架构的位置仍然可以解码,注意力集中在初始信号库附近,在测试过的变形器家族中开始敏感。 这些探索性结果表明,有效上下文的使用取决于评估的架构家族、能力、任务和即时性,而不孤立序列混合器作为唯一原因。

articles.title: Delta N-gram: Forward-Only Continual Writing into a Language Model's Native N-gram Memory
articles.content: Our previous analysis found that a model's native hashed N-gram table is where continual updates disturb the base least, but its writes needed backpropagation and changed the pretrained table. We present Delta N-gram, a forward-only write path into that table. The pretrained table T^0 is never modified. Evidence is written into a sparse patch Δon the rows it addresses: a 4.1M-parameter writer emits a target and a gate per (position, hash head) event, and a block-averaged delta rule keeps each row a convex combination of its old value and the gated targets. The writer is trained offline on raw text with the pretraining objective; at use time writing takes forward passes only, and clearing Δrestores the original model. A 0.6B prototype trained to answer questions keeps 16/16 facts after a second write; online gradient writes keep 2--4/16. We study two writers: a plain writer that encodes evidence with the T^0-only model, and a delta writer that reads its current memory while encoding. On Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, the plain writer's memory is document-specific: on 64 held-out news events it lowers continuation NLL by 0.068 nats/token against empty memory and by 0.024 against another document's memory, and 0.063 and 0.013 after 16 intervening articles. The delta writer's memory is more document-specific and keeps more of it under distraction (70% vs 54%). Over 35,000 writes on our previous seven-task chain both writers stay stable and the delta writer drifts less (layer-2 math drift 176% vs 188%); later accuracy changes by -0.26/-0.52pp (-7.29pp for gradient updates) and small-k_i drift is 17.9/17.5% (39.2%). Acquisition is negative, and general-input drift reaches 32.8% (20.75%): format rows read by every example grow to 4--12 times their pretrained norm. Zeroing eight such rows removes over 98% of layer-2 drift on math inputs, together with their NLL gain.

articles.title_zh: Delta N- gram: 向语言模型的原生 N- gram 内存中仅转发连续写入
articles.content_zh: 我们之前的分析发现,一个模型的原生散列N-gram表是持续更新扰动基数最少的地方,但其书写需要回传,并更改了预训表. 我们给Delta N -gram, 一个只写在桌子上的前进路径。 预训表 T^0 从未修改 。 证据被写成一个零星的补丁 \\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ 4.1M 参数 写出一个目标和一个门, 每( 位置, 散列头) 事件, 和 块平均三角洲规则 \ \ \ \ \ 编剧在原始文本上接受预训目标下的脱机训练;在使用时,写作只取前传,清除QQ重置原型. 接受过回答问题培训的0.6B原型在第二次写完之后保留16/16个事实;在线渐变写完后保留2-4/16个事实. 我们研究两个作家:一个用T^0-只用模型编码证据的普通作家,一个在编码时读取其当前记忆的三角洲作家. 在Quen3.8-Flash-Next上,平面作家的记忆是针对文档的:在64个被搁置的新闻事件中,它将续作NLL降低0.068 nats/token对空存储器,以及0.024对另一个文档的存储器,在16篇干涉文章之后,则降低0.063和0.013. 三角洲作家的内存更具有文档特异性,并让更多的人分心(70%对54%). 超过35,000人写到我们以前的七大任务链上, 写作者都保持稳定, 三角洲写作者漂移较少( 层-2 数学漂移 176%对 188%); 后来的精度变化为 - 0.26/-0.52pp( 梯度更新7. 29pp), 小 k_i漂移为17.9/17. 5%( 39.2%)。 获取是负的,一般输入漂移达到32.8%(20.75%):每个实例所读的格式行增长到4-12倍于其预先训练的规范. 零八个这样的行消除了数学输入中超过98%的层-2漂移,加上它们的NLL增益.

articles.title: Through a PRISM, Clearly: Step-Sequence Reasoning for Mistake Recognition in Procedural Videos
articles.content: Procedural mistake recognition requires identifying deviations from valid multi-step activities. We study post-completion recognition from videos with benchmark-provided step boundaries. We introduce PRISM (Procedural mistake Recognition via Interpretable Semantic Modeling), which grounds video segments in language and maps their descriptions to procedural states using a lightweight hidden Markov model trained on correct executions. Reference alignment and semantic checks identify errors in step content and order. To support evaluation across heterogeneous benchmarks, we map dataset-specific annotations to four edit-based error types: insertion, deletion, substitution, and transposition. Across three benchmarks, we compare gold and VLM-generated descriptions in raw, semantic-role, and action-object forms. Decoder controls show consistent gains from the trained local decoder over nearest-candidate matching, with additional, dataset-dependent benefits from sequence decoding. Semantic role labeling improves Any-F1 in all six matched grounded comparisons, although the gains vary across datasets and do not translate into uniform improvements under separate configuration selection. These results establish language grounding as an effective interface for explicit procedural mistake reasoning and characterize the contributions of representation and decoding.

articles.title_zh: 透过PISM, 很明显: 程序视频中错误识别的步序
articles.content_zh: 程序错误的确认要求查明偏离有效的多步骤活动的情况。 我们研究完成后识别 视频与基准提供的阶梯界限。 我们引入了PISM(通过可解释的语义模型识别程序错误),它用语言将视频部分作为依据,并使用经过正确处决培训的轻量级隐藏的Markov模型将其描述映射到程序状态。 参考对齐和语义检查识别步骤内容和顺序的错误. 为了支持跨不同基准的评价,我们将特定数据集的说明映射到四个基于编辑的错误类型:插入、删除、替换和转置。 在三个基准中,我们用原始、语义作用和动作对象形式比较黄金和VLM产生的描述。 解码器控制显示,从训练有素的本地解码器得到的一致收益大于最近的扫描匹配,还有序列解码带来的更多依赖数据集的好处. 语义角色标签在全部6个匹配的基底比较中改进了Any-F1,虽然收益因数据集而异,在不同的配置选择下并没有转化为统一的改进. 这些结果确立了语言基础,作为明确程序错误推理的有效界面,并说明了代表性和解码的贡献。

articles.title: A Grammar of French Civil Cassation: A Ground-Level Dataset and Tool
articles.content: This paper presents a dataset of 121,536 ground-reasons pairs across 86,464 rulings of the five civil chambers of the French Court of Cassation (2016-2025). An appeal on points of law cannot itself be appealed and often decides a case for good. Understanding how the Court rules is thus crucial and can help lawyers who draft those appeals. Inside a ruling, every ground of appeal (a distinct legal complaint against the appealed decision) has its own answer from the Court. This answer is called the reasons and it belongs to one of a few doctrinal families. Using a deterministic pipeline, we pair each ground with its reasons and attach the pair to its family, according to the established French taxonomy. We obtain a descriptive grammar of civil cassation that shows which grounds succeed, which legal texts they refer to, and how both evolve over the decade. We release the dataset, the code and an interactive consultation tool.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 法国民事上诉法:地面数据集和工具
articles.content_zh: 本文提供了法国最高上诉法院五个民事分庭(2016-2025年)86 464项裁决的121 536对地面理由数据集。 就法律问题提出的上诉本身不能上诉,而且往往要对案件作出合理裁决。 了解法院的规则如何因此至关重要,并能帮助起草这些上诉的律师。 在一项裁决中,每项上诉理由(对上诉裁决提出的不同法律申诉)都有法院的答复。 这个答案叫做原因,属于少数学说家庭之一。 根据法国的既定分类法,我们使用一条确定性管道,将每一块地配上其原因,并附着在它的家族中。 我们获得了民事上诉的描述性语法,它表明哪些理由成功,它们所指的哪些法律文本,以及两者在十年中是如何演变的。 我们发布数据集,代码和一个交互式咨询工具.

articles.title: Learning What to Ask for Tomorrow: Active Preference Acquisition for Long-Term Personalized Web Agents
articles.content: Web agents increasingly serve the same user across repeated online tasks such as booking travel, shopping, and scheduling, so their long-term usefulness depends on how well they know the user's preferences. Passive memory and personalization methods cannot obtain preferences the user never reveals, and clarification methods that value a question by its benefit to the current task overlook the benefit of reusing the answer in later tasks. We study Active Preference Acquisition (APA): which missing preferences are worth the cost of asking? We define the Prospective Personalization Value (PPV) of a missing preference as its expected cumulative utility gain over future tasks minus the effort and disclosure-risk cost of asking, and select questions under a per-interaction budget. We characterize when cumulative reuse justifies acquisition despite insufficient single-task benefit, and evaluate this regime with an initial-profile diagnostic. APA computes the counterfactual gain of each candidate preference on public task prototypes with the agent's own task solver and aggregates it by the expected reuse of each task family. We evaluate it on ActiveWebPref, a controlled longitudinal benchmark with hidden but queryable user profiles and exact task utilities. At a horizon of 20 tasks, 34.4% of budget-feasible valuable missing preferences are amortization-dependent; APA acquires 80.3% of them, whereas current-task value of information acquires 5.1%. Under per-user asking-cost caps matched to APA's realized expenditure, APA achieves higher net utility than four heuristic selection baselines. In our cost setting, asking about every unknown preference yields lower net utility than not asking, while APA recovers 84.2% of its utility gain with 27.6% of its questions. The value of acquiring a user preference should account for its reuse across future tasks, not only its benefit to the task at hand.

articles.title_zh: 学习如何要求明天:长期个人化网络代理的积极优先收购
articles.content_zh: 网络代理越来越多地为同一用户服务,完成多次在线任务,如预订旅行、购物和日程安排,因此其长期效用取决于他们对用户喜好的了解程度。 被动的内存和个人化方法不能获得用户从未透露的偏好,而通过对当前任务的好处来重视一个问题的澄清方法忽略了在后期任务中使用答案的好处. 我们研究Active Presidents Agreement(APA):哪些缺失的优惠值得要求的代价? 我们把缺失的偏好的前景个性化价值定义为:它对未来任务的预期累积效用增益减去询问的努力和披露风险成本,并在每次互动预算下选择问题。 我们说明,尽管单项任务的好处不足,但何时累积再利用才有理由获取,并以初步的诊断方法评估这一制度。 APA用代理商自己的任务解决器计算每个候选者对公共任务原型的偏好反事实收益,并通过预期每个任务家族的再利用来汇总. 我们在ActiveWebPref上评价了它,这是一个有控制的纵向基准,有隐藏但可查询的用户简介和精确的任务公用事业. 在20项任务中,34.4%的预算实际价值缺失偏好依赖摊销;APA获得80.3%,而当前任务的信息价值获得5.1%。 在与APA已实现支出相对应的每个用户问价上限下,APA的净效用高于四个热量选择基线。 在我们的成本设定中,询问每一个未知的偏好产生的净效用低于不询问的净效用,而APA则以27.6%的提问收回其84.2%的效用收益. 获得用户偏好的价值应考虑到它对未来任务的再利用,而不仅仅是它对当前任务的好处。

articles.title: RIFT: KV Cache Compression for Draft Models with Complementary Compressibility Training
articles.content: Speculative decoding is a popular decode acceleration method. As such, it is particularly relevant to long-output generation, which requires an increasingly large KV cache. KV cache compression offers a way to constrain costs in long-context drafting. However, compression methods that focus on prefill information can lose relevance as the output length grows. We term this phenomenon decode staleness and show that it degrades draft model accuracy under selection-based KV cache compression. We introduce RIFT, a family of selection-based KV cache compression strategies that balance prefill information and recent generated tokens. We show that refreshing the KV cache selection during token generation significantly improves the drafter's quality at the cost of additional decode latency. To alleviate the refresh costs, we propose an adaptive KV refresh strategy that reduces the number of score calculations while retaining the drafter's quality. We further demonstrate how a compressibility-driven drafter training phase, based on sparse attention masks, can improve the drafter's quality under a compressed KV cache. Combined with compressibility training, RIFT enables Qwen3.5-4B, drafting for Qwen3.5-122B, to retain over 98% of its full-cache acceptance length on 32K-token inputs, 4K-token outputs, and an 8K-token KV cache budget.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 里夫: 科维 带有辅助压缩训练的模型草稿缓存压缩
articles.content_zh: 光谱解码是一种流行的解码加速方法. 因此,它与长期产出生成特别相关,这需要越来越多的KV缓存. KV缓存压缩提供了一个在长文本起草中限制成本的方法. 然而,专注于预填信息的压缩方法可能会随着输出长度的增长而失去相关性. 我们用这个现象来形容这个现象,解码固态,并显示它在基于选择的 KV 缓存压缩下会降低模型草稿精度. 我们引入RIFT,这是一组基于选择的 KV 缓存压缩策略,平衡了预填信息和最近生成的符号. 我们显示,在代号生成期间刷新 KV 缓存选择会显著提高起草者的质量,而代价是额外的解码间隔. 为了降低刷新成本,我们提出适应性KV刷新策略,减少计分计算数量,同时保留起草者的质量. 我们进一步证明,在压缩的KV缓存下,一个基于注意力面具的压缩驱动起草器培训阶段如何能够提高起草者的质量。 RIFT与可压缩性训练相结合,使得为Quen3.5-122B起草的Quen3.5-4B能够在32K-token输入,4K-token输出,以及8K-token KV缓存预算上保留超过98%的全缓存接受长度.

articles.title: What Pairwise Evaluation Misses: Reward Scores across Prompts
articles.content: Reward models score responses for preference optimization, filtering and ranking, and pooling scores across prompts needs them to be comparable. Yet pairwise evaluation compares two responses to the same prompt, so any score component shared by a prompt's responses cancels and goes untested. We study this component by comparing between-prompt variation in model scores with the same variation in human ratings of the same responses. We propose a human-referenced audit, built from a between-prompt variance share, a sibling-rating regression and prompt substitutions, and apply it to eighteen released scorers and six matched training conditions. We find that scores cluster by prompt more than the ratings do: on HelpSteer2, six reward models have between-prompt shares of 0.34 to 0.64 against a human share near zero. Replacing the original prompt with a fixed instruction keeps substantial clustering but weakens agreement with prompt-level human ratings, so clustering alone does not show agreement with humans. Part of that variation is useful: subtracting prompt means lowers the helpfulness of globally selected responses, and scores stay sensitive to a wrong prompt even when training shuffles prompt means. We propose that reward evaluation check between-prompt variation, sensitivity to a wrong prompt and usefulness for selection separately.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 何为对等评价错失:奖励分数横跨提示
articles.content_zh: 奖励模式对优惠优化、过滤和排位的评分答复,将评分汇集到各提示之间,需要它们具有可比性。 然而双向评价将两个回复比作同一个即时,所以一个即时回复共享的任何分数部分都会取消,未经测试. 我们通过比较模型分数的瞬间变化和相同反应的人类分数的相同变化来研究这个组成部分. 我们建议进行一次人参考审计,根据瞬间差异份额、兄弟级回归和即时替换情况进行,并将它适用于18个解聘的计分员和6个相应的培训条件。 我们发现比收视率更迅速的分数组:在HelpSteer2上,6个奖励模式的瞬间股权为0.34到0.64,而人类股权接近0。 用固定指令取代原始的提示保持实质性的集群化,但削弱与即时级人类评级的一致,因此单是集群化并不能显示与人类的一致. 其中一部分变化是有用的:减去即时反应意味着降低全球所选反应的有用性,分数对错误的即时反应保持敏感,即使培训即时反应。 我们建议,奖励评估在瞬间的变化、对错误的迅速性和单独选择的有用性之间进行检查。

articles.title: SCOPE: Compiling Natural-Language Policies into Neurosymbolic Predicate Programs
articles.content: Policy enforcement for LLM agents has shifted from single-turn content moderation to compound, application-specific policies evaluated over multi-turn transcripts and tool-call trajectories. Fine-tuned guardrail models are efficient but degrade on compound policies, and while LLM-as-a-judge approaches achieve higher accuracy, they incur high inference cost and tend to produce unstable predictions. Neurosymbolic methods offer a natural alternative, decomposing the policy into narrow neural decisions composed under explicit logic. However, existing symbolic layers lack the required expressiveness and are optimized against fixed data rather than the policy itself. To address this, we introduce SCOPE, which compiles a policy into an executable program of neural predicates executed by small models, deterministic extractors, and code that composes their outputs. The program is optimized jointly with its training data, using adversarial generation of counterexamples that target where the program deviates from the policy. We evaluate SCOPE on a benchmark of real-world policy tasks against prompt optimization, task decomposition, and workflow generation methods, achieving the highest average accuracy across tasks and models. Programs optimized with the weakest executor transfer to other models without further optimization. This allows them to be deployed in production on inexpensive models, where they reach accuracy comparable to frontier reasoning models. Unlike these monolithic models, SCOPE produces substantially more stable predictions, and each verdict is interpretable through the predicate outputs that produced it. Additionally, we validate the key components of our method through an ablation study. SCOPE thus enables reliable, interpretable, and efficient policy enforcement at production scale.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SCOPE: 将自然语言政策汇编成神经元 预设程序
articles.content_zh: 对LLM代理人的政策执行已经从单回合内容节制转向复合、具体应用政策,对多回合记录和工具调用轨迹进行评价。 精细的护栏模型是高效的,但因复合政策而退化,虽然LLM-as-a-judge方法的精确度较高,但它们的推论成本很高,往往产生不稳定的预测。 Neurosymbolic方法提供了一个自然的替代方法,将政策分解成由明确逻辑构成的狭义神经决定. 然而,现有的象征性层缺乏所需的表达性,是对照固定数据而不是政策本身来优化的. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了SCOPE,它将一个政策汇编成一个可执行的程序,其中包含由小模型执行的神经上游,决定提取器,以及构成其输出的代码. 方案与其培训数据一起进行优化,使用对抗式生成的反实例,在方案偏离政策的地方设定目标. 我们对照快速优化、任务分解和工作流程生成方法,在现实世界政策任务基准上评价SCOPE,实现不同任务和模式最高平均准确性。 程序优化后最弱的执行器转移到其他模型,而无需进一步优化. 这使得它们能够被部署在廉价的模型上,达到与前沿推理模型相当的精度. 与这些单体模型不同的是,SCOPE能产生相当稳定的预测,每个判断可以通过产生它的上游输出来解释. 此外,我们通过消化研究验证我们方法的关键组成部分。 因此,SCOPE能够在生产规模上可靠、可解释和有效地执行政策。

articles.title: Harm Is Behavioural, Moderation Is Lexical: How Language and Culture Decide Whom Automated Safety Systems Protect and Whom They Silence
articles.content:
Content warning: this paper quotes slurs and hateful statements from published test suites; the racial slur among them is masked.
  Automated systems decide at scale which messages are harmful, and they decide unevenly. Classifiers label African American English as offensive up to twice as often as other English, the accounts of prominent drag queens can score as more toxic than those of white nationalists, and safety behaviour that holds in English collapses in low-resource languages. We argue that over-flagging and under-protection share one cause: deciding harm from vocabulary and surface form rather than from what a message does. We organise the evidence into seven failure modes and argue, as testable hypotheses, that harmful behaviours (a request for secrecy, a demand for payment, an attempt to isolate someone) travel across languages better than the words that express them. We propose an evaluation protocol that makes the gap between the best- and worst-served language communities a headline result, and show that the naive gap is inflated under equal service and that its usual bootstrap interval is unreliable. Applied to five open systems in eleven languages, from a keyword lexicon to two current multilingual guard models, the protocol finds that none reaches native-speaker accuracy at separating harmful function from harmless form (51 of 55 system-language pairs fall short); that greater capability raises discrimination in nine languages while leaving Arabic and romanised Hindi near chance, so the gap between the best- and worst-served languages grows with capability; that one system both over-flags and under-protects the same language most; and that a language a system reads worst can look the most fairly treated when only false positives are reported.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 危害是行为,温和是表征:语言和文化如何决定谁的自动化安全系统保护谁的沉默
articles.content_zh:
内容警告:本文引用了已公布的测试套房的流言蜚语和仇恨言论;其中的种族污蔑被掩盖.
自动化系统在规模上决定哪些信息是有害的,它们决定不均匀。 分类者将非裔美国人英语描述为攻击性最高是其他英语的两倍,显著的拖后腿的叙述可以比白人民族主义者更毒,而英语中的安全行为则以低资源语言存在崩溃. 我们争辩说,过度挥霍和保护不足有一个原因:从词汇和表面形式而不是从信息的作用来决定损害。 我们把证据整理成7种失败模式,并且作为可验证的假设,认为有害行为(要求保密、要求付款、试图孤立某人)比表达其语言的词要好。 我们提议一项评价协议,使服务最优和最差语言群体之间的差距成为头条成果,并表明天真的差距在平等服务下被夸大,其通常的靴子间隔是不可靠的。 协议应用到11种语言的5个开放系统,从关键词词典到目前两种多语种的守护模式,发现没有任何一种语言能够准确区分有害功能和无害形式(55种系统语言配对中的51种不足);能力增强在9种语言中引起歧视,同时使阿拉伯语和罗马化的印地语几乎成为可能,因此服务最优和最差语言之间的差距随着能力而扩大;一个系统既超标,又保护最弱的同一种语言;一个系统读得最差的语言在只报告虚假阳性时可以看起来最公平。

articles.title: Chunk Recomputation under Real Document Revisions: Measuring Update Cost and Retrieval Quality of Fixed, Recursive, and Content-Defined Chunking
articles.content: Chunking strategies for retrieval-augmented generation are almost always evaluated on a static snapshot, yet the documents underlying a knowledge base continue to change. Because chunks are embedded independently, a boundary that moves after an edit forces unchanged text to be re-embedded. We measure this update cost on 120 pairs of adjacent Chinese and English Wikipedia revisions for three stateless chunkers (non-overlapping fixed-size, recursive paragraph-first, and content-defined chunking) under a strict byte-identical reuse rule and a frozen dense encoder. On the 116-article common-success pool, with frozen, length-calibrated parameters, fixed-size chunking recomputes 57-68% of its full new-version embedding-input workload, recursive chunking 38-56%, and content-defined chunking 43-54% (it failed on 4 of 62 Chinese articles), while at these parameters mean evidence recall under a fixed 2048-token retrieval budget differs by less than two percentage points within either language. A cost-only parameter grid shows that the ranking of the two content-aware chunkers changes with chunk-length settings, whereas non-overlapping fixed-size chunking has the highest recomputation cost in every length-matched condition. Controlled edits and a verbatim-presence diagnostic support boundary drift as one contributor to recomputation of text already present in the previous version. Update cost is therefore a substantial, parameter-sensitive dimension that static retrieval evaluations do not expose and that should be reported alongside retrieval quality.

articles.title_zh: 在真实文档下的春克重算 修订:计量更新的固定、递归和内容界定的春金成本和检索质量
articles.content_zh: 几乎总是用静态的快照来评价检索辅助生成的春king策略,但知识库所依据的文件却继续发生变化。 因为块是独立嵌入的,所以在编辑后移动的边框强力不变的文本会被重新嵌入. 我们以120对相邻的中文和英文维基百科修改为标准, 在116条共通的集合上,有冻结的长度校准参数,固定大小的块重计算其全部新版嵌入式投入工作量的57%-68%,递归式块重计算38-56%,以及内容定义的块重计算43-54%(在62条中4条失败),而在这些参数下,在2048年固定的调取预算下,有证据召回,在两种语言中均差不到两个百分点. 仅限成本的参数网格显示,两个内容意识块的排列会随着块长设置而变化,而非重叠的固定大小块在每个长度匹配条件下的重算成本最高. 受控编辑和逐字记录性诊断支持的边界漂移是前一个版本中已经存在的文本的重新计算的一个贡献. 因此,更新成本是一个实质性的、对参数敏感的层面,静态检索评价不会暴露,应当与检索质量一并报告。

articles.title: Mostly Reading: What Open-Book Scores Measure in Document-Level LoRA Adapters
articles.content: Single-document LoRA adapters have been proposed as units of knowledge to be merged and retrieved; yet open-book scoring, with the document in the prompt, can credit a document's own adapter (its specialist) for reading that document as readily as for holding it. Training one adapter for each of 150 Wikipedia articles on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, we find that open-book scores mostly measure a reading behaviour every adapter shares: a random adapter trained on another document recovers 82 % of the specialist's open-book advantage over the base model but only 2 % of its advantage on a cloze probe that asks for the same document's facts without providing the source text, a share we cannot distinguish from zero. Content does reach the weights, since the specialists beat the base model in cloze recall by 0.094, and the geometry of their updates follows the documents they read; yet, in a test of 30 queries, adapters chosen by weight-space proximity or text embedding are not distinguishable from random ones on either probe, although that test cannot exclude an advantage of about four fifths of what a query's own adapter gains over a random one. At 16 documents or more, correctly scaled merges recover 87 % to 89 % of the specialists' open-book advantage but only 12 % to 16 % of their cloze advantage, with intervals that run from below zero to at most 32 %, against 94 % for joint training.We also report four silent errors, each of which produced a clean, wrong result.

articles.title_zh: 主要阅读 : 文档级 LORA 适配器中的什么开放分数测量
articles.content_zh: 单文件 LORA适配器被提议作为需要合并和检索的知识单位;然而,随着文件的及时性,打开的书籍评分可以归功于文件本身的适配器(其专家)阅读该文件的方便程度和持有程度。 对于150篇维基百科文章中每篇关于Llama-3.1-8B-Instructionct的训练一个适配器,我们发现开本得分大多是衡量每个适配器股份的阅读行为:一个随机适配器在另一个文档上训练了82%的专家开本优势在基模型上恢复,但是在一个块状探测器上只有2%的优势要求同一文档的事实而不提供源文本,这个共享我们无法与零区分. 内容确实到达了权重,因为专家以0.094击败了丁字塔中的基础模型,其更新的几何学遵循了他们读到的文档;然而,在30个查询的测试中,以权重空间相近或文本嵌入方式选择的适配器与两个探测器上的随机适配器是无法区分的,尽管该测试不能排除一个查询自身适配器比随机适配器获得的约五分之四的优势. 在16份文件或以上,正确的合并恢复了87%至89%的专家的开放图书优势,但只有12%至16%的专家的血凝胶优势,其间隔从零以下到最多32%,而联合培训为94%。 我们还报告了四个沉默错误,每个错误都产生了一个干净、错误的结果。

articles.title: Padding to k: A Minimum Count in the Schema Makes Open-Weight Models Pad Their Extraction Lists
articles.content: Extraction pipelines ask language models for JSON that follows a schema, and the schema can set a minimum number of list entries. We ask what models do when the document holds fewer items than that minimum. Under a preregistered plan, we test eight open-weight models on 558 real documents from nine annotated datasets, with six more models on hosted services as a reference. Three findings stand out. First, models treat the count as a target: a minimum shown in the schema, but not enforced, raises the share of lists longer than the true count from 34.5% to 55.4%. Second, the padding is hard to catch, because most added entries are real text taken from the document; about half of them pass a check that each entry occurs in the source. Third, common fixes help only partly: a line saying fewer items are fine removes the effect on average but misses more true items, a count in prose ("up to k") also raises over-counting, an "N/A" option under an enforced minimum still leaves half the lists padded, and re-asking with the validation error makes padding far more common. We release the code, answer lists and run records at https://github.com/AbhishekBarali/padding-to-k

articles.title_zh: 铺成 k : Schema 中的最低点数让 开放- 重量模型 铺设其提取列表
articles.content_zh: 采掘管道向JSON查询遵循一个计划的语言模型,计划可以设定最低列表条目数. 我们问,当文件所载项目少于这一最低限度时,模式会做什么。 根据预先注册的计划,我们在9个附加说明的数据集的558个真实文件中测试8个开放量级模型,另外6个关于主机服务的模型作为参考. 三种发现突出. 首先,模型将计数视为一个目标:在计数计划中显示的最小值,但并未执行,比真实计数更长的占比从34.5%提高到55.4%. 其次,粘贴很难捕捉,因为大多数添加的条目都是从文档中取来的真文本;其中约一半通过检查,每个条目都发生在来源中. 第三,常见的修补仅能部分帮助:一行说更少的项目是精细的,可以去除平均效果,但漏掉了更真实的项目,一个借词("上至k")的计数也会引起过量计算,一个强制最小值下的"N/A"选项仍然留下一半的列表的加词,用校验错误重新询问使得加词更加常见. 我们在https://github.com/Abhishek Barali/pading-to-k上发布代码、答复清单和运行记录。
